creator: system
detail_en: Ensure mounting of cramfs filesystems is disabled
detail_zh: 确保cramfs文件系统的挂载被禁用

extraDetail.description: cramfs文件系统类型是嵌入在小型系统中的压缩只读Linux文件系统。可以不必先解压cramfs镜像就可使用。
extraDetail.rationale: 删除对不需要的文件系统类型的支持可以减少服务器本地的攻击面。如果不需要该文件系统类型，请禁用。
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令，验证输出结果如下所示:
modprobe -n -v cramfs| grep -E '(cramfs|install)'
install /bin/true
lsmod | grep cramfs <No output>
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/modprobe.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.conf结尾的文件。
例如:vim /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf，增加如下一行:install cramfs /bin/true
执行以下命令卸载cramfs模块:
卸载cramfs模块
extraDetail.description_en: The cramfs filesystem type is a compressed read-only Linux filesystem embedded in small footprint systems. A cramfs image can be used without having to first decompress the image.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Removing support for unneeded filesystem types reduces the local attack surface of the server. If this filesystem type is not needed, disable it
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following commands and verify the output is as indicated:
modprobe -n -v cramfs | grep -E '(cramfs|install)'
install /bin/true
lsmod | grep cramfs  <No output>
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit or create a file in the /etc/modprobe.d/ directory ending in .conf
Example: vim /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf
and add the following line:
install cramfs /bin/true
Run the following command to unload the cramfs module:
rmmod cramfs

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure mounting of squashfs filesystems is disabled
detail_zh: 确保已禁用squashfs文件系统的挂载

extraDetail.description: squashfs文件系统类型是一个压缩的只读Linux文件系统，嵌入在小型系统中(类似于cramfs)。可以不必首先解压squashfs镜像就可以使用。
extraDetail.rationale: 删除对不需要的文件系统类型的支持可以减少系统的本地攻击面。如果不需要该文件系统类型，请禁用。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，查看回显信息是否与所示一致。# modprobe -n -v squashfs| grep -E '(squashfs|install)' install /bin/true # lsmod | grep squashfs <No output>
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/modprobe中编辑或创建一个文件。vi /etc/modprobe.d/squashfs.conf。
例如:vi /etc/modprobe.d/squashfs.conf增加如下一行:install squashfs /bin/true卸载squashfs模块
extraDetail.impact: 禁用squashfs将阻止使用snap。snap是Linux下的包管理器，用于安装snap包软件。“Snap”应用程序包是自包含的，可以在一系列Linux发行版中工作。这与传统的Linux包管理方法(如APT或RPM)不同，后者需要在应用程序更新时对每个Linux发行版进行专门的改编包，因此会延迟从开发人员到软件最终用户的应用程序部署。snap本身不依赖于任何外部商店(“应用程序商店”)，可以从任何来源获得，因此可用于上游软件部署。当snap部署在Linux版本上时，Ubuntu应用程序商店被用作默认后端，但也可以启用其他存储
extraDetail.description_en: The squashfs filesystem type is a compressed read-only Linux filesystem embedded in small footprint systems (similar to cramfs ). A squashfs image can be used without having to first decompress the image.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Removing support for unneeded filesystem types reduces the local attack surface of the system. If this filesystem type is not needed, disable it.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify the output is as indicated: # modprobe -n -v squashfs | grep -E '(squashfs|install)'  install /bin/true # lsmod | grep squashfs  <No output>
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit or create a file in the /etc/modprobe.d/ directory ending in .conf Example: vi /etc/modprobe.d/squashfs.conf and add the following line: install squashfs /bin/true Run the following command to unload the squashfs module: # rmmod squashfs
extraDetail.impact_en: Disabling squashfs will prevent the use of snap. Snap is a package manager for Linux for installing Snap packages. "Snap" application packages of software are self-contained and work across a range of Linux distributions. This is unlike traditional Linux package management approaches, like APT or RPM, which require specifically adapted packages per Linux distribution on an application update and delay therefore application deployment from developers to their software's end-user. Snaps themselves have no dependency on any external store ("App store"), can be obtained from any source and can be therefore used for upstream software deployment. When snaps are deployed on versions of Linux, the Ubuntu app store is used as default back-end, but other stores can be enabled as well.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure mounting of udf filesystems is disabled
detail_zh: 确保禁用了udf文件系统的挂载

extraDetail.description: udf文件系统类型是用于实现ISO/IEC 13346和ECMA-167规范的通用磁盘格式。这是一种开放的供应商文件系统类型，用于在广泛的媒体上存储数据。这种文件系统类型是支持写入DVD和更新的光盘格式所必需的
extraDetail.rationale: 删除对不需要的文件系统类型的支持可以减少系统的本地攻击面。如果不需要该文件系统类型，请禁用
extraDetail.audit: # modprobe -n -v udf| grep -E '(udf|install)' install /bin/true # lsmod | grep udf <No output>
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/modprobe中编辑或创建一个文件。vi /etc/modprobe.d/udf.conf。
例如:vi /etc/modprobe.d/udf.conf
增加如下一行:install udf /bin/true
卸载udf模块。
extraDetail.description_en: The udf filesystem type is the universal disk format used to implement ISO/IEC 13346 and ECMA-167 specifications. This is an open vendor filesystem type for data storage on a broad range of media. This filesystem type is necessary to support writing DVDs and newer optical disc formats.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Removing support for unneeded filesystem types reduces the local attack surface of the system. If this filesystem type is not needed, disable it
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify the output is as indicated: # modprobe -n -v udf | grep -E '(udf|install)'  install /bin/true # lsmod | grep udf  <No output>
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit or create a file in the /etc/modprobe.d/ directory ending in .conf Example: vi /etc/modprobe.d/udf.conf and add the following line: install udf /bin/true Run the following command to unload the udf module: # rmmod udf

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure /tmp is configured

extraDetail.description: /tmp目录是一个全局可写目录，用于所有用户和一些应用程序的临时存储。
extraDetail.rationale: 使/tmp成为自己的文件系统允许管理员在挂载上设置noexec选项，使/tmp对于攻击者安装可执行代码毫无作用。它还可以防止攻击者建立到系统setuid程序的硬链接，并等待它被更新。一旦程序更新，硬链接就会被破坏，攻击者就会拥有自己的程序副本。如果程序恰好有安全漏洞，攻击者可以继续利用已知的漏洞。这可以通过将tmpfs挂载到/tmp或为/tmp创建一个单独的分区来实现。
extraDetail.audit:
# findmnt -n /tmp /tmp tmpfs tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec如果使用/etc/fstab:执行以下命令，检查tmpfs已经挂载到tmpfs上，或者已经为/tmp创建了系统分区
# grep -E '\s/tmp\s' /etc/fstab | grep -E -v '^\s*#' tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0 or如果systemd tmp。挂载文件:执行以下命令，检查“tmp. conf”文件是否存在。已启用挂载:# systemctl show“tmp”。mount" | grep -i unitfilestate unitfilestate =enabled .
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/fstab或systemd tmp目录中创建或更新/tmp条目。挂载文件:如果使用/etc/fstab:根据实际情况配置/etc/fstab
Example
tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0
执行以下命令重新挂载/tmp
mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /tmp
或者,如果存在“systemd tmp.mount”文件，则执行以下命令创建“/etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount”文件:
[ ! -f /etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount ] && cp -v /usr/lib/systemd/system/tmp.mount /etc/systemd/system/
编辑/etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount文件:
[Mount]
What=tmpfs
Where=/tmp
Type=tmpfs
Options=mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid
运行命令重新加载systemd守护进程:
systemctl daemon-reload
执行以下命令，取消掩码并启动tmp.mount:
systemctl --now unmask tmp.mount
extraDetail.impact: 由于/tmp目录是全局都可以写的，如果它没有绑定到一个单独的分区，就有资源耗尽的风险。不管它下面是什么样的文件系统，耗尽/tmp空间都是一个问题，但是在默认安装中，基于磁盘的/tmp实际上会有整个磁盘可用，因为它只创建一个/分区。另一方面，与tmpfs一样，基于RAM的/tmp几乎肯定要小得多，这可能导致应用程序更容易填满文件系统。
extraDetail.description_en: The /tmp directory is a world-writable directory used for temporary storage by all users and some applications.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Making /tmp its own file system allows an administrator to set the noexec option on the mount, making /tmp useless for an attacker to install executable code. It would also prevent an attacker from establishing a hardlink to a system setuid program and wait for it to be updated. Once the program was updated, the hardlink would be broken and the attacker would have his own copy of the program. If the program happened to have a security vulnerability, the attacker could continue to exploit the known flaw. This can be accomplished by either mounting tmpfs to /tmp, or creating a separate partition for /tmp.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify output shows /tmp to tmpfs or a system partition: # findmnt -n /tmp  /tmp   tmpfs  tmpfs  rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec If /etc/fstab is used: run the following command and verify that tmpfs has been mounted to tmpfs, or a system partition has been created for /tmp # grep -E '\s/tmp\s' /etc/fstab | grep -E -v '^\s*#'  tmpfs   /tmp    tmpfs   defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0   0 OR If systemd tmp.mount file is used: run the following command and verify that tmp.mount is enabled: # systemctl show "tmp.mount" | grep -i unitfilestate  UnitFileState=enabled
extraDetail.remediation_en: Create or update an entry for /tmp in either /etc/fstab OR in a systemd tmp.mount file: If /etc/fstab is used: configure /etc/fstab as appropriate. Example: tmpfs /tmp tmpfs     defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime  0 0 Run the following command to remount /tmp # mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /tmp OR if systemd tmp.mount file is used: run the following command to create the file /etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount if it doesn't exist: # [ ! -f /etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount ] && cp -v /usr/lib/systemd/system/tmp.mount /etc/systemd/system/ Edit the file /etc/systemd/system/tmp.mount: [Mount] What=tmpfs Where=/tmp Type=tmpfs Options=mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid  Run the following command to reload the systemd daemon: # systemctl daemon-reload Run the following command to unmask and start tmp.mount: # systemctl --now unmask tmp
extraDetail.impact_en: Since the /tmp directory is intended to be world-writable, there is a risk of resource exhaustion if it is not bound to a separate partition. Running out of /tmp space is a problem regardless of what kind of filesystem lies under it, but in a default installation a disk-based /tmp will essentially have the whole disk available, as it only creates a single / partition. On the other hand, a RAM-based /tmp as with tmpfs will almost certainly be much smaller, which can lead to applications filling up the filesystem much more easily.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure noexec option set on /tmp partition
detail_zh: 确保在/tmp分区上设置了noexec选项

extraDetail.description: noexec挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含可执行二进制文件
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/tmp文件系统仅用于临时文件存储，因此设置此选项以确保用户不能从/tmp运行可执行二进制文件
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令，验证是否设置了noexec选项:
findmnt -n /tmp | grep -Ev '\bnodev\b'
不应该有任何返回
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑/etc/fstab文件或/etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount文件:
如果使用/etc/fstab挂载/tmp，编辑/etc/fstab文件，在/tmp分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)中添加noexec。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。执行以下命令重新挂载/tmp:
mount -o remount,noexec /tmp
或者如果使用systemd挂载/tmp:
编辑/etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target。想要/tmp.mount添加noexec到/tmp挂载选项:
[Mount]
options =mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid
运行命令重新启动systemd守护进程:
systemctl daemon-reload
执行以下命令重启tmp.mount
systemctl restart tmp.mount
extraDetail.description_en: The noexec mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain executable binaries.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /tmp filesystem is only intended for temporary file storage, set this option to ensure that users cannot run executable binaries from /tmp
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify the noexec option is set: # findmnt -n /tmp | grep -Ev '\bnodev\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file OR the /etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount file: IF /etc/fstab is used to mount /tmp Edit the /etc/fstab file and add noexec to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /tmp partition. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /tmp: # mount -o remount,noexec /tmp OR if systemd is used to mount /tmp:_ Edit /etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount to add noexec to the /tmp mount options: [Mount] Options=mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid Run the following command to restart the systemd daemon: #  systemctl daemon-reload Run the following command to restart tmp.mount # systemctl restart tmp.mount

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition
detail_zh: 确保在/tmp分区上设置了nodev选项

extraDetail.description: nodev挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含特殊设备。
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/tmp文件系统不打算支持设备，因此设置该选项以确保用户不能尝试在/tmp中创建块或字符特殊设备
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，检查是否设置了nodev选项:
findmnt -n /tmp -n | grep -Ev '\bnodev\b'应该没有返回信息
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab文件或/etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp. conf文件。挂载文件:如果使用/etc/fstab挂载/tmp，编辑/etc/fstab文件，将nodev添加到/tmp分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。# mount -o remount,nodev /tmp或者(如果使用systemd挂载/tmp):编辑/etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp。[mount] options =mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid执行以下命令，重新启动systemd守护进程。Mount # systemctl restart tmp.mount
extraDetail.description_en: The nodev mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain special devices.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /tmp filesystem is not intended to support devices, set this option to ensure that users cannot attempt to create block or character special devices in /tmp
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify the nodev option is set: # findmnt -n /tmp -n | grep -Ev '\bnodev\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file OR the /etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount file: IF /etc/fstab is used to mount /tmp Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nodev to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /tmp partition. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /tmp: # mount -o remount,nodev /tmp OR if systemd is used to mount /tmp: Edit /etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount to add nodev to the /tmp mount options: [Mount] Options=mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid Run the following command to restart the systemd daemon: #  systemctl daemon-reload Run the following command to restart tmp.mount # systemctl restart tmp.mount

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nosuid option set on /tmp partition
detail_zh: 确保nosuid选项设置在/tmp分区上

extraDetail.description: nosuid挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含setuid文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/tmp文件系统仅用于临时文件存储，因此设置该选项以确保用户不能在/tmp中创建setuid文件
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令:
findmnt -n /tmp -n | grep -Ev '\bnosuid\b'
不应该有任何返回
extraDetail.remediation: 如果使用/etc/fstab挂载/tmp，编辑/etc/fstab文件，在/tmp分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)中添加nosuid。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。运行下述命令重新挂载/tmp：# mount -o remount, nosuid /tmp 或者如果systemd用于挂在/tmp：编辑/etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount来添加nosuid到/tmp挂载参数：[Mount] Options=mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid。运行以下命令来重启systemd守护进程：#  systemctl daemon-reload. 运行下述明林重启tmp.mount: # systemctl restart tmp.mount
extraDetail.description_en: The nosuid mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain setuid files.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /tmp filesystem is only intended for temporary file storage, set this option to ensure that users cannot create setuid files in /tmp
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify the nodev option is set: # findmnt -n /tmp -n | grep -Ev '\bnosuid\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: IF /etc/fstab is used to mount /tmp Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nosuid to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /tmp partition. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /tmp : # mount -o remount,nosuid /tmp OR if systemd is used to mount /tmp: Edit /etc/systemd/system/local-fs.target.wants/tmp.mount to add nosuid to the /tmp mount options: [Mount] Options=mode=1777,strictatime,noexec,nodev,nosuid Run the following command to restart the systemd daemon: #  systemctl daemon-reload Run the following command to restart tmp.mount:  # systemctl restart tmp.mount

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure /dev/shm is configured

extraDetail.description: /dev/shm是一个传统的共享内存概念。一个程序将创建一个内存部分，其他进程(如果允许)可以访问该内存部分。在/dev/shm上挂载tmpfs由systemd自动处理。
extraDetail.rationale: 任何用户都可以在/dev/shm中上传和执行文件，类似于/tmp分区。配置/dev/shm允许管理员在挂载上设置noexec选项，使/dev/shm对于攻击者安装可执行代码毫无作用。它还可以防止攻击者建立到系统setuid程序的硬链接，并等待它被更新。一旦程序更新，硬链接就会被破坏，攻击者就会拥有自己的程序副本。如果程序恰好有安全漏洞，攻击者可以继续利用已知的漏洞
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，查看显示是否挂载了/dev/shm:
findmnt -n /dev/shm
执行以下命令，检查/etc/fstab中是否存在/dev/shm条目
。# grep -E '\s/dev/shm' /etc/fstab
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab然后添加或者编辑下面的一行: tmpfs      /dev/shm    tmpfs   defaults,noexec,nodev,nosuid,seclabel   0 0    运行下面命令来重新挂载/dev/shm：# mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm 额外信息:  /etc/fstab为/dev/shm提供的入口 将会优先.  tmpfs可以用/etc/fstab中的size={size}参数来调整大小。如果我们不指定大小，就是默认RAM的一半。调整tmpfs大小的例子：  tmpfs   /dev/shm    tmpfs   defaults,noexec,nodev,nosuid,size=2G  0   0
extraDetail.description_en: /dev/shm is a traditional shared memory concept. One program will create a memory portion, which other processes (if permitted) can access. Mounting tmpfs at /dev/shm is handled automatically by systemd.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Any user can upload and execute files inside the /dev/shm similar to the /tmp partition. Configuring /dev/shm allows an administrator to set the noexec option on the mount, making /dev/shm useless for an attacker to install executable code. It would also prevent an attacker from establishing a hardlink to a system setuid program and wait for it to be updated. Once the program was updated, the hardlink would be broken and the attacker would have his own copy of the program. If the program happened to have a security vulnerability, the attacker could continue to exploit the known flaw
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify output shows /dev/shm is mounted: # findmnt -n /dev/shm  tmpfs on /dev/shm type tmpfs (rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,seclabel) Run the following command and verify an entry for /dev/shm exists in /etc/fstab: # grep -E '\s/dev/shm\s' /etc/fstab  tmpfs      /dev/shm    tmpfs   defaults,noexec,nodev,nosuid   0 0
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit /etc/fstab and add or edit the following line: tmpfs      /dev/shm    tmpfs   defaults,noexec,nodev,nosuid,seclabel   0 0 Run the following command to remount /dev/shm: # mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm Additional Information:  An entry for /dev/shm in /etc/fstab will take precedence.  tmpfs can be resized using the size={size} parameter in /etc/fstab. If we don't specify the size, it will be half the RAM. Resize tmpfs example:   tmpfs   /dev/shm    tmpfs   defaults,noexec,nodev,nosuid,size=2G  0   0

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure noexec option set on /dev/shm partition
detail_zh: 确保在/dev/shm分区设置了noexec选项

extraDetail.description: noexec挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含可执行二进制文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 在文件系统上设置此选项可防止用户从共享内存执行程序。这可以阻止用户在系统上引入潜在的恶意软件
extraDetail.audit: # findmnt -n /dev/shm | grep -Ev '\bnoexec\b'不应该有任何返回
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab文件，在/dev/shm分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)中添加noexec。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。# mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm附加信息:/dev/shm由systemd自动挂载。/dev/shm需要添加到/etc/fstab以添加挂载选项，即使它已经在引导时被挂载。
extraDetail.description_en: The noexec mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain executable binaries.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting this option on a file system prevents users from executing programs from shared memory. This deters users from introducing potentially malicious software on the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the noexec option is set: # findmnt -n /dev/shm | grep -Ev '\bnoexec\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file and add noexec to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /dev/shm partition. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /dev/shm: # mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm Additional Information: /dev/shm is mounted automatically by systemd. /dev/shm needs to be added to /etc/fstab to add mount options even though it is already being mounted on boot.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nodev option set on /dev/shm partition

extraDetail.description: nodev挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含特殊设备。
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/dev/shm文件系统不支持设备，因此设置此选项以确保用户不能尝试在/dev/shm分区中创建特殊设备
extraDetail.audit: # findmnt -n /dev/shm | grep -Ev '\bnodev\b'不应该有任何返回
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab文件，将nodev添加到/dev/shm分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。# mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm附加信息:/dev/shm由systemd自动挂载。/dev/shm需要添加到/etc/fstab以添加挂载选项，即使它已经在引导时被挂载。
extraDetail.description_en: The nodev mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain special devices.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /dev/shm filesystem is not intended to support devices, set this option to ensure that users cannot attempt to create special devices in /dev/shm partitions
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the nodev option is set: # findmnt -n /dev/shm | grep -Ev '\bnodev\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nodev to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /dev/shm partition. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /dev/shm: # mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm Additional Information: /dev/shm is mounted automatically by systemd. /dev/shm needs to be added to /etc/fstab to add mount options even though it is already being mounted on boot.

creator: system

extraDetail.rationale: 在文件系统上设置此选项可防止用户将特权程序引入系统并允许非根用户执行这些程序
extraDetail.audit: # findmnt -n /dev/shm | grep -Ev '\bnosuid\b'不应该有任何返回

extraDetail.description_en: The nosuid mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain setuid files.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting this option on a file system prevents users from introducing privileged programs onto the system and allowing non-root users to execute them
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the nosuid option is set: # findmnt -n /dev/shm | grep -Ev '\bnosuid\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nosuid to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /dev/shm partition. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /dev/shm: # mount -o remount,noexec,nodev,nosuid /dev/shm Additional Information: /dev/shm is mounted automatically by systemd. /dev/shm needs to be added to /etc/fstab to add mount options even though it is already being mounted on boot.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure separate partition exists for /var

extraDetail.description: /var目录被守护进程和其他系统服务用来临时存储动态数据。由这些进程创建的一些目录可能是全域可写的。
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/var目录可能包含全局可写的文件和目录，如果不将其绑定到单独的分区，则存在资源耗尽的风险。
extraDetail.audit: # findmnt /var TARGET SOURCE FSTYPE OPTIONS /var <device> < FSTYPE > rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota .执行以下命令，查看是否挂载了/var
extraDetail.remediation: 对于新安装的系统，在安装过程中创建一个自定义分区设置，并为/var指定一个单独的分区。对于以前安装的系统，创建一个新分区，并适当地配置/etc/fstab。引用:1. AJ Lewis， "LVM HOWTO"， http://tldp.org/HOWTO/LVM-HOWTO/ 附加信息:修改/var时，建议将系统设置为紧急模式(因此auditd不运行)，重命名现有目录，挂载新文件系统，并在返回多用户模式之前迁移数据。
extraDetail.impact: 在云托管服务器中，调整文件系统大小是一种常见的活动。单独的文件系统分区可能会阻止成功的调整大小，或者可能需要安装额外的工具来进行调整大小操作。使用这些附加工具可能会引入它们自己的安全注意事项。
extraDetail.description_en: The /var directory is used by daemons and other system services to temporarily store dynamic data. Some directories created by these processes may be world-writable.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /var directory may contain world-writable files and directories, there is a risk of resource exhaustion if it is not bound to a separate partition.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify output shows /var is mounted: # findmnt /var  TARGET SOURCE    FSTYPE  OPTIONS /var  <device>  <fstype> rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota
extraDetail.remediation_en: For new installations, during installation create a custom partition setup and specify a separate partition for /var For systems that were previously installed, create a new partition and configure /etc/fstab as appropriate. References: 1. AJ Lewis, "LVM HOWTO", http://tldp.org/HOWTO/LVM-HOWTO/  Additional Information: When modifying /var it is advisable to bring the system to emergency mode (so auditd is not running), rename the existing directory, mount the new file system, and migrate the data over before returning to multiuser mode.
extraDetail.impact_en: Resizing filesystems is a common activity in cloud-hosted servers. Separate filesystem partitions may prevent successful resizing, or may require the installation of additional tools solely for the purpose of resizing operations. The use of these additional tools may introduce their own security considerations.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure separate partition exists for /var/tmp

extraDetail.description: /var/tmp目录是一个全局可写目录，用于所有用户和一些应用程序的临时存储，用于重新启动时保留的临时文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/var/tmp目录是全域可写的，如果它没有绑定到一个单独的分区，就会有资源耗尽的风险。此外，使/var/tmp成为自己的文件系统，允许管理员在挂载上设置noexec选项，使/var/tmp对于攻击者安装可执行代码毫无作用。它还可以防止攻击者建立到系统setuid程序的硬链接，并等待它被更新。一旦程序更新，硬链接就会被破坏，攻击者就会拥有自己的程序副本。如果程序恰好有安全漏洞，攻击者可以继续利用已知的漏洞。
extraDetail.audit: # find mnt /var/tmp TARGET SOURCE FSTYPE OPTIONS /var/tmp <device> < FSTYPE > rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota
extraDetail.remediation: 对于新增安装系统，在安装期间创建一个自定义分区然后为/var/tmp制定一个独立分区。对于已安装好的系统，创建一个新的分区然后酌情配置/etc/fstab。 额外信息：  tmpfs 不应该用于/var/tmp。 tmpfs一个存在于内存或者swap分区的临时文件系统。 tmpfs的文件将会在每次启动时自动清理。
extraDetail.impact: 在云托管服务器中，调整文件系统大小是一种常见的活动。单独的文件系统分区可能会阻止成功的调整大小，或者可能需要安装额外的工具来进行调整大小操作。使用这些附加工具可能会引入它们自己的安全注意事项。
extraDetail.description_en: The /var/tmp directory is a world-writable directory used for temporary storage by all users and some applications and is intended for temporary files that are preserved across reboots.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /var/tmp directory is intended to be world-writable, there is a risk of resource exhaustion if it is not bound to a separate partition. In addition, making /var/tmp its own file system allows an administrator to set the noexec option on the mount, making /var/tmp useless for an attacker to install executable code. It would also prevent an attacker from establishing a hardlink to a system setuid program and wait for it to be updated. Once the program was updated, the hardlink would be broken and the attacker would have his own copy of the program. If the program happened to have a security vulnerability, the attacker could continue to exploit the known flaw.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify output shows /var/tmp is mounted: # findmnt /var/tmp  TARGET   SOURCE    FSTYPE   OPTIONS /var/tmp <device>  <fstype> rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota
extraDetail.remediation_en: For new installations, during installation create a custom partition setup and specify a separate partition for /var/tmp For systems that were previously installed, create a new partition and configure /etc/fstab as appropriate. Additional Information:  tmpfs should not be used for /var/tmp/   tmpfs is a temporary filesystem that resides in memory and/or swap partition(s)  Files in tmpfs are automatically cleared at each bootup
extraDetail.impact_en: Resizing filesystems is a common activity in cloud-hosted servers. Separate filesystem partitions may prevent successful resizing, or may require the installation of additional tools solely for the purpose of resizing operations. The use of these additional tools may introduce their own security considerations.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure /var/tmp partition includes the noexec option

extraDetail.description: noexec挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含可执行二进制文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 由于/var/tmp文件系统仅用于临时文件存储，因此设置此选项以确保用户不能从/var/tmp运行可执行二进制文件
extraDetail.audit: 如果存在/var/tmp分区，执行以下命令检查是否设置了noexec选项。# findmnt -n /var/tmp | grep -Ev '\bnoexec\b'不应该有任何返回
extraDetail.remediation: 对于现有的/var/tmp分区，编辑/etc/fstab文件，并在/var/tmp条目的第四个字段(挂载选项)中添加noexec。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。# mount -o remount,noexec /var/tmp
extraDetail.description_en: The noexec mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain executable binaries.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the /var/tmp filesystem is only intended for temporary file storage, set this option to ensure that users cannot run executable binaries from /var/tmp
extraDetail.audit_en: If a /var/tmp partition exists, run the following command to verify that the noexec option is set: # findmnt -n /var/tmp | grep -Ev '\bnoexec\b'  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: For existing /var/tmp partitions, edit the /etc/fstab file and add noexec to the fourth field (mounting options) of the /var/tmp entry. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information. Run the following command to remount /var/tmp : # mount -o remount,noexec /var/tmp

extraDetail.audit: # findmnt /var/log TARGET SOURCE FSTYPE OPTIONS /var/log <device> < FSTYPE > rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota . rw: rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota . rw: rw,relatime,attr2
extraDetail.remediation: 对于新的安装，在安装过程中创建一个自定义分区设置，并为/var/log指定一个单独的分区。对于以前安装的系统，创建一个新分区并适当配置/etc/fstab。引用:1。AJ Lewis， "LVM HOWTO"， http://tldp.org/HOWTO/LVM-HOWTO/ 附加信息:修改/var/log时，建议将系统设置为紧急模式(因此auditd不运行)，重命名现有目录，挂载新的文件系统，并在返回多用户模式之前迁移数据。

extraDetail.rationale_en: There are two important reasons to ensure that system logs are stored on a separate partition: protection against resource exhaustion (since logs can grow quite large) and protection of audit data.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify output shows /var/log is mounted: # findmnt /var/log  TARGET   SOURCE   FSTYPE   OPTIONS /var/log <device> <fstype> rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota
extraDetail.remediation_en: For new installations, during installation create a custom partition setup and specify a separate partition for /var/log . For systems that were previously installed, create a new partition and configure /etc/fstab as appropriate. References: 1. AJ Lewis, "LVM HOWTO", http://tldp.org/HOWTO/LVM-HOWTO/  Additional Information: When modifying /var/log it is advisable to bring the system to emergency mode (so auditd is not running), rename the existing directory, mount the new file system, and migrate the data over before returning to multiuser mode.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure separate partition exists for /var/log/audit

extraDetail.description: 审计守护进程auditd将日志数据存储在/var/log/audit目录中。
extraDetail.rationale: 确保auditd收集的数据存储在单独的分区上有两个重要原因:防止资源耗尽(因为audit.log文件可能会变得相当大)和保护审计数据。审计守护进程计算剩余的空闲空间，并根据结果执行操作。如果其他进程(如syslog)在审计的分区中占用空间，则可能无法按预期执行。
extraDetail.audit: # findmnt /var/log/audit TARGET SOURCE FSTYPE OPTIONS /var/log/audit <device> < FSTYPE > rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota . rw: rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota . rw: rw,relatime,attr2
extraDetail.remediation: 对于新的安装，在安装过程中创建一个自定义分区设置，并为/var/log/audit指定一个单独的分区。对于以前安装的系统，创建一个新分区并适当配置/etc/fstab。参考:AJ Lewis，“LVM HOWTO”，http://tldp.org/HOWTO/LVM-HOWTO/附加信息:在修改/var/log/audit时，建议将系统设置为紧急模式(因此auditd不运行)，重命名现有目录，挂载新文件系统，并在返回多用户模式之前迁移数据。
extraDetail.impact: 在云托管服务器中，调整文件系统大小是一种常见的活动。单独的文件系统分区可能会阻止成功的调整大小，或者可能需要安装额外的工具来进行调整大小操作。使用这些附加工具可能会引入它们自己的安全注意事项。
extraDetail.description_en: The auditing daemon, auditd , stores log data in the /var/log/audit directory.
extraDetail.rationale_en: There are two important reasons to ensure that data gathered by auditd is stored on a separate partition: protection against resource exhaustion (since the audit.log file can grow quite large) and protection of audit data. The audit daemon calculates how much free space is left and performs actions based on the results. If other processes (such as syslog ) consume space in the same partition as auditd , it may not perform as desired.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify output shows /var/log/audit is mounted: # findmnt /var/log/audit  TARGET         SOURCE   FSTYPE   OPTIONS /var/log/audit <device> <fstype> rw,relatime,attr2,inode64,noquota
extraDetail.remediation_en: For new installations, during installation create a custom partition setup and specify a separate partition for /var/log/audit . For systems that were previously installed, create a new partition and configure /etc/fstab as appropriate.  References: 1. AJ Lewis, "LVM HOWTO", http://tldp.org/HOWTO/LVM-HOWTO/ Additional Information: When modifying /var/log/audit it is advisable to bring the system to emergency mode (so auditd is not running), rename the existing directory, mount the new file system, and migrate the data over before returning to multiuser mode.

The use of these additional tools may introduce their own security considerations.

extraDetail.description: noexec挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含可执行二进制文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 在文件系统上设置此选项将阻止用户从可移动媒体执行程序。这可以阻止用户在系统上引入潜在的恶意软件
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下脚本，并验证在所有可移动媒体分区上设置了noexec选项。＃！/usr/bin/bash为rmpo $(lsblk -o RM,MOUNTPOINT | awk -F " " '/1/{打印$2}');do findmnt -n "$rmpo" | grep -Ev "\bnoexec\b" done什么都不应该返回
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab文件，在所有可移动介质分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)中添加noexec。查找挂载点包含诸如floppy或cdrom等词的条目。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。
extraDetail.description_en: The noexec mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain executable binaries.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting this option on a file system prevents users from executing programs from the removable media. This deters users from being able to introduce potentially malicious software on the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following script and verify that the noexec option is set on all removable media partitions. #!/usr/bin/bash  for rmpo in $(lsblk -o RM,MOUNTPOINT | awk -F " " '/1/ {print $2}'); do     findmnt -n "$rmpo" | grep -Ev "\bnoexec\b" done Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file and add noexec to the fourth field (mounting options) of all removable media partitions. Look for entries that have mount points that contain words such as floppy or cdrom. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nodev option set on removable media partitions
detail_zh: 确保在可移动媒体分区上设置nodev选项

extraDetail.description: nodev挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含特殊设备。
extraDetail.rationale: 可以使用包含字符和块特殊设备的可移动媒体来绕过安全控制，允许非根用户访问敏感设备文件，如/dev/kmem或裸磁盘分区
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下脚本并验证在所有可移动媒体分区上设置了nodev选项。＃！/usr/bin/bash为rmpo $(lsblk -o RM,MOUNTPOINT | awk -F " " '/1/{打印$2}');do findmnt -n "$rmpo" | grep -Ev "\bnodev\b" done什么都不应该返回
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab文件，将nodev添加到所有可移动媒体分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)。查找挂载点包含诸如floppy或cdrom等词的条目。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。
extraDetail.description_en: The nodev mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain special devices.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Removable media containing character and block special devices could be used to circumvent security controls by allowing non-root users to access sensitive device files such as /dev/kmem or the raw disk partitions
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following script and verify that the nodev option is set on all removable media partitions. #!/usr/bin/bash  for rmpo in $(lsblk -o RM,MOUNTPOINT | awk -F " " '/1/ {print $2}'); do     findmnt -n "$rmpo" | grep -Ev "\bnodev\b" done Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nodev to the fourth field (mounting options) of all removable media partitions. Look for entries that have mount points that contain words such as floppy or cdrom. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nosuid option set on removable media partitions
detail_zh: 确保在可移动媒体分区上设置nosuid选项

extraDetail.description: nosuid挂载选项指定文件系统不能包含setuid文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 在文件系统上设置此选项可防止用户将特权程序引入系统并允许非根用户执行这些程序
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查是否在所有可移动媒体分区上设置了nosuid选项。＃！/usr/bin/bash为rmpo $(lsblk -o RM,MOUNTPOINT | awk -F " " '/1/{打印$2}');do findmnt -n "$rmpo" | grep -Ev "\bnosuid\b" done什么都不应该返回
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/fstab文件，在所有可移动媒体分区的第四个字段(挂载选项)中添加nosuid。查找挂载点包含诸如floppy或cdrom等词的条目。有关更多信息，请参阅fstab(5)手册页。
extraDetail.description_en: The nosuid mount option specifies that the filesystem cannot contain setuid files.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting this option on a file system prevents users from introducing privileged programs onto the system and allowing non-root users to execute them
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify that the nosuid option is set on all removable media partitions. #!/usr/bin/bash  for rmpo in $(lsblk -o RM,MOUNTPOINT | awk -F " " '/1/ {print $2}'); do     findmnt -n "$rmpo" | grep -Ev "\bnosuid\b" done Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nosuid to the fourth field (mounting options) of all removable media partitions. Look for entries that have mount points that contain words such as floppy or cdrom. See the fstab(5) manual page for more information.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure sticky bit is set on all world-writable directories
detail_zh: 确保在所有全局可写目录上设置了sticky位

extraDetail.description: 在全局可写目录上设置sticky位可以防止用户删除或重命名该目录中不属于他们的文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 该特性阻止删除或重命名其他用户拥有的全局可写目录(如/tmp)中的文件。# df——local -P 2> /dev/null | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type d \(-perm -0002 -a !-perm -1000 \) 2>/dev/null不返回任何输出。补救措施:执行以下命令设置所有全局可写目录的粘位:# df——local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type d \(-perm -0002 -a !-perm -1000 \) 2>/dev/null | xargs -I '{}' chmod a+t '{}'
extraDetail.audit: # df——local -P 2> /dev/null | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type d \(-perm -0002 -a !-perm -1000 \) 2>/dev/null不返回任何输出。
extraDetail.remediation: # df——local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type d \(-perm -0002 -a !-perm -1000 \) 2>/dev/null | xargs -I '{}' chmod a+t '{}'
extraDetail.description_en: Setting the sticky bit on world writable directories prevents users from deleting or renaming files in that directory that are not owned by them.
extraDetail.rationale_en: This feature prevents the ability to delete or rename files in world writable directories (such as /tmp ) that are owned by another user
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify no world writable directories exist without the sticky bit set: # df --local -P 2> /dev/null | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type d \( -perm -0002 -a ! -perm -1000 \) 2>/dev/null  No output should be returned.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to set the sticky bit on all world writable directories: # df --local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type d \( -perm -0002 -a ! -perm -1000 \) 2>/dev/null | xargs -I '{}' chmod a+t '{}'

creator: system
detail_en: Disable Automounting

extraDetail.description: autofs允许自动挂载设备，通常包括CD/ dvd和USB驱动器。
extraDetail.rationale: 通过自动挂载功能，任何具有物理访问权限的人都可以连接USB驱动器或磁盘，并在系统中提供其内容，即使他们自己没有权限挂载它。
extraDetail.audit: # systemctl show "autofs. sh " 3 .执行以下命令，确认是否启用autofs。service" | grep -i unitfilestate=enabled不返回任何信息
extraDetail.remediation: 运行以下命令以屏蔽 autofs：# systemctl --now mask autofs 或运行以下命令以删除autofs # yum remove autofs 其他信息：  存在禁用服务的其他方法。请查阅您的发行版文档以了解适当的方法。  此控制应与组织中使用便携式驱动器和光盘媒体的容忍度保持一致。 o 在需要管理员手动安装媒体的服务器上，可以作为纵深防御的一部分，以降低引入未经批准的软件或信息或泄露专有软件或信息的风险。 o 如果管理员通常使用闪存驱动器并且服务器访问具有足够的物理控制，则需要手动安装可能不会增加安全性。
extraDetail.impact: 对于工作站用户来说，使用便携式硬盘驱动器是非常普遍的。如果您的组织允许在工作站上使用便携式存储或介质，并且对工作站上的物理访问控制被认为是足够的，那么关闭自动挂载几乎没有什么价值。
extraDetail.description_en: autofs allows automatic mounting of devices, typically including CD/DVDs and USB drives.
extraDetail.rationale_en: With automounting enabled anyone with physical access could attach a USB drive or disc and have its contents available in system even if they lacked permissions to mount it themselves.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify autofs is not enabled: # systemctl show "autofs.service" | grep -i unitfilestate=enabled  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to mask autofs: # systemctl --now mask autofs OR run the following command to remove autofs # yum remove autofs  Additional Information:  Additional methods of disabling a service exist. Consult your distribution documentation for appropriate methods.  This control should align with the tolerance of the use of portable drives and optical media in the organization.  o On a server requiring an admin to manually mount media can be part of defense-in-depth to reduce the risk of unapproved software or information being introduced or proprietary software or information being exfiltrated. o If admins commonly use flash drives and Server access has sufficient physical controls, requiring manual mounting may not increase security.
extraDetail.impact_en: The use of portable hard drives is very common for workstation users. If your organization allows the use of portable storage or media on workstations and physical access controls to workstations is considered adequate there is little value add in turning off automounting.

creator: system
detail_en: Disable USB Storage

extraDetail.description: USB存储提供了一种传输和存储文件的方法，确保文件的持久性和可用性与网络连接状态无关。它的普及和实用性导致基于usb的恶意软件成为一种简单而常见的网络渗透手段，也是在网络环境中建立持久威胁的第一步。
extraDetail.rationale: 限制系统上的 USB 访问将减少设备的物理攻击面并减少引入恶意软件的可能媒介。
extraDetail.audit: # modprobe -n -v usb-storage install /bin/true # lsmod | grep usb-storage <No output> .使用实例
extraDetail.remediation: 在 /etc/modprobe.d/ 目录下编辑或创建一个以 .conf 结尾的文件 示例：vim /etc/modprobe.d/usb_storage.conf 添加以下行： install usb-storage /bin/true 运行以下命令以卸载 usb-storage 模块：rmmod usb-storage 附加信息：  可以在 USBGuard 中找到禁用 usb-storage 模块的替代解决方案。  USBGuard 的使用和 USB 设备策略的构建应与站点策略保持一致。
extraDetail.description_en: USB storage provides a means to transfer and store files insuring persistence and availability of the files independent of network connection status. Its popularity and utility has led to USB-based malware being a simple and common means for network infiltration and a first step to establishing a persistent threat within a networked environment.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Restricting USB access on the system will decrease the physical attack surface for a device and diminish the possible vectors to introduce malware
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify the output is as indicated: # modprobe -n -v usb-storage  install /bin/true # lsmod | grep usb-storage  <No output>
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit or create a file in the /etc/modprobe.d/ directory ending in .conf Example: vim /etc/modprobe.d/usb_storage.conf Add the following line: install usb-storage /bin/true Run the following command to unload the usb-storage module: rmmod usb-storage  Additional Information:  An alternative solution to disabling the usb-storage module may be found in USBGuard.  Use of USBGuard and construction of USB device policies should be done in alignment with site policy.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure GPG keys are configured

extraDetail.description: 大多数包管理器都实现了GPG密钥签名，以在安装期间验证包的完整性。
extraDetail.rationale: 重要的是要确保更新是从有效来源获得的，以防止欺骗，这可能导致在系统上无意地安装恶意软件
extraDetail.audit: 验证为包管理器正确配置了GPG密钥。根据所使用的包管理，以下命令组之一可能提供所需的信息:# rpm -q gpg-pubkey——qf '%{name}-%{version}-%{release}——> %{summary}\n'
extraDetail.remediation: 根据站点策略更新包管理器GPG密钥。
extraDetail.description_en: Most packages managers implement GPG key signing to verify package integrity during installation.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is important to ensure that updates are obtained from a valid source to protect against spoofing that could lead to the inadvertent installation of malware on the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify GPG keys are configured correctly for your package manager. Depending on the package management in use one of the following command groups may provide the needed information: # rpm -q gpg-pubkey --qf '%{name}-%{version}-%{release} --> %{summary}\n'
extraDetail.remediation_en: Update your package manager GPG keys in accordance with site policy.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure package manager repositories are configured
detail_zh: 确保配置了包管理器存储库

extraDetail.description: 系统需要配置包管理器存储库，以确保它们接收到最新的补丁和更新。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果系统的包存储库配置错误，则可能无法识别重要补丁，或者恶意存储库可能引入受危害的软件
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令验证存储库配置是否正确
extraDetail.remediation: 根据站点策略配置包管理器存储库。
extraDetail.description_en: Systems need to have package manager repositories configured to ensure they receive the latest patches and updates.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If a system's package repositories are misconfigured important patches may not be identified or a rogue repository could introduce compromised software
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify repositories are configured correctly: # yum repolist
extraDetail.remediation_en: Configure your package manager repositories according to site policy.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure gpgcheck is globally activated

extraDetail.description: gpgcheck选项，在/etc/yum.conf和单独的/etc/yum/ rebs .d/*文件的主要部分。repo文件确定在安装之前是否检查了RPM包的签名。
extraDetail.rationale: 重要的是要确保在安装之前始终检查RPM的包签名，以确保该软件是从可信的来源获得的。# grep ^\s*gpgcheck /etc/ yumi .conf gpgcheck=1执行以下命令，检查gpgcheck的所有实例都设置为1:# grep -P '^\h*gpgcheck=[^1\n\r]+\b(\h+.*)?$' /etc/yum.conf /etc/yum.repos.d/*。补救措施:编辑/etc/yum.conf，在[main]部分设置'gpgcheck=1'。编辑/etc/yum.repos.d/*目录下任何失败的文件。回收并设置gpgcheck的所有实例为1。
extraDetail.audit: # grep ^\s*gpgcheck /etc/ yumn .conf gpgcheck=1执行以下命令，查看gpgcheck的所有实例都设置为1:# grep -P '^\h*gpgcheck=[^1\n\r]+\b(\h+.*)?$' /etc/yum.conf /etc/yum.repos.d/*。任何东西都不应该归还
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/yum.conf，在[main]部分设置'gpgcheck=1'。编辑/etc/yum.repos.d/*目录下任何失败的文件。回收并设置gpgcheck的所有实例为1。
extraDetail.description_en: The gpgcheck option, found in the main section of the /etc/yum.conf and individual /etc/yum/repos.d/*.repo files determines if an RPM package's signature is checked prior to its installation.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is important to ensure that an RPM's package signature is always checked prior to installation to ensure that the software is obtained from a trusted source
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify gpgcheck is set to 1: # grep ^\s*gpgcheck /etc/yum.conf  gpgcheck=1 Run the following command and verify that all instances of gpgcheck are set to 1: # grep -P '^\h*gpgcheck=[^1\n\r]+\b(\h+.*)?$' /etc/yum.conf /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit /etc/yum.conf and set 'gpgcheck=1' in the [main] section. Edit any failing files in /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo and set all instances of gpgcheck to 1.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure AIDE is installed

extraDetail.description: AIDE获取文件系统状态的快照，包括修改时间、权限和文件散列，然后可以使用这些快照与文件系统的当前状态进行比较，以检测对系统的修改。注意:预链接特性可能会干扰AIDE，因为它会改变二进制文件以加快它们的启动时间。运行prelink -ua将二进制文件恢复到预链接状态，从而避免AIDE的误报。
extraDetail.rationale: 通过监视文件系统状态，可以检测到受到损害的文件，以防止或限制意外或恶意错误配置或修改二进制文件的暴露。# rpm -q aide aide-<version>修复:执行以下命令安装aide。# yum install aide根据您的环境配置aide。有关选项，请参阅AIDE文档。初始化AIDE:执行如下命令:# AIDE——init # mv /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz 参考:1.单击“确定”。AIDE稳定手册:http://aide.sourceforge.net/stable/manual.html
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q aide aide-<version> .使用实例
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令安装AIDE: # yum install AIDE根据您的环境配置AIDE。有关选项，请参阅AIDE文档。初始化AIDE:执行如下命令:# AIDE——init # mv /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz 参考:1.单击“确定”。AIDE稳定手册:http://aide.sourceforge.net/stable/manual.html
extraDetail.description_en: AIDE takes a snapshot of filesystem state including modification times, permissions, and file hashes which can then be used to compare against the current state of the filesystem to detect modifications to the system. Note: The prelinking feature can interfere with AIDE because it alters binaries to speed up their start up times. Run prelink -ua to restore the binaries to their prelinked state, thus avoiding false positives from AIDE.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By monitoring the filesystem state compromised files can be detected to prevent or limit the exposure of accidental or malicious misconfigurations or modified binaries
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify aide is installed: # rpm -q aide  aide-<version>
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to install AIDE: # yum install aide  Configure AIDE as appropriate for your environment. Consult the AIDE documentation for options. Initialize AIDE: Run the following commands: # aide --init  # mv /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz  References: 1. AIDE stable manual: http://aide.sourceforge.net/stable/manual.html

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure filesystem integrity is regularly checked
detail_zh: 确保定期检查文件系统完整性

extraDetail.description: 需要定期检查文件系统的完整性，以检测文件系统的更改。
extraDetail.rationale: 定期文件检查允许系统管理员定期确定关键文件是否以未经授权的方式被更改
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下命令来验证计划运行aide检查的cron作业。# grep人队  '^([^#]+\ s +) ? (\ / usr \ / s ?本\ / | ^ \ s *)助手(\ .wrapper) ? \ s(——? \ s + \ s) *(-(检查|更新)| \ AIDEARGS美元)/etc/cron. \ b”* /etc/crontab /var/spool/cron/确保返回符合站点策略的cron作业。或者执行以下命令验证aidcheck. conf。服务和援助检查。定时器和aidcheck。定时器正在运行# systemctl -enabled aidecheck。systemctl -enabled aidecheck。定时器# systemctl状态aidecheck。timer
extraDetail.remediation: # crontab -u root -e在crontab中增加如下一行:0 5 * * * /usr/sbin/aide——check OR If aidecheck. shService和aidecheck。创建或编辑/etc/systemd/system/ aideccheck文件[Unit] Description=Aide Check [service] Type=simple ExecStart=/usr/sbin/ Aide——Check [Install] wanttedby =multi-user. sh . shtarget创建或编辑/etc/systemd/system/ aideccheck .文件[Unit] Description=Aide check every day at 5AM [timer] OnCalendar=*-*-* 05:00:00 Unit=aidecheck。service [Install] WantedBy=multi-user。target执行如下命令:# chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/ aideccheck .* # chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/ aideccheck* # systemctl daemon-reload # systemctl enable aidecheck。服务# systemctl—现在启用aidecheck。定时器参考:https://github.com/konstruktoid/hardening/blob/master/config/aidecheck.service 2。https://github.com/konstruktoid/hardening/blob/master/config/aidecheck.timer附加信息:本建议每天早上5点进行检查。根据网站政策调整检查的频率和时间。
extraDetail.description_en: Periodic checking of the filesystem integrity is needed to detect changes to the filesystem.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Periodic file checking allows the system administrator to determine on a regular basis if critical files have been changed in an unauthorized fashion
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands to verify a cron job scheduled to run the aide check. # grep -Ers '^([^#]+\s+)?(\/usr\/s?bin\/|^\s*)aide(\.wrapper)?\s(--?\S+\s)*(--(check|update)|\$AIDEARGS)\b' /etc/cron.* /etc/crontab /var/spool/cron/ Ensure a cron job in compliance with site policy is returned. OR run the following commands to verify that aidcheck.service and aidcheck.timer are enabled and aidcheck.timer is running # systemctl is-enabled aidecheck.service  # systemctl is-enabled aidecheck.timer # systemctl status aidecheck.timer
extraDetail.remediation_en: If cron will be used to schedule and run aide check Run the following command: # crontab -u root -e Add the following line to the crontab: 0 5 * * * /usr/sbin/aide --check OR if aidecheck.service and aidecheck.timer will be used to schedule and run aide check: Create or edit the file /etc/systemd/system/aidecheck.service and add the following lines: [Unit] Description=Aide Check  [Service] Type=simple ExecStart=/usr/sbin/aide --check  [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target Create or edit the file /etc/systemd/system/aidecheck.timer and add the following lines: [Unit] Description=Aide check every day at 5AM  [Timer] OnCalendar=*-*-* 05:00:00 Unit=aidecheck.service  [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target Run the following commands: # chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/aidecheck.* # chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/aidecheck.*  # systemctl daemon-reload  # systemctl enable aidecheck.service # systemctl --now enable aidecheck.timer  References: 1. https://github.com/konstruktoid/hardening/blob/master/config/aidecheck.service 2. https://github.com/konstruktoid/hardening/blob/master/config/aidecheck.timer Additional Information: The checking in this recommendation occurs every day at 5am. Alter the frequency and time of the checks in compliance with site policy.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure bootloader password is set
detail_zh: 确保设置了引导加载程序密码

extraDetail.description: 设置引导加载程序密码将要求任何重新引导系统的人在能够设置命令行引导参数之前必须输入密码
extraDetail.rationale: 在执行引导加载程序时要求输入引导密码将防止未经授权的用户输入引导参数或更改引导分区。这可以防止用户削弱安全性(例如，在启动时关闭SELinux)。
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本验证引导加载程序密码是否已设置:#!/bin/bash tst1="" tst2="" output="" efidir= "$ (find /boot/efi/ efi/ * -type d -not -name ' boot ') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') if [-f "$efidir"/grub.cfg];那么grubdir="$efidir" && grubfile="$efidir/grub.cfg" elif [-f "$gbdir"/grub.cfg];那么grubdir="$gbdir && grubfile="$gbdir/grub.cfg" fi userfile="$grubdir/user.cfg" [-f "$userfile"] && grep -Pq '^\h*GRUB2_PASSWORD\h*=\h*。+$' "$userfile" && output="
 PASSED: bootloader password set in "$userfile"

" if [-z "$output"] && [-f "$grubfile"];然后grep -Piq ' ^ \ h *设置\ h +超级\ h * = \ h *”?[^“r \ n \] +”? (\ h +, *) ?美元的“grubfile美元”& & tst1 =通过grep -Piq ' ^ \ h *密码\ h + h + \ \ h +。+$' "$grubfile" && tst2=pass ["$tst1" =pass] && ["$tst2" =pass] && output="

*** PASSED: bootloader password set in "$grubfile" ***

" fi [-n "$output"] && echo -e "$output" || echo -e "

*** FAILED: bootloader password is not set ***

"
extraDetail.remediation: 对于较新的基于 grub2 的系统（7.2 版及更高版本），使用 grub2-setpassword 创建加密密码：# grub2-setpassword 输入密码：<password> 确认密码：<password> 或对于较旧的基于 grub2 的系统，使用 grub2 创建加密密码-mkpasswd-pbkdf2: # grub2-mkpasswd-pbkdf2 Enter password: <password> Reenter password: <password> 你的 PBKDF2 是 <encrypted-password> 将以下内容添加到 /etc/grub.d/01_users 或自定义 /etc/grub .d 配置文件：cat <<EOF set superusers="<username>" password_pbkdf2 <username> <encrypted-password> EOF 注意：如果将信息放在自定义文件中，请不要包含 "cat << EOF" 和 "EOF" 行，因为内容是从这些文件中自动添加的  超级用户/用户信息和密码不应包含在 /etc/grub.d/00_header 文件中。这些信息可以放在任何 /etc/grub.d 文件中，只要该文件被合并到 grub.cfg 中即可。最好将此数据输入自定义文件，例如 /etc/grub.d/40_custom，这样在更新 Grub 包时不会覆盖它 运行以下命令更新 grub2 配置：# grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg 附加信息：旧方法也适用于 7.2 版和更新的系统 如果您的环境中使用了 LILO 或其他引导加载程序，则此建议是围绕 grub2 引导加载程序设计的。将 /boot/grub2/grub.cfg 替换为适合您环境的 grub 配置文件
extraDetail.impact:  如果启用了密码保护，只有指定的超级用户可以通过按 "e" 来编辑 Grub 2 菜单项或通过按 "c" 访问 GRUB 2 命令行  如果 GRUB 2 设置为自动启动受密码保护的菜单项 用户无法退出密码提示以选择另一个菜单项。在这种情况下，按住 SHIFT 键将不会显示菜单。用户必须输入正确的用户名和密码。如果不能，则必须通过 LiveCD 或其他方式编辑配置文件以解决问题  您可以将 --unrestricted 添加到菜单项以允许系统在不输入密码的情况下启动。编辑菜单项仍需要密码。
extraDetail.description_en: Setting the boot loader password will require that anyone rebooting the system must enter a password before being able to set command line boot parameters
extraDetail.rationale_en: Requiring a boot password upon execution of the boot loader will prevent an unauthorized user from entering boot parameters or changing the boot partition. This prevents users from weakening security (e.g. turning off SELinux at boot time).
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script to verify the bootloader password has been set: #!/bin/bash  tst1="" tst2="" output="" efidir=$(find /boot/efi/EFI/* -type d -not -name 'BOOT') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') if [ -f "$efidir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grubdir="$efidir" && grubfile="$efidir/grub.cfg" elif [ -f "$gbdir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grubdir="$gbdir" && grubfile="$gbdir/grub.cfg" fi userfile="$grubdir/user.cfg" [ -f "$userfile" ] && grep -Pq '^\h*GRUB2_PASSWORD\h*=\h*.+$' "$userfile" && output="
 PASSED: bootloader password set in "$userfile"

" if [ -z "$output" ] && [ -f "$grubfile" ]; then    grep -Piq '^\h*set\h+superusers\h*=\h*"?[^"
]+"?(\h+.*)?$' "$grubfile" && tst1=pass    grep -Piq '^\h*password\h+\H+\h+.+$' "$grubfile" && tst2=pass    [ "$tst1" = pass ] && [ "$tst2" = pass ] && output="

*** PASSED: bootloader password set in "$grubfile" ***

" fi [ -n "$output" ] && echo -e "$output" || echo -e "

 *** FAILED: bootloader password is not set ***

"
extraDetail.remediation_en: For newer grub2 based systems (Release 7.2 and newer), create an encrypted password with grub2-setpassword : # grub2-setpassword  Enter password: <password> Confirm password: <password> OR For older grub2 based systems, create an encrypted password with grub2-mkpasswd-pbkdf2: # grub2-mkpasswd-pbkdf2  Enter password: <password> Reenter password: <password>  Your PBKDF2 is <encrypted-password> Add the following into /etc/grub.d/01_users or a custom /etc/grub.d configuration file: cat <<EOF set superusers="<username>" password_pbkdf2 <username> <encrypted-password> EOF Note:   If placing the information in a custom file, do not include the "cat << EOF" and "EOF" lines as the content is automatically added from these files   The superuser/user information and password should not be contained in the /etc/grub.d/00_header file. The information can be placed in any /etc/grub.d file as long as that file is incorporated into grub.cfg. It is preferable to enter this data into a custom file, such as /etc/grub.d/40_custom, so it is not overwritten should the Grub package be updated Run the following command to update the grub2 configuration: # grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg  Additional Information: The older method will also work on Release 7.2 and newer systems This recommendation is designed around the grub2 bootloader, if LILO or another bootloader is in use in your environment enact equivalent settings. Replace /boot/grub2/grub.cfg with the appropriate grub configuration file for your environment
extraDetail.impact_en:  If password protection is enabled, only the designated superuser can edit a Grub 2 menu item by pressing "e" or access the GRUB 2 command line by pressing "c"  If GRUB 2 is set up to boot automatically to a password-protected menu entry the user has no option to back out of the password prompt to select another menu entry. Holding the SHIFT key will not display the menu in this case. The user must enter the correct username and password. If unable, the configuration files will have to be edited via the LiveCD or other means to fix the problem  You can add --unrestricted to the menu entries to allow the system to boot without entering a password. Password will still be required to edit menu items.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure permissions on bootloader config are configured
detail_zh: 确保已配置引导加载程序配置的权限

extraDetail.description: grub配置文件包含启动设置信息和解锁启动项的密码。grub2的配置通常是grub.cfg。在较新的grub2系统上，加密的引导加载程序密码包含在user.cfg中。如果系统使用UEFI，“/boot/efi”为vfat文件系统。vfat文件系统本身没有权限的概念，但是可以在Linux下以所需的任何权限挂载。
extraDetail.rationale: 为root设置读写权限只会阻止非root用户查看或更改引导参数。读取引导参数的非root用户可能能够在引导时识别安全性弱点，并能够利用它们
extraDetail.audit: 运行下面的脚本来验证grub.cfg的权限、所有权和组，如果存在user.cfg: #!/bin/bash tst1="" tst2="" tst3="" tst4="" test1="" test2="" efidir="" gbdir="" grubdir="" grubfile="" userfile="" efidir=" $(find /boot/efi/ efi/ * -type d -not -name ' boot ') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') for file in "$efidir"/grub.cfg "$efidir"/grub.conf;Do [-f "$file"] && grubdir="$efidir" && grubfile=$file done if [-z "$grubdir"];然后在"$gbdir"/grub.cfg "$gbdir"/grub.conf;做        [ - f“文件”美元)& & grubdir = " $ gbdir " & & grubfile = $文件做fi userfile = " $ grubdir / user.cfg”stat - c " % " " $ grubfile " | grep pq ' ^ \ h *(鹿)00美元的& & tst1 =通过输出=“权限\”grubfile \“\”美元(stat - c " % " " $ grubfile ") \”“stat - c“% u: % g”“grubfile美元”| grep pq的^ \ h * 0时$ & & tst2 =通过output2 =“\”grubfile \”是属于\“美元(stat - c“% u”“grubfile美元”)\”,属于集团\“$ (stat - c“% g”“grubfile美元 ")\"" [ "$ tst1”=通过  ] && [ "$ tst2”=]& & test1 =传球如果[- f“userfile美元”];然后stat - c " % " " $ userfile " | grep pq ' ^ \ h *(鹿)00美元的& & tst3 =通过output3 =“权限\”userfile \“\”美元(stat - c " % " " $ userfile ") \”“stat - c“% u: % g”“userfile美元”| grep pq的^ \ h * 0时$ & & tst4 =通过output4 =“\”userfile \”是属于\“美元(stat - c“% u”“userfile美元”)\”,属于集团\“$ (stat - c“% g”“userfile美元 ")\""    [ "$ tst3”=通过  ] && [ "$ 其他tst4”=]& & test2 =传球test2 = fi [" $ test1 " =传球  ] && [ "$ test2”=通过]& & = true #如果传递是真的如果["$passing" = true]，则传递;然后echo "PASSED:" echo "$output" echo "$output2" [-n "$output3"] && echo "$output3" [-n "$output4"] && echo "$output4" else #打印我们失败的原因echo "FAILED:" echo "$output" echo "$output2" [-n "$output3"] && echo "$output3" [-n "$output4"] && echo "$output4" fi
extraDetail.remediation: 运行以下命令以设置 grub 配置文件的所有权和权限： # chown root:root /boot/grub2/grub.cfg # test -f /boot/grub2/user.cfg && chown root:root /boot /grub2/user.cfg # chmod og-rwx /boot/grub2/grub.cfg # test -f /boot/grub2/user.cfg && chmod og-rwx /boot/grub2/user.cfg 或者如果系统使用 UEFI ，编辑 /etc/fstab 并添加 fmask=0077 选项：示例：<device> /boot/efi vfat defaults,umask=0027,fmask=0077,uid=0,gid=0 0 0 注意：这可能需要重新-boot 以启用更改 附加信息：  此建议是围绕 grub2 引导加载程序设计的。  如果 LILO 或其他引导加载程序正在您的环境中使用： o 制定等效设置 o 将 /boot/grub2/grub.cfg 和 /boot/grub2/user.cfg 替换为适合您环境的引导配置文件
extraDetail.description_en: The grub configuration file contains information on boot settings and passwords for unlocking boot options. The grub2 configuration is usually grub.cfg. On newer grub2 systems the encrypted bootloader password is contained in user.cfg. If the system uses UEFI, /boot/efi is a vfat filesystem. The vfat filesystem itself doesn't have the concept of permissions but can be mounted under Linux with whatever permissions desired.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting the permissions to read and write for root only prevents non-root users from seeing the boot parameters or changing them. Non-root users who read the boot parameters may be able to identify weaknesses in security upon boot and be able to exploit them
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following script to verify correct permissions, ownership, and group for grub.cfg and if it exists, user.cfg: #!/bin/bash  tst1="" tst2="" tst3="" tst4="" test1="" test2="" efidir="" gbdir="" grubdir="" grubfile="" userfile="" efidir=$(find /boot/efi/EFI/* -type d -not -name 'BOOT') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') for file in "$efidir"/grub.cfg "$efidir"/grub.conf; do    [ -f "$file" ] && grubdir="$efidir" && grubfile=$file done if [ -z "$grubdir" ]; then    for file in "$gbdir"/grub.cfg "$gbdir"/grub.conf; do       [ -f "$file" ] && grubdir="$gbdir" && grubfile=$file    done fi userfile="$grubdir/user.cfg" stat -c "%a" "$grubfile" | grep -Pq '^\h*[0-7]00$' && tst1=pass output="Permissions on \"$grubfile\" are \"$(stat -c "%a" "$grubfile")\"" stat -c "%u:%g" "$grubfile" | grep -Pq '^\h*0:0$' && tst2=pass output2="\"$grubfile\" is owned by \"$(stat -c "%U" "$grubfile")\" and belongs to group \"$(stat -c "%G" "$grubfile")\"" [ "$tst1" = pass ] && [ "$tst2" = pass ] && test1=pass if [ -f "$userfile" ]; then    stat -c "%a" "$userfile" | grep -Pq '^\h*[0-7]00$' && tst3=pass    output3="Permissions on \"$userfile\" are \"$(stat -c "%a" "$userfile")\""    stat -c "%u:%g" "$userfile" | grep -Pq '^\h*0:0$' && tst4=pass    output4="\"$userfile\" is owned by \"$(stat -c "%U" "$userfile")\" and belongs to group \"$(stat -c "%G" "$userfile")\""    [ "$tst3" = pass ] && [ "$tst4" = pass ] && test2=pass else    test2=pass fi [ "$test1" = pass ] && [ "$test2" = pass ] && passing=true # If passing is true we pass if [ "$passing" = true ] ; then    echo "PASSED:"    echo "$output"    echo "$output2"    [ -n "$output3" ] && echo "$output3"    [ -n "$output4" ] && echo "$output4" else    # print the reason why we are failing    echo "FAILED:"    echo "$output"    echo "$output2"    [ -n "$output3" ] && echo "$output3"    [ -n "$output4" ] && echo "$output4" fi
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following commands to set ownership and permissions on your grub configuration file(s): # chown root:root /boot/grub2/grub.cfg # test -f /boot/grub2/user.cfg && chown root:root /boot/grub2/user.cfg # chmod og-rwx /boot/grub2/grub.cfg # test -f /boot/grub2/user.cfg && chmod og-rwx /boot/grub2/user.cfg OR If the system uses UEFI, edit /etc/fstab and add the fmask=0077 option: Example: <device> /boot/efi vfat defaults,umask=0027,fmask=0077,uid=0,gid=0 0 0 Note: This may require a re-boot to enable the change Additional Information:  This recommendation is designed around the grub2 bootloader.  If LILO or another bootloader is in use in your environment:  o Enact equivalent settings o Replace /boot/grub2/grub.cfg and /boot/grub2/user.cfg with the appropriate boot configuration files for your environment

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure authentication required for single user mode
detail_zh: 确保单用户模式需要身份验证

extraDetail.description: 单用户模式(救援模式)用于在引导过程中系统检测到问题或通过从引导加载程序手动选择时进行恢复。注意:systemctl选项——fail等同于——job-mode=fail。使用任何一种都是可以接受的。
extraDetail.rationale: 要求在单用户模式(救援模式)下进行身份验证，可以防止未经授权的用户在没有凭证的情况下将系统重新引导为单用户以获得根权限。# grep /sbin/sulogin /usr/lib/systemd/system/rescue. . 5执行以下命令，查看是否使用了/sbin/sulogin或/usr/sbin/suloginservice ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin;/usr/bin/systemctl——fail——no-block default“# grep /sbin/sulogin /usr/lib/systemd/system/emergency.”service ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin;/usr/bin/systemctl——fail——no-block default"修复:编辑/usr/lib/systemd/system/rescue.Service和/usr/lib/systemd/system/emergency。ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin;/usr/bin/systemctl——fail——no-block default"
extraDetail.audit: # grep /sbin/sulogin /usr/lib/systemd/system/rescue. . 5执行以下命令，查看是否使用/sbin/sulogin或/usr/sbin/suloginservice ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin;/usr/bin/systemctl——fail——no-block default“# grep /sbin/sulogin /usr/lib/systemd/system/emergency.”service ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin;/usr/bin/systemctl——fail——no-block default"
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/usr/lib/systemd/system/rescue.Service和/usr/lib/systemd/system/emergency。ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin;/usr/bin/systemctl——fail——no-block default"
extraDetail.description_en: Single user mode (rescue mode) is used for recovery when the system detects an issue during boot or by manual selection from the bootloader. Note: The systemctl option --fail is synonymous with --job-mode=fail. Using either is acceptable.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Requiring authentication in single user mode (rescue mode) prevents an unauthorized user from rebooting the system into single user to gain root privileges without credentials
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify that /sbin/sulogin or /usr/sbin/sulogin is used as shown: # grep /sbin/sulogin /usr/lib/systemd/system/rescue.service  ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin; /usr/bin/systemctl --fail --no-block default" # grep /sbin/sulogin /usr/lib/systemd/system/emergency.service  ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin; /usr/bin/systemctl --fail --no-block default"
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit /usr/lib/systemd/system/rescue.service and /usr/lib/systemd/system/emergency.service and set ExecStart to use /sbin/sulogin or /usr/sbin/sulogin: ExecStart=-/bin/sh -c "/sbin/sulogin; /usr/bin/systemctl --fail --no-block default"

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure core dumps are restricted
detail_zh: 确保核心转储受到限制

extraDetail.description: 核心转储是可执行程序的内存。它通常用于确定程序中止的原因。它还可以用于从核心文件中收集机密信息。系统提供了为核心转储设置软限制的功能，但用户可以覆盖这一功能。
extraDetail.rationale: 对核心转储设置硬限制可以防止用户覆盖软变量。如果需要内核转储，请考虑为用户组设置限制(参见limits.conf(5))。此外，设置fs. conf文件。Suid_dumpable变量设为0将阻止setuid程序转储core
extraDetail.audit: # grep -E "^\s*\* s+hard\s+core" /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.confD /* * hard core 0 # sysctl fs。suid_dumpable fs。Suid_dumpable = 0 # grep "fs\。Suid_dumpable " /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.conf "d / * fs。suid_dumpable = 0执行以下命令，查看是否安装了systemd-coredump。service如果返回enabled或disabled，则安装systemd-coredump
extraDetail.remediation: 在/etc/security/limits.conf或/etc/security/limits.conf中添加以下行d/*文件:* hard core 0在/etc/sysctl.conf或/etc/sysctl.conf文件中设置以下参数。D /*文件:fs。suid_dumpable = 0执行以下命令，设置主内核参数。suid_dumpable=0如果安装了systemd-coredump，请编辑/etc/systemd/coredump.conf，增加/修改以下行:Storage=none ProcessSizeMax=0执行命令:systemctl daemon-reload . sh
extraDetail.description_en: A core dump is the memory of an executable program. It is generally used to determine why a program aborted. It can also be used to glean confidential information from a core file. The system provides the ability to set a soft limit for core dumps, but this can be overridden by the user.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting a hard limit on core dumps prevents users from overriding the soft variable. If core dumps are required, consider setting limits for user groups (see limits.conf(5) ). In addition, setting the fs.suid_dumpable variable to 0 will prevent setuid programs from dumping core
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify output matches: # grep -E "^\s*\*\s+hard\s+core" /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d/*  * hard core 0 # sysctl fs.suid_dumpable  fs.suid_dumpable = 0 # grep "fs\.suid_dumpable" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*  fs.suid_dumpable = 0 Run the following command to check if systemd-coredump is installed: # systemctl is-enabled coredump.service If enabled or disabled is returned systemd-coredump is installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add the following line to /etc/security/limits.conf or a /etc/security/limits.d/* file: * hard core 0 Set the following parameter in /etc/sysctl.conf or a /etc/sysctl.d/* file: fs.suid_dumpable = 0 Run the following command to set the active kernel parameter: # sysctl -w fs.suid_dumpable=0 If systemd-coredump is installed: edit /etc/systemd/coredump.conf and add/modify the following lines: Storage=none ProcessSizeMax=0 Run the command: systemctl daemon-reload

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure XD/NX support is enabled

extraDetail.description: x86家族中的最新处理器支持在每个内存页的基础上阻止代码执行的能力。一般来说，在AMD处理器上，这种能力被称为No Execute (NX)，而在Intel处理器上，它被称为Execute Disable (XD)。此功能有助于防止利用缓冲区溢出漏洞，应在任何可能的情况下激活。必须采取额外的步骤来确保启用这种保护，特别是在32位x86系统上。其他处理器，如Itanium和POWER，从一开始就包含了这种支持，这些平台的标准内核也支持该特性。
extraDetail.rationale: 启用任何可以防止缓冲区溢出攻击的特性都可以增强系统的安全性。注意:在执行此建议之前，请确保您的系统支持XD或NX位并具有PAE支持，因为如果您的硬件不支持这些位，这可能会阻止系统启动
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下命令并验证内核已经识别并激活了NX/XD保护。# journalctl | grep 'protection: active' kernel: NX (Execute Disable) protection: active OR on systems without journalctl: # [-n $(grep noexec[0-9]*=off /proc/cmdline) || -z $(grep -E -i ' (pae| NX)' /proc/cpuinfo) || -n $(grep '\sNX\s.)*\s Protection:\s' /var/log/dmesg | grep -v active)]] && echo "NX Protection is not active"不应返回任何内容
extraDetail.remediation: 在32位系统上安装具有PAE支持的内核，在64位系统上不需要安装:如果需要，配置引导加载程序以加载新内核并重新启动系统。你可能需要在你的bios中启用NX或XD支持。
extraDetail.description_en: Recent processors in the x86 family support the ability to prevent code execution on a per memory page basis. Generically and on AMD processors, this ability is called No Execute (NX), while on Intel processors it is called Execute Disable (XD). This ability can help prevent exploitation of buffer overflow vulnerabilities and should be activated whenever possible. Extra steps must be taken to ensure that this protection is enabled, particularly on 32-bit x86 systems. Other processors, such as Itanium and POWER, have included such support since inception and the standard kernel for those platforms supports the feature.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Enabling any feature that can protect against buffer overflow attacks enhances the security of the system. Note: Ensure your system supports the XD or NX bit and has PAE support before implementing this recommendation as this may prevent it from booting if these are not supported by your hardware
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify your kernel has identified and activated NX/XD protection. # journalctl | grep 'protection: active'  kernel: NX (Execute Disable) protection: active OR on systems without journalctl: # [[ -n $(grep noexec[0-9]*=off /proc/cmdline) || -z $(grep -E -i ' (pae|nx) ' /proc/cpuinfo) || -n $(grep '\sNX\s.*\sprotection:\s' /var/log/dmesg | grep -v active) ]] && echo "NX Protection is not active"  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: On 32 bit systems install a kernel with PAE support, no installation is required on 64 bit systems: If necessary configure your bootloader to load the new kernel and reboot the system. You may need to enable NX or XD support in your bios.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure address space layout randomization (ASLR) is enabled
detail_zh: 确保启用了地址空间布局随机化(ASLR)

extraDetail.description: 地址空间布局随机化(ASLR)是一种随机安排进程关键数据区域的地址空间的漏洞缓解技术。
extraDetail.rationale: 随机放置虚拟内存区域将使编写内存页攻击变得困难，因为内存位置将不断移动
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，验证输出是否匹配。randomize_va_space内核。Randomize_va_space = 2 # grep "kernel\。Randomize_va_space " /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.conf "d / *内核。Randomize_va_space = 2
extraDetail.remediation: 在/etc/sysctl.conf或/etc/sysctl.conf文件中设置以下参数。D /*文件:内核。randomize_va_space = 2执行以下命令，设置活动内核参数。randomize_va_space=2
extraDetail.description_en: Address space layout randomization (ASLR) is an exploit mitigation technique which randomly arranges the address space of key data areas of a process.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Randomly placing virtual memory regions will make it difficult to write memory page exploits as the memory placement will be consistently shifting
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify output matches: # sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space  kernel.randomize_va_space = 2 # grep "kernel\.randomize_va_space" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*  kernel.randomize_va_space = 2
extraDetail.remediation_en: Set the following parameter in /etc/sysctl.conf or a /etc/sysctl.d/* file: kernel.randomize_va_space = 2 Run the following command to set the active kernel parameter: # sysctl -w kernel.randomize_va_space=2

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure prelink is not installed

extraDetail.description: prelink是一个修改ELF共享库和ELF动态链接二进制文件的程序，以这种方式使动态链接器在启动时执行重定位所需的时间显著减少。
extraDetail.rationale: 预链接特性可能会干扰AIDE的操作，因为它会更改二进制文件。如果恶意用户能够破坏公共库(如libc)，预链接还会增加系统的脆弱性
extraDetail.audit: 检查预链接是否安装。执行如下命令:# rpm -q prelink package prelink is not installed
extraDetail.remediation: # prelink -ua执行以下命令，卸载prelink。# yum remove prelink
extraDetail.description_en: prelink is a program that modifies ELF shared libraries and ELF dynamically linked binaries in such a way that the time needed for the dynamic linker to perform relocations at startup significantly decreases.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The prelinking feature can interfere with the operation of AIDE, because it changes binaries. Prelinking can also increase the vulnerability of the system if a malicious user is able to compromise a common library such as libc
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify prelink is not installed. Run the following command: # rpm -q prelink  package prelink is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to restore binaries to normal: # prelink -ua Run the following command to uninstall prelink: # yum remove prelink

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure SELinux is installed

extraDetail.description: SELinux提供强制访问控制。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果没有安装强制访问控制系统，只能使用默认的自由访问控制系统
extraDetail.audit: 检查SELinux是否已安装。# rpm -q libselinux libselinux-<version> .执行以下命令
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令安装SELinux。# yum install libselinux
extraDetail.description_en: SELinux provides Mandatory Access Control.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Without a Mandatory Access Control system installed only the default Discretionary Access Control system will be available
