extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to install SELinux: # yum install libselinux

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure SELinux is not disabled in bootloader configuration
detail_zh: 确保在引导加载程序配置中没有禁用SELinux

extraDetail.description: 将SELINUX配置为在引导时启用，并验证它没有被grub引导参数覆盖。注意:此建议是围绕grub 2引导加载程序设计的，如果在您的环境中正在使用LILO或其他引导加载程序，则制定等效设置。
extraDetail.rationale: 在grub配置中，必须在引导时启用SELinux，以确保它提供的控件不会被覆盖
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下脚本，验证没有linux行设置selinux=0或强制=0参数:#!/bin/bash # IF检查通过返回PASSED efidir=$(find /boot/efi/ efi/ * -type d -not -name ' boot ') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') IF [-f "$efidir"/grub.cfg];然后grep "^\s*linux" "$efidir"/grub.cfg | grep -Eq "(selinux=0|强制=0)"& &回声“失败 : \"$()\" 存在“| |回声”通过“elif [- f / grub.cfg]“gbdir美元”;然后grep "^\s*linux" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg | grep -Eq "(selinux=0|强制=0)"&& echo "FAILED: \"$()\" exists" || echo "PASSED" else echo "FAILED" fi
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/default/grub，从所有CMDLINE_LINUX参数中删除所有selinux=0和enforce =0的实例。GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet" GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=""执行以下命令更新grub2配置
extraDetail.description_en: Configure SELINUX to be enabled at boot time and verify that it has not been overwritten by the grub boot parameters. Note: This recommendation is designed around the grub 2 bootloader, if LILO or another bootloader is in use in your environment enact equivalent settings.
extraDetail.rationale_en: SELinux must be enabled at boot time in your grub configuration to ensure that the controls it provides are not overridden
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following script to verify that no linux line has the selinux=0 or enforcing=0 parameters set: #!/bin/bash  # IF check passes return PASSED efidir=$(find /boot/efi/EFI/* -type d -not -name 'BOOT') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') if [ -f "$efidir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grep "^\s*linux" "$efidir"/grub.cfg | grep -Eq "(selinux=0|enforcing=0)" && echo "FAILED: \"$()\" exists" || echo "PASSED" elif [ -f "$gbdir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grep "^\s*linux" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg | grep -Eq "(selinux=0|enforcing=0)" && echo "FAILED: \"$()\" exists" || echo "PASSED" else    echo "FAILED" fi
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit /etc/default/grub and remove all instances of selinux=0 and enforcing=0 from all CMDLINE_LINUX parameters: GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet"  GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="" Run the following command to update the grub2 configuration: # grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure SELinux policy is configured

extraDetail.description: 配置SELinux以满足或超过默认的目标策略，该策略仅约束守护进程和系统软件。注意:如果您的组织需要更严格的策略，请确保在/etc/selinux/config文件中设置了这些策略。
extraDetail.rationale: 安全配置要求因局点而异。有些网站可能强制执行比默认策略更严格的策略，这是完全可以接受的。该项目旨在确保至少满足默认建议
extraDetail.audit: # grep SELINUXTYPE= /etc/selinux/config SELINUXTYPE=targeted # sestatus | grep 'Loaded policy'加载的策略名称:targeted
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/selinux/config文件，设置SELINUXTYPE参数:SELINUXTYPE=targeted
extraDetail.description_en: Configure SELinux to meet or exceed the default targeted policy, which constrains daemons and system software only. Note: If your organization requires stricter policies, ensure that they are set in the /etc/selinux/config file.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Security configuration requirements vary from site to site. Some sites may mandate a policy that is stricter than the default policy, which is perfectly acceptable. This item is intended to ensure that at least the default recommendations are met
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and ensure output matches either " targeted " or " mls ": # grep SELINUXTYPE= /etc/selinux/config  SELINUXTYPE=targeted # sestatus | grep 'Loaded policy'  Loaded policy name:             targeted
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the /etc/selinux/config file to set the SELINUXTYPE parameter: SELINUXTYPE=targeted

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure the SELinux mode is enforcing or permissive
detail_zh: 确保SELinux模式是强制的或允许的

extraDetail.description:
SELinux可以以三种模式之一运行:禁用、允许或强制:
强制——默认和推荐的操作模式;在强制模式下SELinux正常运行，在整个系统上强制加载安全策略。
允许的——系统就像SELinux在强制执行所加载的安全策略一样，包括在日志中标记对象和发出拒绝访问的条目，但它实际上并不拒绝任何操作。虽然不建议在生产系统中使用，但允许模式对SELinux策略开发很有帮助。
残疾——强烈劝阻;系统不仅避免强制执行SELinux策略，还避免标记任何持久化对象(如文件)，从而使将来难以启用SELinux
注意:当系统运行在强制模式时，您可以将个别域设置为允许模式。例如，要使httpd_t域允许:
semanage permissive -a httpd_t
extraDetail.rationale: 强烈建议在禁用模式下运行SELinux;系统不仅避免强制执行SELinux策略，还避免标记任何持久化对象(如文件)，从而使将来难以启用SELinux
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，确保输出匹配:
执行以下命令验证SELinux当前模式:
getenforce
Enforcing -OR- Permissive
执行以下命令验证SELinux的配置模式:
grep - ei '^\s* SELinux =(enforce | Permissive)' /etc/selinux/config
SELINUX=enforcing -OR- SELINUX=permissive
extraDetail.remediation:
运行如下命令设置SELinux的运行模式:
设置SELinux模式为Enforcing:
setenforce 1
或者设置SELinux模式为Permissive
:setenforce 0
编辑/etc/selinux/config文件设置SELINUX参数:
:SELINUX=enforcing或者SELinux=permissive
extraDetail.description_en: SELinux can run in one of three modes: disabled, permissive, or enforcing:  Enforcing - Is the default, and recommended, mode of operation; in enforcing mode SELinux operates normally, enforcing the loaded security policy on the entire system.  Permissive - The system acts as if SELinux is enforcing the loaded security policy, including labeling objects and emitting access denial entries in the logs, but it does not actually deny any operations. While not recommended for production systems, permissive mode can be helpful for SELinux policy development.  Disabled - Is strongly discouraged; not only does the system avoid enforcing the SELinux policy, it also avoids labeling any persistent objects such as files, making it difficult to enable SELinux in the future Note: you can set individual domains to permissive mode while the system runs in enforcing mode. For example, to make the httpd_t domain permissive: # semanage permissive -a httpd_t
extraDetail.rationale_en: Running SELinux in disabled mode is strongly discouraged; not only does the system avoid enforcing the SELinux policy, it also avoids labeling any persistent objects such as files, making it difficult to enable SELinux in the future
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and ensure output matches: Run the following command to verify SELinux's current mode: # getenforce  Enforcing -OR- Permissive Run the following command to verify SELinux's configured mode: # grep -Ei '^\s*SELINUX=(enforcing|permissive)' /etc/selinux/config  SELINUX=enforcing -OR- SELINUX=permissive
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run one of the following commands to set SELinux's running mode: To set SELinux mode to Enforcing: # setenforce 1 OR To set SELinux mode to Permissive: # setenforce 0 Edit the /etc/selinux/config file to set the SELINUX parameter: For Enforcing mode: SELINUX=enforcing OR For Permissive mode: SELINUX=permissive References: 1. https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_enterprise_linux/7/html/selinux_users_and_administrators_guide/sect-security-enhanced_linux-introduction-selinux_modes

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure the SELinux mode is enforcing

extraDetail.description: SELinux 可以以三种模式之一运行：禁用、宽容或强制：  强制 - 是默认和推荐的操作模式；在强制模式下，SELinux 正常运行，在整个系统上强制执行加载的安全策略。  许可 - 系统表现得好像 SELinux 正在执行加载的安全策略，包括标记对象和在日志中发出访问拒绝条目，但它实际上并不拒绝任何操作。虽然不推荐用于生产系统，但许可模式可能有助于 SELinux 策略开发。  残疾人——强烈反对；系统不仅避免强制执行 SELinux 策略，还避免标记任何持久对象（例如文件），从而使将来难以启用 SELinux 注意：您可以在系统以强制模式运行时将个别域设置为许可模式。例如，要使 httpd_t 域具有许可性：# semanage permissive -a httpd_t
extraDetail.rationale: 在禁用模式下运行SELinux，系统不仅可以避免强制执行SELinux策略，还可以避免标记任何持久化对象(例如文件)，从而使将来难以启用SELinux。以允许模式运行SELinux虽然有助于制定SELinux策略，但它只记录拒绝访问的条目，而不拒绝任何操作。# grep -i SELinux = enforce /etc/selinux/config SELinux = enforce修复:执行以下命令，设置SELinux的运行模式。# setenforce 1编辑/etc/selinux/config文件，设置SELinux参数。https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_enterprise_linux/7/html/selinux_users_and_administrators_guide/sect-security-enhanced_linux-introduction-selinux_modes
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，确保输出结果匹配:执行以下命令，查看SELinux当前模式:# getenforce enforcement查看SELinux配置模式:# grep -i SELinux = enforcement /etc/selinux/config SELinux = enforcement . config执行以下命令，查看SELinux配置模式
extraDetail.remediation: # setenforce 1编辑/etc/selinux/config文件，设置SELinux参数。https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_enterprise_linux/7/html/selinux_users_and_administrators_guide/sect-security-enhanced_linux-introduction-selinux_modes
extraDetail.description_en: SELinux can run in one of three modes: disabled, permissive, or enforcing:  Enforcing - Is the default, and recommended, mode of operation; in enforcing mode SELinux operates normally, enforcing the loaded security policy on the entire system.  Permissive - The system acts as if SELinux is enforcing the loaded security policy, including labeling objects and emitting access denial entries in the logs, but it does not actually deny any operations. While not recommended for production systems, permissive mode can be helpful for SELinux policy development.  Disabled - Is strongly discouraged; not only does the system avoid enforcing the SELinux policy, it also avoids labeling any persistent objects such as files, making it difficult to enable SELinux in the future Note: you can set individual domains to permissive mode while the system runs in enforcing mode. For example, to make the httpd_t domain permissive: # semanage permissive -a httpd_t
extraDetail.rationale_en: Running SELinux in disabled mode the system not only avoids enforcing the SELinux policy, it also avoids labeling any persistent objects such as files, making it difficult to enable SELinux in the future. Running SELinux in Permissive mode, though helpful for developing SELinux policy, only logs access denial entries, but does not deny any operations
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and ensure output matches: Run the following command to verify SELinux's current mode: # getenforce  Enforcing Run the following command to verify SELinux's configured mode: # grep -i SELINUX=enforcing /etc/selinux/config  SELINUX=enforcing
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to set SELinux's running mode: # setenforce 1 Edit the /etc/selinux/config file to set the SELINUX parameter: For Enforcing mode: SELINUX=enforcing References: 1. https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_enterprise_linux/7/html/selinux_users_and_administrators_guide/sect-security-enhanced_linux-introduction-selinux_modes

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure no unconfined services exist
detail_zh: 确保不存在不受限制的服务

extraDetail.description: 注:偶尔某些守护进程(如备份或集中管理软件)可能需要无限制运行。任何这样的软件都应该在例外情况出现之前仔细分析和记录。
extraDetail.rationale: 对于不受限制的进程，将应用SELinux策略规则，但是存在允许运行在不受限制域中的进程几乎所有访问的策略规则。在不受限制的域中运行的进程退回到只使用DAC规则。如果一个不受限制的进程受到威胁，SELinux不会阻止攻击者获得对系统资源和数据的访问权，但是当然，DAC规则仍然会被使用。SELinux是在DAC规则之上的一种安全增强——它并没有取代DAC规则
extraDetail.audit: # ps -eZ | grep unconfined_service_t . sh执行以下命令，确认无输出
extraDetail.remediation: 调查在审核过程中发现的任何不受限过程。它们可能需要有分配给它们的现有安全上下文或为它们构建的策略。
extraDetail.description_en: Unconfined processes run in unconfined domains Note: Occasionally certain daemons such as backup or centralized management software may require running unconfined. Any such software should be carefully analyzed and documented before such an exception is made.
extraDetail.rationale_en: For unconfined processes, SELinux policy rules are applied, but policy rules exist that allow processes running in unconfined domains almost all access. Processes running in unconfined domains fall back to using DAC rules exclusively. If an unconfined process is compromised, SELinux does not prevent an attacker from gaining access to system resources and data, but of course, DAC rules are still used. SELinux is a security enhancement on top of DAC rules – it does not replace them
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify not output is produced: # ps -eZ | grep unconfined_service_t
extraDetail.remediation_en: Investigate any unconfined processes found during the audit action. They may need to have an existing security context assigned to them or a policy built for them.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure SETroubleshoot is not installed

extraDetail.description: setroubleshooting服务通过用户友好的界面通知桌面用户SELinux拒绝。该服务提供有关配置错误、未经授权的入侵和其他潜在错误的重要信息。
extraDetail.rationale: setroubleshooting服务是在服务器上运行的一个不必要的守护进程，特别是在禁用X Windows的情况下
extraDetail.audit: 检查是否安装setroubleshooting。执行以下命令:# rpm -q setroubleshooting package setroubleshooting未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令卸载setroubleshooting。# yum remove setroubleshooting
extraDetail.description_en: The SETroubleshoot service notifies desktop users of SELinux denials through a user-friendly interface. The service provides important information around configuration errors, unauthorized intrusions, and other potential errors.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The SETroubleshoot service is an unnecessary daemon to have running on a server, especially if X Windows is disabled
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify setroubleshoot is not installed. Run the following command: # rpm -q setroubleshoot  package setroubleshoot is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to Uninstall setroubleshoot: # yum remove setroubleshoot

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure the MCS Translation Service (mcstrans) is not installed
detail_zh: 确保没有安装MCS翻译服务(mcstrans)

extraDetail.description: mcstransd守护进程向请求信息的客户机进程提供类别标签信息。标签转换定义在/etc/selinux/ targets /setrans.conf中
extraDetail.rationale: 由于此服务不经常使用，请删除它以减少系统上运行的潜在易受攻击代码的数量
extraDetail.audit: 验证mcstrans是否安装。执行如下命令:# rpm -q mcstrans package mcstrans未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令卸载mcstrans。# yum remove mcstrans
extraDetail.description_en: The mcstransd daemon provides category label information to client processes requesting information. The label translations are defined in /etc/selinux/targeted/setrans.conf
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since this service is not used very often, remove it to reduce the amount of potentially vulnerable code running on the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify mcstrans is not installed. Run the following command: # rpm -q mcstrans  package mcstrans is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to uninstall mcstrans: # yum remove mcstrans

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure message of the day is configured properly
detail_zh: 确保每日信息配置正确

extraDetail.description: /etc/motd文件的内容将在登录后显示给用户，并作为经过认证的用户的每日消息。基于unix的系统通常在登录系统时显示有关操作系统版本和补丁级别的信息。这些信息对于为特定操作系统平台开发软件的开发人员非常有用。如果mingetty(8)支持以下选项，则显示操作系统信息:\m -机器架构\r -操作系统版本\s -操作系统名称\v -操作系统版本
extraDetail.rationale: 警告消息通知试图登录系统的用户关于系统的合法状态，并且必须包括拥有系统的组织的名称和任何已启用的监视策略。在登录栏中显示操作系统和补丁级别的信息也有副作用，即为试图针对系统的特定漏洞的攻击者提供详细的系统信息。授权用户登录后可以通过运行“uname -a”命令轻松获得这些信息
extraDetail.audit: # cat /etc/motd执行以下命令，确认无返回结果。# grep -E -i "(\\\v|\\\ \r|\\\ \m|\\\s|$(grep '^ID=' /etc/os-release | cut -d= -f2 | sed -E 's/"//g') "/etc/motd
extraDetail.remediation: 根据您的站点策略编辑/etc/motd文件，删除\m， \r， \s， \v的任何实例或对操作系统平台的引用，或者如果motd不使用，则可以删除此文件。执行以下命令，删除motd文件
extraDetail.description_en: The contents of the /etc/motd file are displayed to users after login and function as a message of the day for authenticated users. Unix-based systems have typically displayed information about the OS release and patch level upon logging in to the system. This information can be useful to developers who are developing software for a particular OS platform. If mingetty(8) supports the following options, they display operating system information: \m - machine architecture \r - operating system release \s - operating system name \v - operating system version
extraDetail.rationale_en: Warning messages inform users who are attempting to login to the system of their legal status regarding the system and must include the name of the organization that owns the system and any monitoring policies that are in place. Displaying OS and patch level information in login banners also has the side effect of providing detailed system information to attackers attempting to target specific exploits of a system. Authorized users can easily get this information by running the " uname -a " command once they have logged in

extraDetail.rationale: 如果不需要图形用户界面(GUI)，则应该删除它，以减少系统的攻击面。

extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove gdm References 1.执行以下命令，删除gdm包。https://wiki.gnome.org/Projects/GDM
extraDetail.impact: 删除GNOME Display管理器将从系统中删除GUI。
extraDetail.description_en: The GNOME Display Manager (GDM) is a program that manages graphical display servers and handles graphical user logins.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If a Graphical User Interface (GUI) is not required, it should be removed to reduce the attack surface of the system.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify the output: # rpm -q gdm  package gdm is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the gdm package # yum remove gdm References: 1. https://wiki.gnome.org/Projects/GDM
