creator: system
detail_en: Ensure GDM login banner is configured

extraDetail.description: GDM是GNOME显示管理器，它为基于GNOME的系统处理图形化登录。
extraDetail.rationale: 警告消息通知试图登录系统的用户关于系统的合法状态，并且必须包括拥有系统的组织的名称和任何已启用的监视策略。注意:如果不需要图形登录，则应删除该图形登录，以减少系统的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: 查看是否存在“/etc/dconf/profile/gdm”文件，包括以下内容:user -db:用户system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults查看“/etc/dconf/db/gdm”文件是否存在(这通常是/etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/01-banner-message) [org/gnome/login-screen] banner- messageenable =true banner- messagetext ='<banner message>'
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑或创建“/etc/dconf/profile/gdm”文件，增加以下内容:user -db:用户system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults编辑或创建“/etc/dconf/db/gdm.”文件(这通常是/etc/dconf/db/ gmd .d/01-banner-message) [org/gnome/login-screen] banner-message-enable=true banner-message- Text ='<banner message>'示例横幅文本:'授权用户。所有活动都可能被监控和报告。” 执行以下命令更新系统数据库:# dconf update附加信息:“/etc/dconf/db/gdm. conf”文件中可能会出现额外的选项和章节d / 01-banner-message文件。如果系统正在使用并且需要不同的GUI登录服务，请参考您的文档以禁用显示上次登录用户并应用等效的横幅。
extraDetail.description_en: GDM is the GNOME Display Manager which handles graphical login for GNOME based systems.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Warning messages inform users who are attempting to login to the system of their legal status regarding the system and must include the name of the organization that owns the system and any monitoring policies that are in place. Note: If a graphical login is not required, it should be removed to reduce the attack surface of the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify that /etc/dconf/profile/gdm exists and includes the following: user-db:user system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults Verify that a file exists in /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/ and includes the following: (This is typically /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/01-banner-message) [org/gnome/login-screen] banner-message-enable=true banner-message-text='<banner message>'
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit or create the file /etc/dconf/profile/gdm and add the following: user-db:user system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults Edit or create the file /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/ and add the following: (This is typically /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/01-banner-message) [org/gnome/login-screen] banner-message-enable=true banner-message-text='<banner message>' Example Banner Text: 'Authorized users only. All activity may be monitored and reported.' Run the following command to update the system databases: # dconf update Additional Information: Additional options and sections may appear in the /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/01-banner-message file. If a different GUI login service is in use and required on the system, consult your documentation to disable displaying the last logged on user and apply an equivalent banner.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure last logged in user display is disabled
detail_zh: 确保上次登录用户显示被禁用

extraDetail.description: GDM是GNOME显示管理器，它为基于GNOME的系统处理图形化登录。
extraDetail.rationale: 显示上次登录的用户消除了未经授权的人登录所需的一半用户 ID/密码等式。警告消息通知试图登录系统的用户他们在系统方面的合法状态，并且必须包括拥有该系统的组织的名称和任何已实施的监控策略。注意：  如果不需要图形登录，则应将其删除以减少系统的攻击面。  如果系统正在使用和需要不同的 GUI 登录服务，请查阅您的文档以禁用显示上次登录使用
extraDetail.audit: 查看是否存在“/etc/dconf/profile/gdm”文件，包括以下内容:user -db:用户system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults查看“/etc/dconf/db/gdm”文件是否存在d/并包括以下内容:(这通常是/etc/dconf/db/ gmd .d/00-login-screen) [org/gnome/login-screen] disableuser -list=true
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑或创建“/etc/dconf/profile/gdm”文件，增加以下内容:user -db:用户system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults编辑或创建“/etc/dconf/db/gdm.”文件(这通常是/etc/dconf/db/ gmd .d/00-login-screen) [org/gnome/login-screen] #不显示用户列表disable-user-list=true执行以下命令更新系统数据库
extraDetail.description_en: GDM is the GNOME Display Manager which handles graphical login for GNOME based systems.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Displaying the last logged in user eliminates half of the Userid/Password equation that an unauthorized person would need to log on. Warning messages inform users who are attempting to login to the system of their legal status regarding the system and must include the name of the organization that owns the system and any monitoring policies that are in place. Notes:  If a graphical login is not required, it should be removed to reduce the attack surface of the system.   If a different GUI login service is in use and required on the system, consult your documentation to disable displaying the last logged on use
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify that /etc/dconf/profile/gdm exists and includes the following: user-db:user system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults Verify that a file exists in /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/ and includes the following: (This is typically /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/00-login-screen) [org/gnome/login-screen] disable-user-list=true
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit or create the file /etc/dconf/profile/gdm and add the following: user-db:user system-db:gdm file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults Edit or create the file /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/ and add the following: (This is typically /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/00-login-screen) [org/gnome/login-screen] # Do not show the user list disable-user-list=true Run the following command to update the system databases: # dconf update

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure XDCMP is not enabled

extraDetail.description: X显示管理器控制协议(XDMCP)旨在为远程显示提供对显示管理服务的认证访问
extraDetail.rationale: XDMCP 本质上是不安全的。  XDMCP 不是加密协议。这可能允许攻击者捕获用户输入的击键  XDMCP 容易受到中间人攻击。这可能允许攻击者通过冒充 XDMCP 服务器窃取合法用户的凭据
extraDetail.audit: # grep -Eis '^\s*Enable\s*=\s*true' /etc/gdm/custom.conf不显示任何信息
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/gdm/custom.conf文件，删除“Enable=true”一行
extraDetail.defaultValue: false(在[xdmcp]部分的/etc/gdm/custom.conf文件中没有Enabled=项表示
extraDetail.description_en: X Display Manager Control Protocol (XDMCP) is designed to provide authenticated access to display management services for remote displays
extraDetail.rationale_en: XDMCP is inherently insecure.  XDMCP is not a ciphered protocol. This may allow an attacker to capture keystrokes entered by a user  XDMCP is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. This may allow an attacker to steal the credentials of legitimate users by impersonating the XDMCP server
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command and verify the output: # grep -Eis '^\s*Enable\s*=\s*true' /etc/gdm/custom.conf  Nothing should be returned
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the file /etc/gdm/custom.conf and remove the line Enable=true
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: false (This is denoted by no Enabled= entry in the file /etc/gdm/custom.conf in the [xdmcp] section

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure updates, patches, and additional security software are installed
detail_zh: 确保安装了更新、补丁和其他安全软件

extraDetail.description: 由于安全缺陷或包含额外功能，所包含的软件会定期发布补丁。注意:站点策略可能要求在安装到生产系统上进行可用更新之前有一段测试期。
extraDetail.rationale: 较新的补丁可能包含通过最新的完整更新无法提供的安全增强功能。因此，建议使用最新的软件补丁来利用最新的功能。与任何软件安装一样，组织需要确定给定的更新是否满足他们的需求，并根据所选择的更新修订验证任何其他软件的兼容性和可支持性
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下命令验证没有要安装的更新或补丁。# yum check-update
extraDetail.remediation: 使用包管理器根据站点策略更新系统上的所有包。下面的命令将安装所有可用的包# yum update
extraDetail.description_en: Periodically patches are released for included software either due to security flaws or to include additional functionality. Note: Site policy may mandate a testing period before install onto production systems for available updates.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Newer patches may contain security enhancements that would not be available through the latest full update. As a result, it is recommended that the latest software patches be used to take advantage of the latest functionality. As with any software installation, organizations need to determine if a given update meets their requirements and verify the compatibility and supportability of any additional software against the update revision that is selected
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify there are no updates or patches to install. # yum check-update
extraDetail.remediation_en: Use your package manager to update all packages on the system according to site policy. The following command will install all available packages # yum update

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure xinetd is not installed

extraDetail.description: 扩展InterNET守护进程(xinetd)是一个开源的超级守护进程，它取代了原来的inetd守护进程。xinetd守护进程侦听已知的服务，并分派适当的守护进程以正确响应服务请求。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果不需要xinetd服务，建议删除该包，减少系统的攻击面。注意:如果需要xinetd服务，请确保所有不需要的xinetd服务都已停止和关闭审计:执行以下命令，检查xinetd是否安装。# rpm -q xinetd package xinetd is not installed修复:执行以下命令，删除xinetd
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q xinetd package xinetd未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除xinetd。# yum remove xinetd
extraDetail.description_en: The eXtended InterNET Daemon ( xinetd ) is an open source super daemon that replaced the original inetd daemon. The xinetd daemon listens for well known services and dispatches the appropriate daemon to properly respond to service requests.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If there are no xinetd services required, it is recommended that the package be removed to reduce the attack surface are of the system. Note: If an xinetd service or services are required, ensure that any xinetd service not required is stopped and disabled
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify xinetd is not installed: # rpm -q xinetd  package xinetd is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove xinetd: # yum remove xinetd

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure time synchronization is in use
detail_zh: 确保时间同步正在使用

extraDetail.description: 系统时间应该在环境中的所有系统之间同步。这通常是通过建立一个权威的时间服务器或一组服务器并让所有系统将它们的时钟同步到它们来完成的。注意：  如果使用另一种时间同步方法，则可以跳过此部分。  只安装一个时间同步包
extraDetail.rationale: 时间同步对于支持时间敏感的安全机制（如 Kerberos）很重要，还可以确保日志文件在整个企业中具有一致的时间记录，这有助于取证调查
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查时间同步包是否安装。# rpm -q chrony ntp chrony-<version> # rpm -q ntp ntp-<version>
extraDetail.remediation: 运行以下命令之一来安装 chrony 或 NTP： 要安装 chrony，请运行以下命令：# yum install chrony 或 要安装 ntp，请运行以下命令：# yum install ntp 注意：在基于主机的时间同步可用的系统上请查阅您的虚拟化软件文档并设置基于主机的同步。附加信息：  在基于主机的时间同步不可用的系统上，验证是否安装了 chrony 或 NTP。  在基于主机的时间同步可用的系统上，请查阅您的文档并验证是否正在使用基于主机的同步。
extraDetail.description_en: System time should be synchronized between all systems in an environment. This is typically done by establishing an authoritative time server or set of servers and having all systems synchronize their clocks to them. Note:  If another method for time synchronization is being used, this section may be skipped.  Only one time synchronization package should be installed
extraDetail.rationale_en: Time synchronization is important to support time sensitive security mechanisms like Kerberos and also ensures log files have consistent time records across the enterprise, which aids in forensic investigations
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands to verify that a time synchronization packages is installed: # rpm -q chrony ntp  chrony-<version>  # rpm -q ntp  ntp-<version>
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run One of the following commands to install chrony or NTP: To install chrony, run the following command: # yum install chrony OR To install ntp, run the following command: # yum install ntp Note: On systems where host based time synchronization is available consult your virtualization software documentation and setup host based synchronization. Additional Information:  On systems where host based time synchronization is not available, verify that chrony or NTP is installed.  On systems where host based time synchronization is available consult your documentation and verify that host based synchronization is in use.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure chrony is configured

extraDetail.description: chrony是一个实现网络时间协议(NTP)的守护进程，旨在跨各种系统同步系统时钟，并使用高度准确的源。更多关于时间的信息可以在http://chrony.tuxfamily.org/上找到。可以将Chrony配置为客户机和/或服务器。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果在系统上使用了时间同步，正确的配置对于确保时间同步正常工作至关重要。注意:此建议仅适用于在系统上使用了chrony的情况
extraDetail.audit: # grep -E "^(server|pool)"说明/etc/ clock .conf server <remote-server>可能配置多个服务器。# grep ^OPTIONS /etc/sysconfig/chronyd OPTIONS="-u chrony"可能还有其他选项。
extraDetail.remediation: 在/etc/sysconfig/chronyd中添加或编辑“-u chrony”选项:OPTIONS="-u chrony"
extraDetail.description_en: chrony is a daemon which implements the Network Time Protocol (NTP) and is designed to synchronize system clocks across a variety of systems and use a source that is highly accurate. More information on chrony can be found at http://chrony.tuxfamily.org/. chrony can be configured to be a client and/or a server.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If chrony is in use on the system proper configuration is vital to ensuring time synchronization is working properly. Note: This recommendation only applies if chrony is in use on the system
extraDetail.audit_en: IF chrony is installed on the system: Run the following command and verify remote server is configured properly: # grep -E "^(server|pool)" /etc/chrony.conf  server <remote-server> Multiple servers may be configured. Run the following command and verify OPTIONS includes '-u chrony': # grep ^OPTIONS /etc/sysconfig/chronyd  OPTIONS="-u chrony" Additional options may be present.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add or edit server or pool lines to /etc/chrony.conf as appropriate: server <remote-server> Add or edit the OPTIONS in /etc/sysconfig/chronyd to include '-u chrony': OPTIONS="-u chrony"

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure ntp is configured

extraDetail.description: ntp是实现网络时间协议(ntp)的守护进程。它的设计目的是在各种系统之间同步系统时钟，并使用高度准确的源。关于NTP的更多信息可以在http://www.ntp.org上找到。NTP可以配置为客户端和/或服务器。注意:此建议仅适用于系统上使用ntp的情况。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果系统上使用了ntp，正确的配置对于确保时间同步正常工作至关重要
extraDetail.audit: # systemctl is-enabled ntpd enabled执行以下命令，验证是否开启ntpd。# grep "^restrict" /etc/ntp.conf restrict -4 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery restrict -6 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery第一行的-4为可选参数，“default”后面的选项可以任意排列。可能存在其他限制线。执行以下命令，确认远程服务器配置正确。# grep -E "^(server|pool)"/etc/ntp.conf server <remote-server>可能配置了多个服务器执行以下命令，检查OPTIONS或ExecStart中是否包含了“-u ntp:ntp”service ExecStart=/usr/sbin/ntpd -u ntp:ntp $OPTIONS可能存在其他选项。
extraDetail.remediation: 在/etc/ntp.conf中添加或编辑限制行，以匹配以下内容:restrict -4 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery restrict -6 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery在/etc/ntp.conf中适当添加或编辑服务器或池行:server <remote-server>在/etc/sysconfig/ntpd中添加或编辑OPTIONS，包括'-u ntp:ntp': OPTIONS="-u ntp:ntp"重新加载systemd daemon: systemctl daemon- Reload启用并启动ntp服务:systemctl——now Enable ntpd
extraDetail.description_en: ntp is a daemon which implements the Network Time Protocol (NTP). It is designed to synchronize system clocks across a variety of systems and use a source that is highly accurate. More information on NTP can be found at http://www.ntp.org. ntp can be configured to be a client and/or a server. Note: This recommendation only applies if ntp is in use on the system.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If ntp is in use on the system proper configuration is vital to ensuring time synchronization is working properly
extraDetail.audit_en: IF NTP is installed on the system: Run the following command and verify ntpd is enabled: # systemctl is-enabled ntpd  enabled Run the following command and verify output matches: # grep "^restrict" /etc/ntp.conf  restrict -4 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery restrict -6 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery The -4 in the first line is optional and options after default can appear in any order. Additional restriction lines may exist. Run the following command and verify remote server is configured properly: # grep -E "^(server|pool)" /etc/ntp.conf  server <remote-server> Multiple servers may be configured Run the following commands and verify that ' -u ntp:ntp ' is included in OPTIONS OR ExecStart as listed: # grep "^OPTIONS" /etc/sysconfig/ntpd  OPTIONS="-u ntp:ntp" OR # grep "^ExecStart" /usr/lib/systemd/system/ntpd.service  ExecStart=/usr/sbin/ntpd -u ntp:ntp $OPTIONS Additional options may be present.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Add or edit restrict lines in /etc/ntp.conf to match the following: restrict -4 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery restrict -6 default kod nomodify notrap nopeer noquery Add or edit server or pool lines to /etc/ntp.conf as appropriate: server <remote-server> Add or edit the OPTIONS in /etc/sysconfig/ntpd to include '-u ntp:ntp': OPTIONS="-u ntp:ntp" Reload the systemd daemon: systemctl daemon-reload Enable and start the ntp service: systemctl --now enable ntpd

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure X11 Server components are not installed

extraDetail.description: X窗口系统提供了一个图形用户界面(GUI)，用户可以有多个窗口在其中运行程序和各种添加。X Windows系统通常用于用户登录的工作站，而不是用户通常不登录的服务器。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非您的组织特别要求通过X Windows进行图形登录访问，否则请删除它以减少潜在的攻击面。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令验证是否安装X Windows Server。# RPM -qa xorg-x11-server*
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除X Windows Server包。# yum remove xorg-x11-server*
extraDetail.impact: 许多Linux系统运行的应用程序都需要Java运行时。一些Linux Java包依赖于特定的X Windows xorg-x11-字体。避免这种依赖的一种解决方法是针对特定的Java运行时使用“无头”Java包。
extraDetail.description_en: The X Window System provides a Graphical User Interface (GUI) where users can have multiple windows in which to run programs and various add on. The X Windows system is typically used on workstations where users login, but not on servers where users typically do not login.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless your organization specifically requires graphical login access via X Windows, remove it to reduce the potential attack surface.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to Verify X Windows Server is not installed. # rpm -qa xorg-x11-server*
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the X Windows Server packages: # yum remove xorg-x11-server*
extraDetail.impact_en: Many Linux systems run applications which require a Java runtime. Some Linux Java packages have a dependency on specific X Windows xorg-x11-fonts. One workaround to avoid this dependency is to use the "headless" Java packages for your specific Java runtime.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure Avahi Server is not installed

extraDetail.description: Avahi是一个免费的零配置实现，包括一个组播DNS/DNS- sd服务发现系统。Avahi允许程序发布和发现运行在本地网络上的服务和主机，而不需要特定的配置。例如，用户可以将一台计算机接入网络，Avahi就会自动找到要打印的打印机、要查看的文件、要交谈的人，以及机器上运行的网络服务。
extraDetail.rationale: 系统功能通常不需要自动发现网络服务。建议删除此包以减少潜在的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: 1 .执行如下命令，检查avahi-autoipd和avahi是否安装。# rpm -q avahi-autoipd avahi package avahi-autoipd is not installed package avahi is not installed
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令停止、屏蔽和删除avahi-autoipd和avahi。套接字avahi-daemon。service # yum remove avahi-autoipd avahi
extraDetail.description_en: Avahi is a free zeroconf implementation, including a system for multicast DNS/DNS-SD service discovery. Avahi allows programs to publish and discover services and hosts running on a local network with no specific configuration. For example, a user can plug a computer into a network and Avahi automatically finds printers to print to, files to look at and people to talk to, as well as network services running on the machine.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Automatic discovery of network services is not normally required for system functionality. It is recommended to remove this package to reduce the potential attack surface
extraDetail.audit_en: Run one of the following command to verify avahi-autoipd and avahi are not installed: # rpm -q avahi-autoipd avahi  package avahi-autoipd is not installed package avahi is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following commands to stop, mask and remove avahi-autoipd and avahi: # systemctl stop avahi-daemon.socket avahi-daemon.service # yum remove avahi-autoipd avahi

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure CUPS is not installed

extraDetail.description: 通用Unix打印系统(CUPS)提供了打印到本地和网络打印机的能力。运行CUPS的系统还可以接受来自远程系统的打印作业，并将它们打印到本地打印机。它还提供了基于web的远程管理功能。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果系统不需要打印作业或接受其他系统的打印作业，建议删除CUPS以减少潜在的攻击面。注意:移除CUPS将阻止从系统中打印
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令确认cups未安装。# rpm -q cups package cups未安装
extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove cups参考:1.执行以下命令，删除杯子。关于CUPS的更详细的文档可以在项目主页http://www.cups.org上找到。
extraDetail.impact: 禁用CUPS将阻止从系统中打印，这是工作站系统的常见任务。
extraDetail.description_en: The Common Unix Print System (CUPS) provides the ability to print to both local and network printers. A system running CUPS can also accept print jobs from remote systems and print them to local printers. It also provides a web based remote administration capability.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the system does not need to print jobs or accept print jobs from other systems, it is recommended that CUPS be removed to reduce the potential attack surface. Note: Removing CUPS will prevent printing from the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify cups is not installed: # rpm -q cups  package cups is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove cups: # yum remove cups References: 1. More detailed documentation on CUPS is available at the project homepage at http://www.cups.org.
extraDetail.impact_en: Disabling CUPS will prevent printing from the system, a common task for workstation systems.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure DHCP Server is not installed

extraDetail.description: 动态主机配置协议(DHCP)是一种允许动态分配机器IP地址的服务。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非系统被专门设置为DHCP服务器，否则建议删除DHCP包，以减少潜在的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q dhcp package dhcp is not installed .执行以下命令检查dhcp是否安装
extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove dhcp参考:1.执行以下命令，删除dhcp。dhcpd(8)
extraDetail.description_en: The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) is a service that allows machines to be dynamically assigned IP addresses.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless a system is specifically set up to act as a DHCP server, it is recommended that the dhcp package be removed to reduce the potential attack surface
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify dhcp is not installed: # rpm -q dhcp  package dhcp is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove dhcp: # yum remove dhcp References: 1. dhcpd(8)

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure LDAP server is not installed

extraDetail.description: 轻量级目录访问协议(LDAP)作为NIS/YP的替代品被引入。它是一种服务，提供从中央数据库查找信息的方法。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果系统不需要作为LDAP服务器，建议删除该软件，减少潜在的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q openldap-servers包未安装openldap-servers
extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove openldap-servers参考:1.执行以下命令，删除openldap-servers。有关OpenLDAP的更多详细文档，请访问项目主页http://www.openldap.org。
extraDetail.description_en: The Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) was introduced as a replacement for NIS/YP. It is a service that provides a method for looking up information from a central database.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the system will not need to act as an LDAP server, it is recommended that the software be removed to reduce the potential attack surface
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify openldap-servers is not installed: # rpm -q openldap-servers  package openldap-servers is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove openldap-servers: # yum remove openldap-servers References: 1. For more detailed documentation on OpenLDAP, go to the project homepage at http://www.openldap.org.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure DNS Server is not installed

extraDetail.description: 域名系统(DNS)是一个分层命名系统，它将名称映射到连接到网络的计算机、服务和其他资源的IP地址。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非一个系统被特别指定为DNS服务器，否则建议删除该包以减少潜在的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: 执行如下命令检查bind是否安装。# rpm -q bind package bind未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，解除绑定。# yum remove bind
extraDetail.description_en: The Domain Name System (DNS) is a hierarchical naming system that maps names to IP addresses for computers, services and other resources connected to a network.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless a system is specifically designated to act as a DNS server, it is recommended that the package be removed to reduce the potential attack surface
extraDetail.audit_en: Run one of the following commands to verify bind is not installed: # rpm -q bind  package bind is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove bind: # yum remove bind

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure FTP Server is not installed

extraDetail.description: FTP(文件传输协议)是一种传统的、广泛使用的标准工具，用于通过网络在服务器和客户端之间传输文件，特别是在不需要身份验证的情况下(允许匿名用户连接到服务器)。
extraDetail.rationale: FTP不保护数据或身份验证凭证的机密性。如果需要传输文件，建议使用SFTP协议。除非需要将系统作为FTP服务器运行(例如，允许匿名下载)，否则建议删除该包，以减少潜在的攻击面。注意:还存在其他FTP服务器，如果不需要，请删除它们
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q vsftpd package vsftpd未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除vsftpd。# yum remove vsftpd
extraDetail.description_en: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) is a traditional and widely used standard tool for transferring files between a server and clients over a network, especially where no authentication is necessary (permits anonymous users to connect to a server).
extraDetail.rationale_en: FTP does not protect the confidentiality of data or authentication credentials. It is recommended SFTP be used if file transfer is required. Unless there is a need to run the system as a FTP server (for example, to allow anonymous downloads), it is recommended that the package be removed to reduce the potential attack surface. Note: Additional FTP servers also exist and should be removed if not required
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify vsftpd is not installed: # rpm -q vsftpd  package vsftpd is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove vsftpd: # yum remove vsftpd

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure HTTP server is not installed

extraDetail.description: HTTP或web服务器提供托管网站内容的能力。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非需要将系统作为 Web 服务器运行，否则建议删除该软件包以减少潜在的攻击面。注意：  存在多个 http 服务器。 apache、apache2、lighttpd 和 nginx 是提供 HTTP 服务器的示例包。  这些和其他包也应该被审核，如果不需要则删除
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q httpd package httpd未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令移除httpd。# yum remove httpd
extraDetail.description_en: HTTP or web servers provide the ability to host web site content.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless there is a need to run the system as a web server, it is recommended that the package be removed to reduce the potential attack surface. Notes:  Several http servers exist. apache, apache2, lighttpd, and nginx are example packages that provide an HTTP server.   These and other packages should also be audited, and removed if not required
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify httpd is not installed: # rpm -q httpd  package httpd is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove httpd: # yum remove httpd

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure IMAP and POP3 server is not installed

extraDetail.description: dovecot是一个开源的IMAP和POP3服务器，用于基于Linux的系统。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非该系统提供 POP3 和/或 IMAP 服务器，否则建议删除该包以减少潜在的攻击面。注意：  存在多个 IMAP/POP3 服务器并且可以使用其他服务名称。 courier-imap 和 cyrus-imap 是提供邮件服务器的示例服务。  这些和其他服务也应该被审核，如果不需要，则删除包
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q dovecot包未安装dovecot
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除dovecot。# yum remove dovecot
extraDetail.description_en: dovecot is an open source IMAP and POP3 server for Linux based systems.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless POP3 and/or IMAP servers are to be provided by this system, it is recommended that the package be removed to reduce the potential attack surface. Notes:  Several IMAP/POP3 servers exist and can use other service names. courier-imap and cyrus-imap are example services that provide a mail server.   These and other services should also be audited and the packages removed if not required
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify dovecot is not installed: # rpm -q dovecot  package dovecot is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove dovecot: # yum remove dovecot

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure Samba is not installed

extraDetail.description: Samba守护进程允许系统管理员配置他们的Linux系统，以便与Windows桌面共享文件系统和目录。Samba将通过服务器消息块(SMB)协议发布文件系统和目录。Windows桌面用户将能够将这些目录和文件系统作为字母驱动器挂载到他们的系统上。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果不需要将目录和文件系统挂载到Windows系统，则可以删除此包以减少潜在的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查是否安装samba。# rpm -q samba package samba未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除samba。# yum remove samba
extraDetail.description_en: The Samba daemon allows system administrators to configure their Linux systems to share file systems and directories with Windows desktops. Samba will advertise the file systems and directories via the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol. Windows desktop users will be able to mount these directories and file systems as letter drives on their systems.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If there is no need to mount directories and file systems to Windows systems, then this package can be removed to reduce the potential attack surface
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify samba is not installed: # rpm -q samba  package samba is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove samba: # yum remove samba

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure HTTP Proxy Server is not installed
detail_zh: 请确保没有安装HTTP代理服务器

extraDetail.description: Squid是一个在许多发行版和环境中使用的标准代理服务器。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非系统被专门设置为充当代理服务器，否则建议删除squid包以减少潜在的攻击面。注意:存在多个HTTP代理服务器。除非需要，否则应检查并移除
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令确认squid未安装。# rpm -q squid package squid未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除鱿鱼包。# yum remove squid
extraDetail.description_en: Squid is a standard proxy server used in many distributions and environments.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless a system is specifically set up to act as a proxy server, it is recommended that the squid package be removed to reduce the potential attack surface. Note: Several HTTP proxy servers exist. These should be checked and removed unless required
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify squid is not installed: # rpm -q squid  package squid is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the squid package: # yum remove squid

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure net-snmp is not installed

extraDetail.description: 简单网络管理协议(SNMP)是一种广泛使用的协议，用于监控网络设备、计算机设备和ups等设备的健康和福利。Net-SNMP是一套应用程序，用于同时使用IPv4和IPv6实现SNMPv1 (RFC 1157)、SNMPv2 (RFC 1901-1908)和SNMPv3 (RFC 3411-3418)。支持SNMPv2经典版(也称经典版)。“SNMPv2历史”- rfc1441 -1452)随着UCD-snmp包的4.0发布而被删除。简单网络管理协议(SNMP)服务器用于侦听来自SNMP管理系统的SNMP命令，执行命令或收集信息，然后将结果发送回请求系统。
extraDetail.rationale: SNMP 服务器可以使用 SNMPv1 进行通信，SNMPv1 以明文方式传输数据并且不需要身份验证即可执行命令。 SNMPv3 用更安全的编码参数取代了 SNMPv2 中使用的简单/明文密码共享。如果不需要 SNMP 服务，则应删除 net-snmp 包以减少系统的攻击面。注意：如果需要 SNMP：  应仅为 SNMP v3 配置服务器。应配置用户身份验证和消息加密。  如果绝对需要 SNMP v2，请修改社区字符串的值
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q net-snmp package net-snmp is not installed
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除net-snmpd
extraDetail.description_en: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) is a widely used protocol for monitoring the health and welfare of network equipment, computer equipment and devices like UPSs. Net-SNMP is a suite of applications used to implement SNMPv1 (RFC 1157), SNMPv2 (RFCs 1901-1908), and SNMPv3 (RFCs 3411-3418) using both IPv4 and IPv6. Support for SNMPv2 classic (a.k.a. "SNMPv2 historic" - RFCs 1441-1452) was dropped with the 4.0 release of the UCD-snmp package. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) server is used to listen for SNMP commands from an SNMP management system, execute the commands or collect the information and then send results back to the requesting system.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The SNMP server can communicate using SNMPv1, which transmits data in the clear and does not require authentication to execute commands. SNMPv3 replaces the simple/clear text password sharing used in SNMPv2 with more securely encoded parameters. If the the SNMP service is not required, the net-snmp package should be removed to reduce the attack surface of the system. Note: If SNMP is required:  The server should be configured for SNMP v3 only. User Authentication and Message Encryption should be configured.   If SNMP v2 is absolutely necessary, modify the community strings' values
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify net-snmp is not installed: # rpm -q net-snmp  package net-snmp is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove net-snmpd: # yum remove net-snmp

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure NIS server is not installed

extraDetail.description: ypserv包提供了网络信息服务(NIS)。该服务正式称为黄页，是用于分发系统配置文件的客户机-服务器目录服务协议。NIS服务器是允许分发配置文件的程序的集合。
extraDetail.rationale: NIS服务本质上是一个不安全的系统，它容易受到DOS攻击、缓冲区溢出以及查询NIS映射时的糟糕身份验证。NIS通常被LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol)等协议所取代。建议删除ypserv包，如果需要，可以使用更安全的服务
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查ypserv是否安装。# rpm -q ypserv包ypserv未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除ypserv。# yum remove ypserv
extraDetail.description_en: The ypserv package provides the Network Information Service (NIS). This service, formally known as Yellow Pages, is a client-server directory service protocol for distributing system configuration files. The NIS server is a collection of programs that allow for the distribution of configuration files.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The NIS service is inherently an insecure system that has been vulnerable to DOS attacks, buffer overflows and has poor authentication for querying NIS maps. NIS generally has been replaced by such protocols as Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). It is recommended that the ypserv package be removed, and if required a more secure services be used
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify ypserv is not installed: # rpm -q ypserv  package ypserv is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove ypserv: # yum remove ypserv

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure telnet-server is not installed

extraDetail.description: telnet-server包包含telnet守护进程，它通过telnet协议接受来自其他系统的用户的连接。
extraDetail.rationale: telnet协议是不安全的、未加密的协议。使用未加密的传输介质可以允许访问网络流量的用户窃取凭据。ssh提供加密的会话，安全性更高
extraDetail.audit: rpm -q telnet-server package没有安装telnet-server
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除“telnet-server”包。# yum remove telnet-server
extraDetail.description_en: The telnet-server package contains the telnet daemon, which accepts connections from users from other systems via the telnet protocol.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The telnet protocol is insecure and unencrypted. The use of an unencrypted transmission medium could allow a user with access to sniff network traffic the ability to steal credentials. The ssh package provides an encrypted session and stronger security
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify the telnet-server package is not installed: rpm -q telnet-server  package telnet-server is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the telnet-server package: # yum remove telnet-server

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure mail transfer agent is configured for local-only mode
detail_zh: 确保本地模式下配置了邮件传输代理

extraDetail.description: 邮件传输代理(MTA)，例如sendmail和Postfix，用于监听传入邮件并将消息传输给适当的用户或邮件服务器。如果系统不打算成为邮件服务器，建议将MTA配置为只处理本地邮件。
extraDetail.rationale: 所有邮件传输代理的软件都很复杂，而且大多数都有很长的安全问题历史。虽然确保系统可以处理本地邮件消息很重要，但没有必要让 MTA 的守护程序侦听端口，除非该服务器旨在成为接收和处理来自其他系统的邮件的邮件服务器。注意：  此建议是围绕 postfix 邮件服务器设计的。  根据您的环境，您可能安装了替代 MTA，例如 sendmail。如果是这种情况，请查阅您安装的 MTA 的文档以配置推荐的状态
extraDetail.audit: 运行以下命令验证MTA没有监听任何非环回地址(127.0.0.1或::1)应该没有返回任何内容# ss -lntu | grep -E ':25\s' | grep -E -v '\s(127.0.0.1|\[?::1\]?):25\s'
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/postfix/main.cf并将以下行添加到RECEIVING MAIL部分。如果已经存在，修改如下所示:inet_interfaces = loopback-only重新启动postfix
extraDetail.description_en: Mail Transfer Agents (MTA), such as sendmail and Postfix, are used to listen for incoming mail and transfer the messages to the appropriate user or mail server. If the system is not intended to be a mail server, it is recommended that the MTA be configured to only process local mail.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The software for all Mail Transfer Agents is complex and most have a long history of security issues. While it is important to ensure that the system can process local mail messages, it is not necessary to have the MTA's daemon listening on a port unless the server is intended to be a mail server that receives and processes mail from other systems. Notes:  This recommendation is designed around the postfix mail server.   Depending on your environment you may have an alternative MTA installed such as sendmail. If this is the case consult the documentation for your installed MTA to configure the recommended state
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the MTA is not listening on any non-loopback address ( 127.0.0.1 or ::1 ) Nothing should be returned #  ss -lntu | grep -E ':25\s' | grep -E -v '\s(127.0.0.1|\[?::1\]?):25\s'
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit /etc/postfix/main.cf and add the following line to the RECEIVING MAIL section. If the line already exists, change it to look like the line below: inet_interfaces = loopback-only Run the following command to restart postfix: # systemctl restart postfix

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nfs-utils is not installed or the nfs-server service is masked
detail_zh: 确保未安装nfs-utils或屏蔽nfs-server服务

extraDetail.description: 网络文件系统(NFS)是UNIX环境中最早和分布最广泛的文件系统之一。它提供了系统通过网络挂载其他服务器的文件系统的能力。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果系统不需要网络共享，建议删除nfs-utils包，减少系统的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q nfs-utils package未安装nfs-utils或如果需要依赖于nfs-package，则执行以下命令验证nfs-server服务是否被屏蔽。# systemctl -enabled nfs-server masking
extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove nfs-utils OR如果需要使用nfs-package作为依赖项，则执行以下命令停止并屏蔽nfs-server服务。# systemctl——now mask nfs-server附加信息:许多企业级Linux虚拟化使用的libvirt包依赖于nfs-utils包。如果需要使用nfs-package作为依赖项，则应该禁用并屏蔽nfs-server，以减少系统的攻击面。
extraDetail.description_en: The Network File System (NFS) is one of the first and most widely distributed file systems in the UNIX environment. It provides the ability for systems to mount file systems of other servers through the network.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the system does not require network shares, it is recommended that the nfs-utils package be removed to reduce the attack surface of the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify nfs-utils is not installed: # rpm -q nfs-utils  package nfs-utils is not installed OR If the nfs-package is required as a dependency, run the following command to verify that the nfs-server service is masked: # systemctl is-enabled nfs-server  masked
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove nfs-utils: # yum remove nfs-utils OR If the nfs-package is required as a dependency, run the following command to stop and mask the nfs-server service: # systemctl --now mask nfs-server Additional Information: many of the libvirt packages used by Enterprise Linux virtualization are dependent on the nfs-utils package. If the nfs-package is required as a dependency, the nfs-server should be disabled and masked to reduce the attack surface of the system.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rpcbind is not installed or the rpcbind services are masked
detail_zh: 确保没有安装rpcbind或屏蔽rpcbind服务

extraDetail.description: rpcbind实用程序将RPC服务映射到它们侦听的端口。RPC进程在启动时通知rpcbind，注册它们正在侦听的端口和它们期望服务的RPC程序号。然后客户端系统用一个特定的RPC程序号联系服务器上的rpcbind。rpcbind服务将客户端重定向到正确的端口号，以便它可以与所请求的服务通信。Portmapper是一个RPC服务，它总是侦听tcp和udp 111，并用于将其他RPC服务(如nfs、nlockmgr、quotad、mountd等)映射到服务器上相应的端口号。当远程主机对该服务器进行RPC调用时，它首先咨询portmap，以确定RPC服务器正在侦听的位置。
extraDetail.rationale: 发送到Portmapper的一个小请求(通过UDP ~82字节)会生成一个大响应(放大7倍到28倍)，这使它成为DDoS攻击的合适工具。如果不需要rpcbind，建议删除rpcbind包，减少系统的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q rpcbind package rpcbind is not installed OR如果需要rpcbind包作为依赖项，执行以下命令检查rpcbind和rpcbind. sh是否安装rpcbind。Socket服务被屏蔽:# systemctl -enabled rpcbind蒙面# systemctl -enabled rpcbind。套接字蒙面
extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove rpcbind OR如果需要rpcbind包作为依赖项，执行以下命令停止并屏蔽rpcbind和rpcbind。Socket服务:# systemctl——now mask rpcbind # systemctl——now mask rpcbind。Enterprise Linux虚拟化使用的许多libvirt包，以及用于网络文件系统(NFS)的NFS -utils包都依赖于rpcbind包。如果需要rpcbind作为依赖项，则服务rpcbind。Service和rpcbind。Socket应该被停止和屏蔽，以减少系统的攻击面。
extraDetail.description_en: The rpcbind utility maps RPC services to the ports on which they listen. RPC processes notify rpcbind when they start, registering the ports they are listening on and the RPC program numbers they expect to serve. The client system then contacts rpcbind on the server with a particular RPC program number. The rpcbind service redirects the client to the proper port number so it can communicate with the requested service Portmapper is an RPC service, which always listens on tcp and udp 111, and is used to map other RPC services (such as nfs, nlockmgr, quotad, mountd, etc.) to their corresponding port number on the server. When a remote host makes an RPC call to that server, it first consults with portmap to determine where the RPC server is listening.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A small request (~82 bytes via UDP) sent to the Portmapper generates a large response (7x to 28x amplification), which makes it a suitable tool for DDoS attacks. If rpcbind is not required, it is recommended that the rpcbind package be removed to reduce the attack surface of the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify rpcbind is not installed: # rpm -q rpcbind  package rpcbind is not installed OR If the rpcbind package is required as a dependency, run the following commands to verify that the rpcbind and rpcbind.socket services are masked: # systemctl is-enabled rpcbind  masked # systemctl is-enabled rpcbind.socket  masked
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove nfs-utils: # yum remove rpcbind OR If the rpcbind package is required as a dependency, run the following commands to stop and mask the rpcbind and rpcbind.socket services: # systemctl --now mask rpcbind # systemctl --now mask rpcbind.socket Additional Information: Many of the libvirt packages used by Enterprise Linux virtualization, and the nfs-utils package used for The Network File System (NFS), are dependent on the rpcbind package. If the rpcbind is required as a dependency, the services rpcbind.service and rpcbind.socket should be stopped and masked to reduce the attack surface of the system.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rsync is not installed or the rsyncd service is masked
detail_zh: 确保没有安装rsync或屏蔽rsyncd服务

extraDetail.description: rsyncd服务可用于通过网络链路在系统之间同步文件。
extraDetail.rationale: 除非需要，否则应该删除rsync包，以减少系统的攻击面面积。rsyncd服务存在安全风险，因为它使用未加密的协议进行通信。注意:如果rsync包存在必需的依赖关系，但rsyncd服务不是必需的，则该服务应该被屏蔽。
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q rsync package rsync is not installed OR执行以下命令，检查rsyncd服务是否被屏蔽
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除rsync包。# yum remove rsync OR执行以下命令，屏蔽rsync服务
extraDetail.impact: 有些包依赖于rsync包。如果rsync包被删除，这些包也将被删除。在删除rsync包之前，请检查任何依赖包，以确定系统是否需要它们。如果需要依赖的包，则屏蔽rsyncd服务，并保留安装的rsync包。
extraDetail.description_en: The rsyncd service can be used to synchronize files between systems over network links.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unless required, the rsync package should be removed to reduce the attack surface area of the system. The rsyncd service presents a security risk as it uses unencrypted protocols for communication. Note: If a required dependency exists for the rsync package, but the rsyncd service is not required, the service should be masked.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that rsync is not installed: # rpm -q rsync  package rsync is not installed OR Run the following command to verify the rsyncd service is masked: # systemctl is-enabled rsyncd  masked
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the rsync package: # yum remove rsync OR Run the following command to mask the rsyncd service: # systemctl --now mask rsyncd
extraDetail.impact_en: There are packages that are dependent on the rsync package. If the rsync package is removed, these packages will be removed as well. Before removing the rsync package, review any dependent packages to determine if they are required on the system. If a dependent package is required, mask the rsyncd service and leave the rsync package installed.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure NIS Client is not installed

extraDetail.description: NIS (Network Information Service)，以前称为黄页，是一种用于分发系统配置文件的客户端-服务器目录服务协议。NIS客户端(ypbind)用于将机器绑定到NIS服务器并接收分布式配置文件。
extraDetail.rationale: NIS服务本质上是一个不安全的系统，它容易受到DOS攻击、缓冲区溢出以及查询NIS映射时的糟糕身份验证。NIS通常被LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol)等协议所取代。建议删除该服务。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查ypbind包是否安装。# rpm -q ypbind package ypbind未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除ypbind包。# yum remove ypbind
extraDetail.impact: 许多不安全的服务客户端被用作故障排除工具和测试环境。卸载它们会抑制测试和故障排除的能力。如果需要，建议在使用后取出客户端，以防止意外或故意误用。
extraDetail.description_en: The Network Information Service (NIS), formerly known as Yellow Pages, is a client-server directory service protocol used to distribute system configuration files. The NIS client ( ypbind ) was used to bind a machine to an NIS server and receive the distributed configuration files.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The NIS service is inherently an insecure system that has been vulnerable to DOS attacks, buffer overflows and has poor authentication for querying NIS maps. NIS generally has been replaced by such protocols as Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). It is recommended that the service be removed.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the ypbind package is not installed: # rpm -q ypbind  package ypbind is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the ypbind package: # yum remove ypbind
extraDetail.impact_en: Many insecure service clients are used as troubleshooting tools and in testing environments. Uninstalling them can inhibit capability to test and troubleshoot. If they are required it is advisable to remove the clients after use to prevent accidental or intentional misuse.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rsh client is not installed

extraDetail.description: rsh包包含rsh服务的客户端命令。
extraDetail.rationale: 这些遗留客户端包含大量安全隐患，已被更安全的SSH包所取代。即使删除了服务器，最好确保也删除了客户端，以防止用户无意中尝试使用这些命令，从而暴露他们的凭据。注意，删除rsh包会删除rsh、rcp和rlogin的客户端。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查rsh包是否安装。# rpm -q rsh package rsh未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除rsh包。# yum remove rsh .执行以下命令，删除rsh包
extraDetail.impact: 许多不安全的服务客户端被用作故障排除工具和测试环境。卸载它们会抑制测试和故障排除的能力。如果需要，建议在使用后取出客户端，以防止意外或故意误用。
extraDetail.description_en: The rsh package contains the client commands for the rsh services.
extraDetail.rationale_en: These legacy clients contain numerous security exposures and have been replaced with the more secure SSH package. Even if the server is removed, it is best to ensure the clients are also removed to prevent users from inadvertently attempting to use these commands and therefore exposing their credentials. Note that removing the rsh package removes the clients for rsh , rcp and rlogin .
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the rsh package is not installed: # rpm -q rsh  package rsh is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the rsh package: # yum remove rsh
extraDetail.impact_en: Many insecure service clients are used as troubleshooting tools and in testing environments. Uninstalling them can inhibit capability to test and troubleshoot. If they are required it is advisable to remove the clients after use to prevent accidental or intentional misuse.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure talk client is not installed
detail_zh: 确保谈话客户端没有安装

extraDetail.description: 会话软件使用户能够通过终端会话跨系统发送和接收消息。默认情况下安装了允许初始化会话的会话客户端。
extraDetail.rationale: 该软件使用未加密的协议进行通信，存在安全风险。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查talk包是否安装。# rpm -q talk package talk未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除talk包。# yum remove talk
extraDetail.impact: 许多不安全的服务客户端被用作故障排除工具和测试环境。卸载它们会抑制测试和故障排除的能力。如果需要，建议在使用后取出客户端，以防止意外或故意误用。
extraDetail.description_en: The talk software makes it possible for users to send and receive messages across systems through a terminal session. The talk client, which allows initialization of talk sessions, is installed by default.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The software presents a security risk as it uses unencrypted protocols for communication.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the talk package is not installed: # rpm -q talk  package talk is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the talk package: # yum remove talk
extraDetail.impact_en: Many insecure service clients are used as troubleshooting tools and in testing environments. Uninstalling them can inhibit capability to test and troubleshoot. If they are required it is advisable to remove the clients after use to prevent accidental or intentional misuse.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure telnet client is not installed

extraDetail.description: telnet包包含telnet客户端，允许用户通过telnet协议启动与其他系统的连接。
extraDetail.rationale: telnet协议是不安全的、未加密的协议。使用未加密的传输介质可能允许未经授权的用户窃取凭证。ssh包提供了加密的会话和更强的安全性，并且包含在大多数Linux发行版中。
extraDetail.audit: # rpm -q telnet package telnet未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，删除telnet包。# yum remove telnet
extraDetail.impact: 许多不安全的服务客户端被用作故障排除工具和测试环境。卸载它们会抑制测试和故障排除的能力。如果需要，建议在使用后取出客户端，以防止意外或故意误用。
extraDetail.description_en: The telnet package contains the telnet client, which allows users to start connections to other systems via the telnet protocol.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The telnet protocol is insecure and unencrypted. The use of an unencrypted transmission medium could allow an unauthorized user to steal credentials. The ssh package provides an encrypted session and stronger security and is included in most Linux distributions.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the telnet package is not installed: # rpm -q telnet  package telnet is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the telnet package: # yum remove telnet
extraDetail.impact_en: Many insecure service clients are used as troubleshooting tools and in testing environments. Uninstalling them can inhibit capability to test and troubleshoot. If they are required it is advisable to remove the clients after use to prevent accidental or intentional misuse.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure LDAP client is not installed

extraDetail.description: 轻量级目录访问协议(LDAP)作为NIS/YP的替代品被引入。它是一种服务，提供从中央数据库查找信息的方法。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果系统不需要作为LDAP客户端，建议将该软件移除，以减少潜在的攻击面。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，检查openldap-clients包是否安装。# rpm -q openldap-clients包未安装
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下命令，移除openldap-clients包。# yum remove openldap-clients
extraDetail.impact: 删除LDAP客户端将阻止或禁止在您的环境中使用LDAP进行身份验证。
extraDetail.description_en: The Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) was introduced as a replacement for NIS/YP. It is a service that provides a method for looking up information from a central database.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the system will not need to act as an LDAP client, it is recommended that the software be removed to reduce the potential attack surface.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command to verify that the openldap-clients package is not installed: # rpm -q openldap-clients  package openldap-clients is not installed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the openldap-clients package: # yum remove openldap-clients
extraDetail.impact_en: Removing the LDAP client will prevent or inhibit using LDAP for authentication in your environment.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure nonessential services are removed or masked
detail_zh: 确保删除或屏蔽非必要的服务

extraDetail.description: 网络端口由它的编号、相关的IP地址和通信协议的类型(如TCP或UDP)来标识。监听端口是应用程序或进程监听的网络端口，充当通信端点。每个监听端口可以通过防火墙打开或关闭(过滤)。一般来说，开放端口是接受来自远程位置的传入数据包的网络端口。
extraDetail.rationale: 系统上侦听的服务作为攻击载体存在潜在风险。应该审查这些服务，如果不需要，应该停止服务，并且应该删除包含该服务的包。如果需要的包具有依赖关系，则应停止服务并屏蔽服务，以减少系统的攻击面
extraDetail.audit: 执行如下命令:# lsof -i -P -n | grep -v "(ESTABLISHED)"检查输出以确保列出的所有服务都是系统所需要的。如果列出的某个服务不是必需的，请删除包含该服务的包。如果需要使用包含该服务的包，请停止并屏蔽该服务
extraDetail.remediation: # yum remove <package_name> OR如果需要的包有依赖关系:执行以下命令停止并屏蔽服务
extraDetail.description_en: A network port is identified by its number, the associated IP address, and the type of the communication protocol such as TCP or UDP. A listening port is a network port on which an application or process listens on, acting as a communication endpoint. Each listening port can be open or closed (filtered) using a firewall. In general terms, an open port is a network port that accepts incoming packets from remote locations.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Services listening on the system pose a potential risk as an attack vector. These services should be reviewed, and if not required, the service should be stopped, and the package containing the service should be removed. If required packages have a dependency, the service should be stopped and masked to reduce the attack surface of the system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following command: # lsof -i -P -n | grep -v "(ESTABLISHED)" Review the output to ensure that all services listed are required on the system. If a listed service is not required, remove the package containing the service. If the package containing the service is required, stop and mask the service
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following command to remove the package containing the service: # yum remove <package_name> OR If required packages have a dependency: Run the following command to stop and mask the service: # systemctl --now mask <service_name>

creator: system
title_en: Disable unused network protocols and devices
title_zh: 禁用未使用的网络协议和设备
detail_en: Disable IPv6

extraDetail.description: 尽管IPv6比相较于IPv4有很多优势，但并非所有组织都实现了IPv6或双栈配置。
extraDetail.rationale: 在不使用IPv6或双栈的情况下，建议关闭IPv6功能，减少系统的攻击面。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，验证是否使用了以下方法中的一种来禁用IPv6。如果通过GRUB2配置禁用了IPv6:执行以下命令，验证不返回任何行。# grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1 如果通过sysctl设置禁用了IPv6:执行以下命令:# sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all。disable_ipv6 net.ipv6.conf.all。sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1 # sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1 # grep -E '^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.(all|default)\.disable_ipv6\s*= 1\b(\s+#.*)?* /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf | cut -d: -f2 net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1 net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1
extraDetail.remediation: 使用以下两种方法之一在系统上禁用 IPv6：通过 GRUB2 配置禁用 IPv6：编辑 /etc/default/grub 并在 GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX 参数中添加 ipv6.disable=1：GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX = "ipv6.disable=1"   执行以下命令以更新 grub2 配置：# grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg  或通过 sysctl 设置禁用 IPv6：在 /etc/sysctl.conf 或 /etc/sysctl.d/* 文件中设置以下参数：net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1，net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1  执行以下命令以设置活动内核参数：# sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.route.flush = 1
extraDetail.impact: 如果通过sysctl配置禁用IPv6, SSH X11forwarding可能不再正常工作。我们建议禁用SSH X11forwarding，但是如果需要，以下内容将允许通过sysctl配置禁用IPv6的SSH X11forwarding。在/etc/ssh/sshd_config文件中添加以下一行:AddressFamily inet  执行以下命令重新启动openSSH服务器:# systemctl restart sshd
extraDetail.description_en: Although IPv6 has many advantages over IPv4, not all organizations have IPv6 or dual stack configurations implemented.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If IPv6 or dual stack is not to be used, it is recommended that IPv6 be disabled to reduce the attack surface of the system.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands to verify that one of the following methods has been used to disable IPv6: IF IPv6 is disabled through the GRUB2 config: Run the following command and verify no lines should be returned. #  grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1 OR IF IPv6 is disabled through sysctl settings: Run the following commands: # sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6  net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1 # sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6  net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1 # grep -E '^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.(all|default)\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf | cut -d: -f2  net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1 net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1
extraDetail.remediation_en: Use one of the two following methods to disable IPv6 on the system: To disable IPv6 through the GRUB2 config: Edit /etc/default/grub and add ipv6.disable=1 to the GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX parameters: GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="ipv6.disable=1" Ru the following command to update the grub2 configuration: # grub2-mkconfig –o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg OR To disable IPv6 through sysctl settings: Set the following parameters in /etc/sysctl.conf or a /etc/sysctl.d/* file: net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1 net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1 Run the following commands to set the active kernel parameters: # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=1 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6=1 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.route.flush=1
extraDetail.impact_en: If IPv6 is disabled through sysctl config, SSH X11forwarding may no longer function as expected. We recommend that SSH X11fowarding be disabled, but if required, the following will allow for SSH X11forwarding with IPv6 disabled through sysctl config: Add the following line the /etc/ssh/sshd_config file: AddressFamily inet Run the following command to re-start the openSSH server: # systemctl restart sshd

creator: system
title_en: Disable unused network protocols and devices
title_zh: 禁用未使用的网络协议和设备
detail_en: Ensure wireless interfaces are disabled

extraDetail.description: 在有线网络不可用时使用无线网络。
extraDetail.rationale: 如果不使用无线，应禁用无线设备，以减少潜在的攻击面。
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下脚本验证系统上没有活动的无线接口:#!/bin/bash  if command -v nmcli >/dev/null 2>&1 ; then    if nmcli radio all | grep -Eq '\s*\S+\s+disabled\s+\S+\s+disabled\b'; then       echo "Wireless is not enabled"    else        nmcli radio all    fi elif [ -n "$(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless)" ]; then    t=0    mname=$(for driverdir in $(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless | xargs -0 dirname); do basename "$(readlink -f "$driverdir"/device/driver/module)";done | sort -u)    for dm in $mname; do       if grep -Eq "^\s*install\s+$dm\s+/bin/(true|false)" /etc/modprobe.d/*.conf; then          /bin/true       else          echo "$dm is not disabled"          t=1       fi    done    [ "$t" -eq 0 ] && echo "Wireless is not enabled" else    echo "Wireless is not enabled" fi   输出应为: Wireless is not enabled
extraDetail.remediation: 执行以下脚本禁用任何无线接口:#!/bin/bash  if command -v nmcli >/dev/null 2>&1 ; then    nmcli radio all off else    if [ -n "$(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless)" ]; then       mname=$(for driverdir in $(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless | xargs -0 dirname); do basename "$(readlink -f "$driverdir"/device/driver/module)";done | sort -u)       for dm in $mname; do          echo "install $dm /bin/true" >> /etc/modprobe.d/disable_wireless.conf       done    fi fi
extraDetail.impact: 许多笔记本电脑工作站和一些桌面工作站将通过无线连接，因此需要启用这些接口。
extraDetail.description_en: Wireless networking is used when wired networks are unavailable.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If wireless is not to be used, wireless devices should be disabled to reduce the potential attack surface.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following script to verify no wireless interfaces are active on the system: #!/bin/bash  if command -v nmcli >/dev/null 2>&1 ; then    if nmcli radio all | grep -Eq '\s*\S+\s+disabled\s+\S+\s+disabled\b'; then       echo "Wireless is not enabled"    else        nmcli radio all    fi elif [ -n "$(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless)" ]; then    t=0    mname=$(for driverdir in $(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless | xargs -0 dirname); do basename "$(readlink -f "$driverdir"/device/driver/module)";done | sort -u)    for dm in $mname; do       if grep -Eq "^\s*install\s+$dm\s+/bin/(true|false)" /etc/modprobe.d/*.conf; then          /bin/true       else          echo "$dm is not disabled"          t=1       fi    done    [ "$t" -eq 0 ] && echo "Wireless is not enabled" else    echo "Wireless is not enabled" fi Output should be: Wireless is not enabled
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following script to disable any wireless interfaces: #!/bin/bash  if command -v nmcli >/dev/null 2>&1 ; then    nmcli radio all off else    if [ -n "$(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless)" ]; then       mname=$(for driverdir in $(find /sys/class/net/*/ -type d -name wireless | xargs -0 dirname); do basename "$(readlink -f "$driverdir"/device/driver/module)";done | sort -u)       for dm in $mname; do          echo "install $dm /bin/true" >> /etc/modprobe.d/disable_wireless.conf       done    fi fi
extraDetail.impact_en: Many if not all laptop workstations and some desktop workstations will connect via wireless requiring these interfaces be enabled.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure IP forwarding is disabled

extraDetail.description: net.ipv4.ip_forward和net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding标志用来告诉系统是否可以转发数据包
extraDetail.rationale: 将标志设置为0可以确保具有多个接口的系统(例如硬代理)永远不能转发数据包，因此永远不能作为路由器
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令并验证输入是否匹配: 执行# sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward  输出net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0 执行# grep -E -s "^\s*net\.ipv4\.ip_forward\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf 不应返回任何值   如果IPv6启用，执行以下命令并验证输出是否匹配: 执行 # sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding  输出 net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding = 0 执行# grep -E -s "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.forwarding\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  不应返回任何值  或是验证IPv6是否已禁用: 执行以下脚本.如果系统上禁用了IPv6，则将会输出确认结果. #!/bin/bash  [ -n "$passing" ] && passing="" [ -z "$(grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1)" ] && passing="true" grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" /etc/sysctl.conf \ /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" \ /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && \ sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && passing="true" if [ "$passing" = true ] ; then  echo "IPv6 is disabled on the system" else  echo "IPv6 is enabled on the system" fi
extraDetail.remediation: 执行一下命令恢复默认参数并设置活动内核参数 # grep -Els "^\s*net\.ipv4\.ip_forward\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf | while read filename; do sed -ri "s/^\s*(net\.ipv4\.ip_forward\s*)(=)(\s*\S+\b).*$/# *REMOVED* \1/" $filename; done; sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=0; sysctl -w net.ipv4.route.flush=1 # grep -Els "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.forwarding\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf | while read filename; do sed -ri "s/^\s*(net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.forwarding\s*)(=)(\s*\S+\b).*$/# *REMOVED* \1/" $filename; done; sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0; sysctl -w net.ipv6.route.flush=1
extraDetail.description_en: The net.ipv4.ip_forward and net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding flags are used to tell the system whether it can forward packets or not.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting the flags to 0 ensures that a system with multiple interfaces (for example, a hard proxy), will never be able to forward packets, and therefore, never serve as a router
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify output matches: # sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward  net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0 # grep -E -s "^\s*net\.ipv4\.ip_forward\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  No value should be returned IFIPv6 is enabled: Run the following commands and verify output matches: # sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding  net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding = 0 # grep -E -s "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.forwarding\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  No value should be returned OR Verify that IPv6 is disabled: Run the following script. Output will confirm if IPv6 is disabled on the system. #!/bin/bash  [ -n "$passing" ] && passing="" [ -z "$(grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1)" ] && passing="true" grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" /etc/sysctl.conf \ /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" \ /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && \ sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && passing="true" if [ "$passing" = true ] ; then  echo "IPv6 is disabled on the system" else  echo "IPv6 is enabled on the system" fi
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run the following commands to restore the default parameters and set the active kernel parameters: # grep -Els "^\s*net\.ipv4\.ip_forward\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf | while read filename; do sed -ri "s/^\s*(net\.ipv4\.ip_forward\s*)(=)(\s*\S+\b).*$/# *REMOVED* \1/" $filename; done; sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=0; sysctl -w net.ipv4.route.flush=1 # grep -Els "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.forwarding\s*=\s*1" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf | while read filename; do sed -ri "s/^\s*(net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.forwarding\s*)(=)(\s*\S+\b).*$/# *REMOVED* \1/" $filename; done; sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0; sysctl -w net.ipv6.route.flush=1

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure packet redirect sending is disabled
detail_zh: 确保报文重定向发送是禁用的

extraDetail.description: ICMP重定向用于向其他主机发送路由信息。由于主机本身不充当路由器(仅在主机配置中)，因此无需发送重定向。
extraDetail.rationale: 攻击者可以使用被入侵的主机向其他路由器设备发送无效的ICMP重定向，试图破坏路由，并让用户访问攻击者设置的系统，而不是有效的系统
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，验证输出是否匹配: 执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0 执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.all\.send_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0 执行# grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.default\.send_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects= 0”“net\.ipv4\.conf\.default\.send_redirects”/etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf 应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects= 0
extraDetail.remediation: 在 /etc/sysctl.conf 或 /etc/sysctl.d/* 文件中设置以下参数：net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0 net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 0 执行以下命令设置活动内核参数：# sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.route.flush=1
extraDetail.description_en: ICMP Redirects are used to send routing information to other hosts. As a host itself does not act as a router (in a host only configuration), there is no need to send redirects.
extraDetail.rationale_en: An attacker could use a compromised host to send invalid ICMP redirects to other router devices in an attempt to corrupt routing and have users access a system set up by the attacker as opposed to a valid system
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the following commands and verify output matches: # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects  net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects  net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 0 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.all\.send_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.default\.send_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects= 0
extraDetail.remediation_en: Set the following parameters in /etc/sysctl.conf or a /etc/sysctl.d/* file: net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0 net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 0 Run the following commands to set the active kernel parameters: # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.route.flush=1

creator: system
title_zh: 网络参数 (主机和路由器)
detail_en: Ensure source routed packets are not accepted
detail_zh: 确保源路由数据包不被接受

extraDetail.description: 在网络中，源路由允许发送方部分或全部指定数据包通过网络路由。相比之下，非源路由数据包的路径由网络中的路由器决定。在某些情况下，系统可能无法从某些位置路由或到达(例如私有地址vs互联网路由)，因此需要使用源路由包。
extraDetail.rationale: 将net.ipv4.conf.all.Accept_source_route, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route, net.ipv6.conf.all.Accept_source_route和net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route设置为0表示可以禁止系统接受源路由包。假设该系统能够通过一个接口路由到可从互联网路由的地址，通过另一个接口路由到私有地址。假设私有地址不能路由到Internet可路由地址，反之亦然。在正常路由情况下，来自可从互联网路由的地址的攻击者不能使用该系统到达私有地址系统。但是，如果允许源路由包，则可以使用它们来访问私有地址系统，因为可以指定路由，而不是依赖于不允许这种路由的路由协议
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，验证输出是否匹配: 执行# sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0 执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.all\.accept_source_route" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route= 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.default\.accept_source_route" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route= 0 如果IPv6启: 执行一下命令验证输出是否匹配: 执行 # sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route  应输出 net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0 执行# sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route  应输出net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0 执行# grep "net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.accept_source_route" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route= 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.accept_source_route" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route= 0 或是验证IPv6是否已禁用: 执行以下脚本.如果系统上禁用了IPv6，则将会输出确认结果。  #!/bin/bash  [ -n "$passing" ] && passing="" [ -z "$(grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1)" ] && passing="true" grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" /etc/sysctl.conf \ /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" \ /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && \ sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && passing="true" if [ "$passing" = true ] ; then  echo "IPv6 is disabled on the system" else  echo "IPv6 is enabled on the system" fi
extraDetail.remediation: 在 /etc/sysctl.conf 或 /etc/sysctl.d/* 文件中设置以下参数: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0 net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0 执行以下命令以设置活动内核参数: # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.route.flush=1 如果未禁用 IPv6: 在 /etc/sysctl.conf 或 /etc/sysctl.d/* 文件中设置以下参数：: net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0 net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0 执行以下命令以设置活动内核参数: # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.route.flush=1
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route, net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route and net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route to 0 disables the system from accepting source routed packets. Assume this system was capable of routing packets to Internet routable addresses on one interface and private addresses on another interface. Assume that the private addresses were not routable to the Internet routable addresses and vice versa. Under normal routing circumstances, an attacker from the Internet routable addresses could not use the system as a way to reach the private address systems. If, however, source routed packets were allowed, they could be used to gain access to the private address systems as the route could be specified, rather than rely on routing protocols that did not allow this routing

detail_en: Ensure ICMP redirects are not accepted

extraDetail.description: ICMP重定向消息是传递路由信息的数据包，并告诉您的主机(充当路由器)通过备用路径发送数据包。它是一种允许外部路由设备更新系统路由表的方法。将net.ipv4.conf.all.Accept_redirects和net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects设置为0时，系统将不接受任何ICMP重定向消息，因此，不允许外部人员更新系统的路由表。
extraDetail.rationale: 攻击者可以使用伪造的ICMP重定向消息恶意更改系统路由表，使它们将数据包发送到错误的网络，并允许捕获您的系统数据包
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，验证输出是否匹配: 执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0 执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.all\.accept_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects= 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.default\.accept_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects= 0 如果未禁用IPv6: 执行以下命令，验证输出是否匹配:  执行# sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects  应输出 net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0  执行# sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects  应输出 net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.accept_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects= 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.accept_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects= 0 或是验证IPv6是否已禁用: 执行以下脚本.如果系统上禁用了IPv6，则将会输出确认IPv6是否在系统上被禁用 #!/bin/bash  [ -n "$passing" ] && passing="" [ -z "$(grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1)" ] && passing="true" grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" /etc/sysctl.conf \ /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" \ /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && \ sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && passing="true" if [ "$passing" = true ] ; then    echo "IPv6 is disabled on the system" else    echo "IPv6 is enabled on the system" fi
extraDetail.remediation: 在 /etc/sysctl.conf 或 /etc/sysctl.d/* 文件中设置以下参数: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0 net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0 R执行以下命令以设置活动内核参数: # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv4.route.flush=1 如果未禁用 IPv6：在 /etc/sysctl.conf 或 /etc/sysctl.d/* 文件中设置以下参数: net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0 net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0 执行以下命令以设置活动内核参数: # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects=0 # sysctl -w net.ipv6.route.flush=1
extraDetail.description_en: ICMP redirect messages are packets that convey routing information and tell your host (acting as a router) to send packets via an alternate path. It is a way of allowing an outside routing device to update your system routing tables. By setting net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects and net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects to 0, the system will not accept any ICMP redirect messages, and therefore, won't allow outsiders to update the system's routing tables.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Attackers could use bogus ICMP redirect messages to maliciously alter the system routing tables and get them to send packets to incorrect networks and allow your system packets to be captured

Output will confirm if IPv6 is disabled on the system. #!/bin/bash  [ -n "$passing" ] && passing="" [ -z "$(grep "^\s*linux" /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -v ipv6.disable=1)" ] && passing="true" grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" /etc/sysctl.conf \ /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" \ /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf && sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.all\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && \ sysctl net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 | \ grep -Eq "^\s*net\.ipv6\.conf\.default\.disable_ipv6\s*=\s*1\b(\s+#.*)?$" && passing="true" if [ "$passing" = true ] ; then    echo "IPv6 is disabled on the system" else    echo "IPv6 is enabled on the system" fi

extraDetail.description: 安全ICMP重定向与ICMP重定向相同，只是它们来自默认网关列表中列出的网关。我们假设您的系统知道这些网关，并且很可能是安全的。
extraDetail.rationale: 即使是已知的网关也有可能被破坏。将net.ipv4.conf.all.Secure_redirects设置为0可以保护系统不受可能受到威胁的已知网关更新路由表的影响
extraDetail.audit: 执行以下命令，验证输出是否匹配：执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0 执行 # sysctl net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.all\.secure_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects= 0 执行 # grep "net\.ipv4\.conf\.default\.secure_redirects" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf /usr/lib/sysctl.d/*.conf /run/sysctl.d/*.conf  应输出 net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects= 0

extraDetail.description_en: Secure ICMP redirects are the same as ICMP redirects, except they come from gateways listed on the default gateway list. It is assumed that these gateways are known to your system, and that they are likely to be secure.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is still possible for even known gateways to be compromised. Setting net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects to 0 protects the system from routing table updates by possibly compromised known gateways
