creator: system
detail_en: Ensure audit_backlog_limit is sufficient

extraDetail.description: backlog限制的默认设置为64
extraDetail.rationale: 在引导期间，如果audit=1，那么backlog将包含64条记录。如果在引导期间创建了超过64条记录，则审计记录将丢失，并且可能无法检测到潜在的恶意活动
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本，验证audit_backlog_limit=参数被设置为适合您的组织的大小
#!/bin/bash  # IF check passes return PASSED efidir=$(find /boot/efi/EFI/* -type d -not -name 'BOOT') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') if [ -f "$efidir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grep "^\s*linux" "$efidir"/grub.cfg | grep -Evq "audit_backlog_limit=\S+ " && echo -e "

FAILED" || echo -e "

PASSED:
 "$(grep "audit_backlog_limit=" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg)"" elif [ -f "$gbdir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grep "^\s*linux" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg | grep -Evq "audit_backlog_limit=\S+ " && echo -e "

FAILED" || echo -e "

PASSED:
 "$(grep "audit_backlog_limit=" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg)"" else    echo "FAILED" fi 
确保返回值符合本端策略。建议该值为8192或更大。
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑/etc/default/grub，在GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX中增加audit_backlog_limit=<BACKLOG SIZE>。
例如: 
GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit_backlog_limit=8192" 
执行以下命令，更新grub2配置 
# grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg
extraDetail.description_en: The backlog limit has a default setting of 64
extraDetail.rationale_en: During boot if audit=1, then the backlog will hold 64 records. If more than 64 records are created during boot, auditd records will be lost and potential malicious activity could go undetected

Run the following script to verify the audit_backlog_limit= parameter is set to an appropriate size for your organization 
#!/bin/bash  # IF check passes return PASSED efidir=$(find /boot/efi/EFI/* -type d -not -name 'BOOT') gbdir=$(find /boot -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'grub*') if [ -f "$efidir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grep "^\s*linux" "$efidir"/grub.cfg | grep -Evq "audit_backlog_limit=\S+ " && echo -e "

 "$(grep "audit_backlog_limit=" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg)"" elif [ -f "$gbdir"/grub.cfg ]; then    grep "^\s*linux" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg | grep -Evq "audit_backlog_limit=\S+ " && echo -e "

 "$(grep "audit_backlog_limit=" "$gbdir"/grub.cfg)"" else    echo "FAILED" fi

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure events that modify date and time information are collected
detail_zh: 确保收集了修改日期和时间信息的事件

extraDetail.description: 捕获修改了系统日期和/或时间的事件。本节中的参数用于确定是否执行了adjtimex(调整内核时钟)，settimeofday(设置时间，使用timeval和timezone结构)stime(使用从1/1/1970年开始的秒数)或clock_settime(允许设置几个内部时钟和计时器)系统调用，并且在退出时总是将审计记录写入/var/log/audit.log文件，并将记录标记为“time-change”。重新加载auditd配置以设置活动设置需要重新启动auditd服务，并且可能需要重新引导系统。
extraDetail.rationale: 系统日期和/或时间的意外更改可能是系统上存在恶意活动的迹象
extraDetail.audit:
在32位系统上运行以下命令: 
# grep time-change /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep time-change 
验证都匹配的输出: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change 
在64位系统上运行以下命令: 
# grep time-change /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep time-change 
验证都匹配的输出: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change
extraDetail.remediation:
对于32位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件:
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-time_change.rules
 增加以下几行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change 
对于64位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件: 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-time_change.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change
extraDetail.description_en:
Capture events where the system date and/or time has been modified. The parameters in this section are set to determine if the adjtimex (tune kernel clock), settimeofday (Set time, using timeval and timezone structures) stime (using seconds since 1/1/1970) or clock_settime (allows for the setting of several internal clocks and timers) system calls have been executed and always write an audit record to the /var/log/audit.log file upon exit, tagging the records with the identifier "time-change" 
Note: Reloading the auditd config to set active settings requires the auditd service to be restarted, and may require a system reboot
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unexpected changes in system date and/or time could be a sign of malicious activity on the system
extraDetail.audit_en:
On a 32 bit system run the following commands: 
# grep time-change /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep time-change 
Verify output of both matches: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change 
On a 64 bit system run the following commands: 
# grep time-change /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep time-change 
Verify output of both matches: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change
extraDetail.remediation_en:
For 32 bit systems Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-time_change.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change 
For 64 bit systems Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-time_change.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S stime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S clock_settime -k time-change 
-w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure events that modify user/group information are collected
detail_zh: 确保已收集修改用户/组信息的事件

extraDetail.description: 记录影响组、passwd(用户id)、shadow和gshadow(密码)或/etc/security/opasswd(旧密码，根据PAM配置中的remember参数)文件的事件。本节中的参数将监视文件，以查看它们是否已被打开用于写入或已发生属性更改(例如权限)，并在审计日志文件中用标识符“identity”标记它们。注意:重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新引导系统。
extraDetail.rationale: 对这些文件的意外更改可能表明系统已遭到破坏，并且未经授权的用户正试图隐藏其活动或破坏其他帐户
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令查看审计过的.rules文件:
 # grep identity /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-w /etc/group -p wa -k identity -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity 
-w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity 
-w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity 
-w /etc/security/opasswd -p wa -k identity 
查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep identity 
验证输出是否匹配:  
-w /etc/group -p wa -k identity 
-w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity 
-w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity

extraDetail.description:

注意:重新加载auditd配置以设置活动设置需要重新启动auditd服务，并且可能需要重新引导系统。
extraDetail.rationale: 监视sethostname和setdomainname将识别对系统主机和域名的潜在未经授权的更改。更改这些名称可能会破坏基于这些名称设置的安全参数。监视/etc/hosts文件中可能表明未经授权的入侵者试图更改与IP地址的计算机关联并欺骗用户和进程连接到非预期的计算机的更改。监视/etc/issue和/etc/issue.net非常重要，因为入侵者可能会在这些文件中放入虚假信息，诱使用户向入侵者提供信息。监视/etc/sysconfig/network非常重要，因为它可以显示网络接口或脚本是否被修改，从而导致计算机不可用或受到威胁。所有审计记录都将被标记为标识符“system-locale”

-w /etc/issue.net -p wa -k system-locale

-w /etc/sysconfig/network -p wa -k system-locale

-w /etc/issue.net -p wa -k system-locale

-w /etc/sysconfig/network -p wa -k system-locale
extraDetail.description_en: Record changes to network environment files or system calls. The below parameters monitor the sethostname (set the systems host name) or setdomainname (set the systems domainname) system calls, and write an audit event on system call exit. The other parameters monitor the /etc/issue and /etc/issue.net files (messages displayed pre-login), /etc/hosts (file containing host names and associated IP addresses) and /etc/sysconfig/network (directory containing network interface scripts and configurations) files. Note: Reloading the auditd config to set active settings requires the auditd service to be restarted, and may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Monitoring sethostname and setdomainname will identify potential unauthorized changes to host and domainname of a system. The changing of these names could potentially break security parameters that are set based on those names. The /etc/hosts file is monitored for changes in the file that can indicate an unauthorized intruder is trying to change machine associations with IP addresses and trick users and processes into connecting to unintended machines. Monitoring /etc/issue and /etc/issue.net is important, as intruders could put disinformation into those files and trick users into providing information to the intruder. Monitoring /etc/sysconfig/network is important as it can show if network interfaces or scripts are being modified in a way that can lead to the machine becoming unavailable or compromised. All audit records will be tagged with the identifier "system-locale."

-w /etc/issue.net -p wa -k system-locale 
-w /etc/hosts -p wa -k system-locale 
-w /etc/sysconfig/network -p wa -k system-locale

Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-system_local.rules

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure events that modify the system's Mandatory Access Controls are collected
detail_zh: 确保已收集修改系统强制访问控制的事件

extraDetail.description:
监视SELinux强制访问控制。下面的参数监视对/etc/selinux/和/usr/share/selinux/目录的任何写访问(可能增加、删除或修改目录中的文件)或属性更改
注意:

重新加载auditd配置以设置活动设置需要重新启动auditd服务，并且可能需要重新引导系统
extraDetail.rationale: 对/etc/selinux/和/usr/share/selinux/目录中的文件的更改可能表明未经授权的用户正在试图修改访问控制和更改安全上下文，从而导致系统受到损害
extraDetail.audit:

extraDetail.description_en:
Monitor SELinux mandatory access controls. The parameters below monitor any write access (potential additional, deletion or modification of files in the directory) or attribute changes to the /etc/selinux/ and /usr/share/selinux/ directories. Note: 
 If a different Mandatory Access Control method is used, changes to the corresponding directories should be audited. 
 Reloading the auditd config to set active settings requires the auditd service to be restarted, and may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Changes to files in the /etc/selinux/ and /usr/share/selinux/ directories could indicate that an unauthorized user is attempting to modify access controls and change security contexts, leading to a compromise of the system
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following commands: 
# grep MAC-policy /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep MAC-policy 
Verify output of both matches: 
-w /etc/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy 
-w /usr/share/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-MAC_policy.rules 
Add the following lines:

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure login and logout events are collected
detail_zh: 确保收集了登录和注销事件

extraDetail.description:
监视登录和注销事件。下面的参数跟踪与登录/注销事件相关的文件的更改。
“/var/log/lastlog”文件保存用户最后一次成功登录的记录。
—“/var/run/faillock/”目录通过pam_faillock模块保存登录失败的记录。
注意:重新加载auditd配置以设置活动设置需要重新启动auditd服务，并且可能需要重新引导系统
extraDetail.rationale: 监视登录/注销事件可以为系统管理员提供与针对用户登录的暴力攻击相关的信息
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令:
# grep logins /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep logins 
验证两者的输出包括: 
-w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k logins
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-logins.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k logins
extraDetail.description_en:
Monitor login and logout events. The parameters below track changes to files associated with login/logout events. 
The file /var/log/lastlog maintain records of the last time a user successfully logged in. 
 The /var/run/faillock/ directory maintains records of login failures via the pam_faillock module. 
Note: Reloading the auditd config to set active settings requires the auditd service to be restarted, and may require a system reboot
extraDetail.rationale_en: Monitoring login/logout events could provide a system administrator with information associated with brute force attacks against user logins
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following commands: 
# grep logins /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
# auditctl -l | grep logins 
Verify output of both includes: 
-w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k logins
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-logins.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k logins

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure session initiation information is collected
detail_zh: 确保收集了会话启动信息

extraDetail.description:
监视会话启动事件。本节中的参数跟踪与会话事件相关的文件的更改。文件/var/run/utmp跟踪所有当前登录的用户。所有审计记录都将被标记为标识符“session”。/var/log/wtmp文件跟踪登录、注销、关机和重新引导事件。/var/log/btmp文件记录了失败的登录尝试，可以通过输入命令/usr/bin/last -f /var/log/btmp读取。所有审计记录都将被标记为标识符“login”。
注:
最后一个命令可以读取/var/log/wtmp (last，不带参数)和/var/run/utmp (last -f /var/run/utmp)
重新加载auditd配置以设置活动设置需要重新启动auditd服务，并且可能需要重新引导系统
extraDetail.rationale: 监视这些文件的更改可以提醒系统管理员在异常时间发生登录，这可能表明有入侵者活动(即用户在不正常登录的时间登录)
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令检查auditd .rules文件:
# grep -E '(session|logins)' /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出包括: 
-w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session 
-w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep -E '(session|logins)' 
验证输出包括: 
-w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session 
-w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-session.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session 
-w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins -w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins
extraDetail.description_en: Monitor session initiation events. The parameters in this section track changes to the files associated with session events. The file /var/run/utmp tracks all currently logged in users. All audit records will be tagged with the identifier "session." The /var/log/wtmp file tracks logins, logouts, shutdown, and reboot events. The file /var/log/btmp keeps track of failed login attempts and can be read by entering the command /usr/bin/last -f /var/log/btmp . All audit records will be tagged with the identifier "logins." Notes:  The last command can be used to read /var/log/wtmp (last with no parameters) and /var/run/utmp (last -f /var/run/utmp)   Reloading the auditd config to set active settings requires the auditd service to be restarted, and may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Monitoring these files for changes could alert a system administrator to logins occurring at unusual hours, which could indicate intruder activity (i.e. a user logging in at a time when they do not normally log in)
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command to check the auditd .rules files: 
# grep -E '(session|logins)' /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
Verify output includes: 
-w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session 
-w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins 
Run the following command to check loaded auditd rules: 
# auditctl -l | grep -E '(session|logins)' 
Verify output includes: 
-w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session 
-w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins 
-w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-session.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session 
-w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins -w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure discretionary access control permission modification events are collected
detail_zh: 确保收集任意访问控制权限修改事件

extraDetail.description: 监视文件权限、属性、所有权和组的更改。本节中的参数跟踪影响文件权限和属性的系统调用的更改。chmod、fchmod和fchmodat系统调用影响与文件相关的权限。chown、fchown、fchownat和lchown系统调用会影响文件的所有者和组属性。setxattr, lsetxattr, fsetxattr(设置扩展文件属性)和removexattr, lremovexattr, fremovexattr(删除扩展文件属性)控制扩展文件属性。在所有情况下，只会为非系统用户id (auid >=1000)写入审计记录，并且将忽略Daemon事件(auid = 4294967295)。所有审计记录都将被标记为标识符“perm_mod”。注意:系统可能已经被定制以更改默认的UID_MIN。要确认您系统的UID_MIN，请执行以下命令:# awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs如果您系统的UID_MIN不是1000，请在审计和补救程序中将审计>=<UID_MIN替换为审计>=1000。重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新启动系统
extraDetail.rationale: 监视文件属性的更改可以提醒系统管理员注意可能指示入侵者活动或违反策略的活动
extraDetail.audit:

验证输出是否匹配:  
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod -S fchmod -S fchmodat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chown -S fchown -S fchownat -S lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S setxattr -S lsetxattr -S fsetxattr -S removexattr -S lremovexattr -S fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep perm_mod 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S lchown,fchown,chown,fchownat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod 
在64位系统上运行以下命令:

验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod -S fchmod -S fchmodat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod -S fchmod -S fchmodat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chown -S fchown -S fchownat -S lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chown -S fchown -S fchownat -S lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S setxattr -S lsetxattr -S fsetxattr -S removexattr -S lremovexattr -S fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S setxattr -S lsetxattr -S fsetxattr -S removexattr -S lremovexattr -S fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k perm_mod 
查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep auditctl -l | grep perm_mod 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S -F key=perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S -F key=perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod chmod,fchmod,fchmodat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 chmod,fchmod,fchmodat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 chown,fchown,lchown,fchownat -F auid>=1000 -F lchown,fchown,chown,fchownat -F auid>=1000 -F 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=perm_mod
extraDetail.remediation:
对于32位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-perm_mod.rules

extraDetail.description_en:
Monitor changes to file permissions, attributes, ownership and group. The parameters in this section track changes for system calls that affect file permissions and attributes. The chmod , fchmod and fchmodat system calls affect the permissions associated with a file. The chown , fchown , fchownat and lchown system calls affect owner and group attributes on a file. The setxattr , lsetxattr , fsetxattr (set extended file attributes) and removexattr , lremovexattr , fremovexattr (remove extended file attributes) control extended file attributes. In all cases, an audit record will only be written for non-system user ids (auid >=1000) and will ignore Daemon events (auid = 4294967295). All audit records will be tagged with the identifier "perm_mod." 
Note: Systems may have been customized to change the default UID_MIN. To confirm the UID_MIN for your system, run the following command: 
# awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs 
If your systems' UID_MIN is not 1000, replace audit>=1000 with audit>=<UID_MIN for your system> in the Audit and Remediation procedures. 
Reloading the auditd config to set active settings may require a system reboot
extraDetail.rationale_en: Monitoring for changes in file attributes could alert a system administrator to activity that could indicate intruder activity or policy violation

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure use of privileged commands is collected
detail_zh: 确保收集特权命令的使用

extraDetail.description: 监视特权程序(那些在执行时设置了setuid和/或setgid位的程序)，以确定非特权用户是否正在运行这些命令。注意:系统可能已经被定制以更改默认的UID_MIN。要确认您系统的UID_MIN，请执行以下命令:# awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs如果您系统的UID_MIN不是1000，请在审计和补救程序中将审计>=<UID_MIN替换为审计>=1000。重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新启动系统
extraDetail.rationale: Execution of privileged commands by non-privileged users could be an indication of someone trying to gain unauthorized access to the system
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令，将<partition>替换为可以在系统上执行程序的分区列表: 
# find <partition> -xdev \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -type f | awk '{print "-a always,exit -F path=" $1 " -F perm=x -F auid>='"$(awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)"' -F auid!=4294967295 -k privileged" }' 
验证所有结果行都是/etc/audit/rules.d/中的.rules文件和auditctl -l的输出 
注意:.rules文件输出将是auid!=-1 not auid!= 4294967295
extraDetail.remediation:
为了解决这个问题，系统管理员必须执行find命令来查找所有特权程序，然后为每个特权程序添加审计行。
与此相关的审计参数如下:
- f path=" $1 " -将填充通过find命令找到并由awk处理的每个文件名
- f perm=x -如果执行了文件，则写入审计记录。
- f audit>=1000 -如果执行该命令的用户不是特权用户，则写入记录。
-F auid!= 4294967295 -将忽略Daemon事件
所有审计记录都应该标记为“privileged”标识符。
运行以下命令，替换为一个分区列表，其中程序可以从您的系统上执行:
# find <partition> -xdev \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -type f | awk '{print "-a always,exit -F path=" $1 " -F perm=x -F auid>='"$(awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)"' -F auid!=4294967295 -k privileged" }' 
在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录中编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件，并将所有结果行添加到该文件中
例如:
# find / -xdev \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -type f | awk '{print "-a always,exit -F path=" $1 " -F perm=x -F auid>='"$(awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)"' -F auid!=4294967295 -k privileged" }' >> /etc/audit/rules.d/50-privileged.rules
extraDetail.description_en: Monitor privileged programs (those that have the setuid and/or setgid bit set on execution) to determine if unprivileged users are running these commands. Note: Systems may have been customized to change the default UID_MIN. To confirm the UID_MIN for your system, run the following command: # awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs If your systems' UID_MIN is not 1000, replace audit>=1000 with audit>=<UID_MIN for your system> in the Audit and Remediation procedures. Reloading the auditd config to set active settings may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Execution of privileged commands by non-privileged users could be an indication of someone trying to gain unauthorized access to the system
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command replacing <partition> with a list of partitions where programs can be executed from on your system: 
# find <partition> -xdev \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -type f | awk '{print "-a always,exit -F path=" $1 " -F perm=x -F auid>='"$(awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)"' -F auid!=4294967295 -k privileged" }' 
Verify all resulting lines are a .rules file in /etc/audit/rules.d/ and the output of auditctl -l. 
Note: The .rules file output will be auid!=-1 not auid!=4294967295
extraDetail.remediation_en:
To remediate this issue, the system administrator will have to execute a find command to locate all the privileged programs and then add an audit line for each one of them. The audit parameters associated with this are as follows: 
 -F path=" $1 " - will populate each file name found through the find command and processed by awk. 
 -F perm=x - will write an audit record if the file is executed.  -F audit>=1000 - will write a record if the user executing the command is not a privileged user. 
 -F auid!= 4294967295 - will ignore Daemon events 
All audit records should be tagged with the identifier "privileged". 
Run the following command replacing with a list of partitions where programs can be executed from on your system: 
# find <partition> -xdev \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -type f | awk '{print "-a always,exit -F path=" $1 " -F perm=x -F auid>='"$(awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)"' -F auid!=4294967295 -k privileged" }' 
Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules and add all resulting lines to the file. 
Example: 
# find / -xdev \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -type f | awk '{print "-a always,exit -F path=" $1 " -F perm=x -F auid>='"$(awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)"' -F auid!=4294967295 -k privileged" }' >> /etc/audit/rules.d/50-privileged.rules

detail_en: Ensure successful file system mounts are collected
detail_zh: 确保收集成功的文件系统挂载

extraDetail.description: 监视挂载系统调用的使用。mount(和umount)系统调用控制文件系统的挂载和卸载。下面的参数将系统配置为在非特权用户使用mount系统调用时创建审计记录。注意:系统可能已经被定制为更改默认的UID_MIN。要确认您系统的UID_MIN，请执行以下命令:# awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs如果您系统的UID_MIN不是1000，请在审计和补救程序中将审计>=<UID_MIN替换为审计>=1000。重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新启动系统
extraDetail.rationale: 非特权用户将文件系统挂载到系统中是非常罕见的。虽然跟踪挂载命令为系统管理员提供了外部媒体可能已被挂载的证据(基于对挂载源的检查并确认它是一个外部媒体类型)，但它并不能最终表明数据已导出到媒体。希望确定是否导出了数据的系统管理员还必须跟踪成功地打开、创建和截断系统调用，这些调用要求对外部媒体文件系统挂载点下的文件进行写访问。这可以很好地表明发生了写操作。真正证明这一点的唯一方法是跟踪成功的写入到外部媒体。跟踪写系统调用会很快填满审计日志，不建议使用。关于跟踪数据导出到媒体的配置选项的建议超出了本文档的范围
extraDetail.audit:
在32位系统上运行以下命令: 
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件: 
# grep mounts /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep mounts 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k mounts 
在64位系统上运行以下命令: 
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件: 
# grep mounts /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep mounts 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k mounts 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k mounts
extraDetail.remediation:
对于32位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-mounts.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
对于64位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-mounts.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts
extraDetail.description_en: Monitor the use of the mount system call. The mount (and umount ) system call controls the mounting and unmounting of file systems. The parameters below configure the system to create an audit record when the mount system call is used by a non-privileged user Note: Systems may have been customized to change the default UID_MIN. To confirm the UID_MIN for your system, run the following command: # awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs If your systems' UID_MIN is not 1000, replace audit>=1000 with audit>=<UID_MIN for your system> in the Audit and Remediation procedures. Reloading the auditd config to set active settings may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is highly unusual for a non privileged user to mount file systems to the system. While tracking mount commands gives the system administrator evidence that external media may have been mounted (based on a review of the source of the mount and confirming it's an external media type), it does not conclusively indicate that data was exported to the media. System administrators who wish to determine if data were exported, would also have to track successful open , creat and truncate system calls requiring write access to a file under the mount point of the external media file system. This could give a fair indication that a write occurred. The only way to truly prove it, would be to track successful writes to the external media. Tracking write system calls could quickly fill up the audit log and is not recommended. Recommendations on configuration options to track data export to media is beyond the scope of this document

Run the following command to check the auditd .rules files:

Verify output matches: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
Run the following command to check loaded auditd rules: 
# auditctl -l | grep mounts 
Verify output matches: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k mounts 
On a 64 bit system run the following commands: 
Run the following command to check the auditd .rules files: 
# grep mounts /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
Verify output matches: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
Run the following command to check loaded auditd rules: 
# auditctl -l | grep mounts 
Verify output matches: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k mounts 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k mounts
extraDetail.remediation_en:
For 32 bit systems edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-mounts.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts 
For 64 bit systems Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-mounts.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k mounts

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure file deletion events by users are collected
detail_zh: 确保收集用户删除文件的事件

extraDetail.description:
监视与删除或重命名文件和文件属性相关的系统调用的使用。该配置语句设置了对以下系统调用的监控，并使用标识符“delete”标记它们:
unlink—删除文件
- unlinkat-删除一个文件属性
rename-重命名一个文件
renameat—重命名文件属性
注意:系统可能已经被定制以更改默认的UID_MIN。使用实例确认系统的UID_MIN:
awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs
如果您的系统的UID_MIN不是1000，在审计和补救过程中将system>的audit>=1000替换为auditX=YUID_MIN。在审核和补救程序中用audit>=1000替换audit>=<UID_MIN for your system>
重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新启动系统
extraDetail.rationale: 监视来自非特权用户的这些调用可以为系统管理员提供证据，证明正在发生与受保护文件相关的文件和文件属性的不适当删除。虽然此审计选项将查看所有事件，但系统管理员将希望查找正在删除或更改的特定特权文件
extraDetail.audit:
在32位系统上运行以下命令: 
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件: 
# grep delete /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k delete 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep delete 
验证输出是否匹配: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k delete 
在64位系统上运行以下命令: 
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件:

-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k delete

对于32位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-deletion.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k delete 
对于64位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-deletion.rules 
增加以下几行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k delete 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -k delete
extraDetail.description_en: Monitor the use of system calls associated with the deletion or renaming of files and file attributes. This configuration statement sets up monitoring for following system calls and tags them with the identifier "delete":  unlink - remove a file  unlinkat - remove a file attribute  rename - rename a file  renameat - rename a file attribute Note: Systems may have been customized to change the default UID_MIN. To confirm the UID_MIN for your system, run the following command: # awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs If your systems' UID_MIN is not 1000, replace audit>=1000 with audit>=<UID_MIN for your system> in the Audit and Remediation procedures. Reloading the auditd config to set active settings may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Monitoring these calls from non-privileged users could provide a system administrator with evidence that inappropriate removal of files and file attributes associated with protected files is occurring. While this audit option will look at all events, system administrators will want to look for specific privileged files that are being deleted or altered

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure changes to system administration scope (sudoers) is collected
detail_zh: 确保收集对系统管理范围(sudoers)的更改

extraDetail.description: 为系统管理员监视范围更改。如果系统已正确配置为强制系统管理员首先以自己的身份登录，然后使用sudo命令执行特权命令，则可以监视范围内的更改。/etc/sudoers文件或/etc/sudoers. .文件当文件或其属性发生更改时，将写入D目录。注意:重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新引导系统。
extraDetail.rationale: 修改/etc/sudoers文件，或修改/etc/sudoers.D / directory可以指示对系统管理员活动范围进行了未经授权的更改
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件: 
# grep scope /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证匹配的输出: 
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope 
-w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep scope 
Verify output matches: -
w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope 
-w /etc/sudoers.d -p wa -k scope
extraDetail.remediation:
在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-scope.rules 
添加以下行: 
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope 
-w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope
extraDetail.description_en: Monitor scope changes for system administrators. If the system has been properly configured to force system administrators to log in as themselves first and then use the sudo command to execute privileged commands, it is possible to monitor changes in scope. The file /etc/sudoers or a file in the /etc/sudoers.d directory will be written to when the file or its attributes have changed. Note: Reloading the auditd config to set active settings may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Changes in the /etc/sudoers file, or a file in the /etc/sudoers.d/ directory can indicate that an unauthorized change has been made to scope of system administrator activity
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command to check the auditd .rules files: 
# grep scope /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
Verify output of matches: 
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope 
-w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope 
Run the following command to check loaded auditd rules: 
# auditctl -l | grep scope 
Verify output matches: -
w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope 
-w /etc/sudoers.d -p wa -k scope
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-scope.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope 
-w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure system administrator command executions (sudo) are collected
detail_zh: 确保收集系统管理员执行的命令(sudo)

extraDetail.description: Sudo为用户提供执行操作的临时提升权限。监视具有临时提升权限的管理员及其执行的操作
extraDetail.rationale: 创建具有临时提升权限的管理员及其执行的操作的审计日志对于报告至关重要。管理员将希望将写入审计跟踪的事件与写入sudo日志文件的记录相关联，以验证是否执行了未经授权的命令。注意:系统可能已经被定制以更改默认的UID_MIN。要确认您系统的UID_MIN，请执行以下命令:# awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs如果您系统的UID_MIN不是1000，请在审计和补救程序中将审计>=<UID_MIN替换为审计>=1000。重新加载审计配置以设置活动设置可能需要重新启动系统
extraDetail.audit:
在32位系统中，执行以下命令: 
执行以下命令，检查规则是否包含在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下的.rules文件中: 
# grep actions /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出包括: 
/etc/audit/rules.d/cis.rules:-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -C euid!=uid -F euid=0 -Fauid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -S execve -k actions 
执行以下命令，检查正在运行的auditd config中是否有规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep actions 
验证输出包括: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=actions 
在64位系统中，执行以下命令: 
执行以下命令，检查规则是否包含在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下的.rules文件中: 
# grep actions /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证输出包括: 
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -C euid!=uid -F euid=0 -Fauid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -S execve -k actions 
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -C euid!=uid -F euid=0 -Fauid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -S execve -k actions 
执行以下命令，检查正在运行的auditd config中是否有规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep actions 
验证输出包括: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=actions 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -F key=actions
extraDetail.remediation:
对于32位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件: 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-actions.rules 
添加以下行: 
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -C euid!=uid -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -S execve -k actions 
对于64位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件: 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-actions.rules 
添加以下行: 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -C euid!=uid -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -S execve -k actions  
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -C euid!=uid -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=4294967295 -S execve -k actions
extraDetail.description_en: sudo provides users with temporary elevated privileges to perform operations. Monitor the administrator with temporary elevated privileges and the operation(s) they performed
extraDetail.rationale_en: creating an audit log of administrators with temporary elevated privileges and the operation(s) they performed is essential to reporting. Administrators will want to correlate the events written to the audit trail with the records written to sudo logfile to verify if unauthorized commands have been executed. Note: Systems may have been customized to change the default UID_MIN. To confirm the UID_MIN for your system, run the following command: # awk '/^\s*UID_MIN/{print $2}' /etc/login.defs If your systems' UID_MIN is not 1000, replace audit>=1000 with audit>=<UID_MIN for your system> in the Audit and Remediation procedures. Reloading the auditd config to set active settings may require a system reboot

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure kernel module loading and unloading is collected
detail_zh: 确保收集内核模块的加载和卸载

extraDetail.description: 监视内核模块的加载和卸载。程序insmod(安装内核模块)、rmmod(删除内核模块)和modprobe(加载和卸载模块的更复杂的程序，以及一些其他特性)控制模块的加载和卸载。init_module(加载模块)和delete_module(删除模块)系统调用控制模块的加载和卸载。任何加载和卸载模块程序和系统调用的执行都将触发一个标识符为“modules”的审计记录。注意:重新加载auditd配置以设置活动设置需要重新启动auditd服务，并且可能需要重新引导系统
extraDetail.rationale: 监视insmod、rmmod和modprobe的使用可以为系统管理员提供证据，证明未经授权的用户加载或卸载了内核模块，这可能危及系统的安全性。对init_module和delete_module系统调用的监视将反映试图使用不同程序加载和卸载模块的未授权用户
extraDetail.audit:
在32位系统中，执行以下命令: 
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件: 
# grep modules /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证匹配的输出: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep modules 
验证匹配的输出: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module,delete_module -F key=modules 
在64位系统中，执行以下命令: 
执行以下命令检查审计的.rules文件: 
# grep modules /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
验证匹配的输出: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules 
执行如下命令查看已加载的审计规则: 
# auditctl -l | grep modules 
Verify output matches: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,delete_module -F key=modules
extraDetail.remediation:
对于32位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-modules.rules 
添加以下行: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules 
对于64位系统，在/etc/audit/rules.d/目录下编辑或创建一个以.rules结尾的文件 
例如: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-modules.rules 
添加以下行: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules
extraDetail.description_en: Monitor the loading and unloading of kernel modules. The programs insmod (install a kernel module), rmmod (remove a kernel module), and modprobe (a more sophisticated program to load and unload modules, as well as some other features) control loading and unloading of modules. The init_module (load a module) and delete_module (delete a module) system calls control loading and unloading of modules. Any execution of the loading and unloading module programs and system calls will trigger an audit record with an identifier of "modules". Note: Reloading the auditd config to set active settings requires the auditd service to be restarted, and may require a system reboot.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Monitoring the use of insmod , rmmod and modprobe could provide system administrators with evidence that an unauthorized user loaded or unloaded a kernel module, possibly compromising the security of the system. Monitoring of the init_module and delete_module system calls would reflect an unauthorized user attempting to use a different program to load and unload modules
extraDetail.audit_en:
On a 32 bit system run the following commands: 
Run the following command to check the auditd .rules files: 
# grep modules /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
Verify output matches: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules 
Run the following command to check loaded auditd rules: 
# auditctl -l | grep modules 
Verify output matches: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module,delete_module -F key=modules 
On a 64 bit system run the following commands: 
Run the following command to check the auditd .rules files: 
# grep modules /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules 
Verify output matches: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules 
Run the following command to check loaded auditd rules: 
# auditctl -l | grep modules 
Verify output matches: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,delete_module -F key=modules
extraDetail.remediation_en:
For 32 bit systems Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-modules.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules 
For 64 bit systems Edit or create a file in the /etc/audit/rules.d/ directory ending in .rules 
Example: vi /etc/audit/rules.d/50-modules.rules 
Add the following lines: 
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules 
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules 
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure the audit configuration is immutable
detail_zh: 确保审计配置是不可变的

extraDetail.description: 设置系统审计，使审计规则不能被auditctl修改。设置标志“-e 2”将强制审计置于不可变模式。审计更改只能在系统重新启动时进行。注意:此设置将需要重新启动系统以更新活动审计配置设置
extraDetail.rationale: 在不可变模式下，未经授权的用户不能对审计系统执行更改以隐藏恶意活动，然后再将审计规则放回。用户很可能会注意到系统重新启动，并提醒管理员尝试进行未经授权的审计更改
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，检查输出结果是否匹配: 
# grep "^\s*[^#]" /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules | tail -1 
-e 2
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑或新建/etc/audit/rules.d/99-finalize.rules文件，并在文件末尾增加如下一行:-e 2
extraDetail.description_en: Set system audit so that audit rules cannot be modified with auditctl . Setting the flag "-e 2" forces audit to be put in immutable mode. Audit changes can only be made on system reboot. Note: This setting will require the system to be rebooted to update the active auditd configuration settings.
extraDetail.rationale_en: In immutable mode, unauthorized users cannot execute changes to the audit system to potentially hide malicious activity and then put the audit rules back. Users would most likely notice a system reboot and that could alert administrators of an attempt to make unauthorized audit changes
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command and verify output matches: 
# grep "^\s*[^#]" /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules | tail -1  
-e 2
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit or create the file /etc/audit/rules.d/99-finalize.rules and add the following line at the end of the file: 
-e 2

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rsyslog is installed

extraDetail.description:
rsyslog软件是原syslogd守护进程的推荐替代品
rsyslog提供了对syslogd的改进，包括:
面向连接(即TCP)的日志传输
•登录到数据库格式的选项
•到中央日志服务器途中的日志数据加密
extraDetail.rationale: rsyslog的安全性增强，例如面向连接(即TCP)的日志传输，日志记录到数据库格式的选项，以及在发送到中央日志服务器的途中对日志数据进行加密)证明安装和配置这个包是正确的
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令验证rsyslog是否安装:
# rpm -q rsyslog
rsyslog-<version>
extraDetail.remediation:
执行以下命令，安装rsyslog:
# yum install rsyslog
extraDetail.description_en:
The rsyslog software is a recommended replacement to the original syslogd daemon.
rsyslog provides improvements over syslogd, including:
 connection-oriented (i.e. TCP) transmission of logs
 The option to log to database formats
 Encryption of log data en route to a central logging server
extraDetail.rationale_en: The security enhancements of rsyslog such as connection-oriented (i.e. TCP) transmission of logs, the option to log to database formats, and the encryption of log data en route to a central logging server) justify installing and configuring the package
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command to Verify rsyslog is installed:
 # rpm -q rsyslog
rsyslog-<version>
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following command to install rsyslog:
# yum install rsyslog

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rsyslog Service is enabled and running
detail_zh: 确保rsyslog服务已启用并运行

extraDetail.description: Rsyslog需要启用并运行才能执行日志记录
extraDetail.rationale: 如果rsyslog服务没有激活，系统可能会默认使用syslogd服务或缺少日志记录
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令验证rsyslog是否开启:
# systemctl is-enabled rsyslog
enabled
执行如下命令查看rsyslog是否正在运行:
# systemctl status rsyslog | grep 'active (running) '
Active: active (running) since <Day date time>
extraDetail.remediation:
启用并启动rsyslog日志:
# systemctl——now enable rsyslog
extraDetail.description_en: rsyslog needs to be enabled and running to perform logging
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the rsyslog service is not activated the system may default to the syslogd service or lack logging instead
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run one of the following commands to verify rsyslog is enabled:
# systemctl is-enabled rsyslog
enabled
Run the following command to verify that rsyslog is running:
# systemctl status rsyslog | grep 'active (running) '
Active: active (running) since <Day date time>
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following command to enable and start rsyslog:
# systemctl --now enable rsyslog

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rsyslog default file permissions configured
detail_zh: 确保配置了rsyslog默认文件权限

extraDetail.description:
rsyslog将创建系统上不存在的日志文件。此设置控制将哪些权限应用于这些新创建的文件
$FileCreateMode参数指定rsyslogd创建新文件时使用的文件创建模式。如果未指定，则使用0644
注:
*给定的值必须始终是一个4位八进制数，首位数为0。
在/etc/rsyslog.d/目录下任何以.conf结尾的文件中，该设置可以被限制较少的设置覆盖
extraDetail.rationale: 重要的是要确保日志文件具有正确的权限，以确保对敏感数据进行归档和保护。
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，检查$FileCreateMode是否为0640或更严格的限制:
# grep ^\$FileCreateMode /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
$FileCreateMode 0640
验证没有返回限制较小的文件模式的结果
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑/etc/rsyslog.conf和/etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf文件，将$FileCreateMode设置为0640或更严格的限制:
$FileCreateMode 0640
extraDetail.description_en:
rsyslog will create logfiles that do not already exist on the system. This setting controls what permissions will be applied to these newly created files.
The $FileCreateMode parameter specifies the file creation mode with which rsyslogd creates new files. If not specified, the value 0644 is used.
Notes:
 The value given must always be a 4-digit octal number, with the initial digit being zero.
 This setting can be overridden by a less restrictive setting in any file ending in .conf in the /etc/rsyslog.d/ directory
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is important to ensure that log files have the correct permissions to ensure that sensitive data is archived and protected
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command and verify that $FileCreateMode is 0640 or more restrictive:
# grep ^\$FileCreateMode /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
$FileCreateMode 0640
Verify that no results return with a less restrictive file mode
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf files and set $FileCreateMode to 0640 or more restrictive:
$FileCreateMode 0640

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure logging is configured

extraDetail.description: /etc/rsyslog.conf和/etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf文件指定了记录日志的规则，以及将使用哪些文件记录某些类型的消息
extraDetail.rationale: 大量与安全相关的重要信息通过rsyslog发送(例如，成功和失败的su尝试、失败的登录尝试、root登录尝试等)
extraDetail.audit:
检查/etc/rsyslog.conf和/etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf文件的内容，确保设置了适当的日志记录。另外，执行如下命令，查看日志文件是否为日志信息:
# ls -l /var/log/
extraDetail.remediation:
根据您的环境，编辑/etc/rsyslog.conf和/etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf文件中的以下行:
*.emerg                                  :omusrmsg:* auth,authpriv.*                          /var/log/secure mail.*                                  -/var/log/mail mail.info                               -/var/log/mail.info mail.warning                            -/var/log/mail.warn mail.err                                 /var/log/mail.err news.crit                               -/var/log/news/news.crit news.err                                -/var/log/news/news.err news.notice                             -/var/log/news/news.notice *.=warning;*.=err                       -/var/log/warn *.crit                                   /var/log/warn *.*;mail.none;news.none                 -/var/log/messages local0,local1.*                         -/var/log/localmessages local2,local3.*                         -/var/log/localmessages local4,local5.*                         -/var/log/localmessages local6,local7.*                         -/var/log/localmessages
重新加载rsyslogd配置:
# systemctl restart rsyslog
extraDetail.description_en: The /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf files specifies rules for logging and which files are to be used to log certain classes of messages
extraDetail.rationale_en: A great deal of important security-related information is sent via rsyslog (e.g., successful and failed su attempts, failed login attempts, root login attempts, etc.)
extraDetail.audit_en:
Review the contents of the /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf files to ensure appropriate logging is set. In addition, run the following command and verify that the log files are logging information:
# ls -l /var/log/
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the following lines in the /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf files as appropriate for your environment:
*.emerg                                  :omusrmsg:* auth,authpriv.*                          /var/log/secure mail.*                                  -/var/log/mail mail.info                               -/var/log/mail.info mail.warning                            -/var/log/mail.warn mail.err                                 /var/log/mail.err news.crit                               -/var/log/news/news.crit news.err                                -/var/log/news/news.err news.notice                             -/var/log/news/news.notice *.=warning;*.=err                       -/var/log/warn *.crit                                   /var/log/warn *.*;mail.none;news.none                 -/var/log/messages local0,local1.*                         -/var/log/localmessages local2,local3.*                         -/var/log/localmessages local4,local5.*                         -/var/log/localmessages local6,local7.*                         -/var/log/localmessages
Run the following command to reload the rsyslogd configuration:
# systemctl restart rsyslog

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure rsyslog is configured to send logs to a remote log host
detail_zh: 确保配置rsyslog将日志发送到远端日志主机

extraDetail.description: rsyslog实用程序支持将收集到的日志发送到运行syslogd(8)的远程日志主机或从远程主机接收消息的能力，从而减少管理开销。注意:请确保所发送的日志文件的选择符合本端站点策略
extraDetail.rationale: 将日志数据存储在远程主机上可以保护日志完整性免受本地攻击
extraDetail.audit:
检查/etc/rsyslog.conf和/etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf文件，确认日志是否被发送到中心主机:
# grep -E '^\s*([^#]+\s+)?action\(([^#]+\s+)?\btarget=\"?[^#"]+\"?\b' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
输出应包括target=<FQDN or IP of remote loghost>
OR
# grep -E '^[^#]\s*\S+\.\*\s+@' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
输出应该包括FQDN或远程日志主机的IP
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑/etc/rsyslog.conf和/etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf文件，添加以下一行:
新的语法:
<files to sent to the remote log server> action(type="omfwd" target="<FQDN or ip of loghost>" port="<port number>" protocol="tcp"                                          action.resumeRetryCount="<number of re-tries>"                                          queue.type="LinkedList" queue.size=<number of messages to queue>")
例如:
*.* action(type="omfwd" target="192.168.2.100" port="514" protocol="tcp"            action.resumeRetryCount="100"            queue.type="LinkedList" queue.size="1000")
老的语法:
*.* @@<FQDN or ip of loghost>
例如:
*.* @@192.168.2.100
重新加载rsyslog配置:
# systemctl restart rsyslog
extraDetail.description_en:
The rsyslog utility supports the ability to send logs it gathers to a remote log host running syslogd(8) or to receive messages from remote hosts, reducing administrative overhead.
Note: Ensure that the selection of logfiles being sent follows local site policy
extraDetail.rationale_en: Storing log data on a remote host protects log integrity from local attacks. If an attacker gains root access on the local system, they could tamper with or remove log data that is stored on the local system
extraDetail.audit_en:
Review the /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf files and verify that logs are sent to a central host
# grep -E '^\s*([^#]+\s+)?action\(([^#]+\s+)?\btarget=\"?[^#"]+\"?\b' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
Output should include target=<FQDN or IP of remote loghost>
OR
# grep -E '^[^#]\s*\S+\.\*\s+@' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
Output should include either the FQDN or the IP of the remote loghost
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf files and add one of the following lines:
Newer syntax:
<files to sent to the remote log server> action(type="omfwd" target="<FQDN or ip of loghost>" port="<port number>" protocol="tcp"                                          action.resumeRetryCount="<number of re-tries>"                                          queue.type="LinkedList" queue.size=<number of messages to queue>")
Example:
*.* action(type="omfwd" target="192.168.2.100" port="514" protocol="tcp"            action.resumeRetryCount="100"            queue.type="LinkedList" queue.size="1000")
Older syntax:
*.* @@<FQDN or ip of loghost>
Example:
*.* @@192.168.2.100
Run the following command to reload the rsyslog configuration:
# systemctl restart rsyslog

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure remote rsyslog messages are only accepted on designated log hosts.
detail_zh: 确保仅在指定的日志主机上接受远程rsyslog消息。

extraDetail.description:
默认情况下，rsyslog不侦听来自远程系统的日志消息。ModLoad告诉rsyslog加载imtcp。所以它可以通过TCP在网络上监听。InputTCPServerRun选项指示rsyslogd在指定的TCP端口上侦听
注意:$ModLoad imtcp行可以将.so扩展名添加到模块的末尾，或者使用模块的完整路径
extraDetail.rationale: 本节中的指导将确保远程日志主机配置为只接受来自指定域内主机的rsyslog数据，而那些不是日志主机的系统不接受任何远程rsyslog消息。这提供了防止欺骗日志数据的保护，并确保系统管理员在一个中心位置审查相当完整的syslog数据
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令，检查结果行在指定的日志主机上是未注释的，在所有其他日志主机上是注释或删除的:
# grep '$ModLoad imtcp' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
$ModLoad imtcp
# grep '$InputTCPServerRun' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
$InputTCPServerRun 514
extraDetail.remediation:
$对于指定为日志主机的主机，编辑/etc/rsyslog.conf文件并un- comment或增加如下几行:
$ModLoad imtcp
$InputTCPServerRun 514
对于未指定为日志主机的主机，编辑/etc/rsyslog.conf文件，注释或删除以下几行:
# $ModLoad imtcp
# $InputTCPServerRun 514
重新加载rsyslogd配置:
# systemctl restart rsyslog
extraDetail.description_en:
By default, rsyslog does not listen for log messages coming in from remote systems. The ModLoad tells rsyslog to load the imtcp.so module so it can listen over a network via TCP. The InputTCPServerRun option instructs rsyslogd to listen on the specified TCP port.
Note: The $ModLoad imtcp line can have the .so extension added to the end of the module, or use the full path to the module.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The guidance in the section ensures that remote log hosts are configured to only accept rsyslog data from hosts within the specified domain and that those systems that are not designed to be log hosts do not accept any remote rsyslog messages. This provides protection from spoofed log data and ensures that system administrators are reviewing reasonably complete syslog data in a central location
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following commands and verify the resulting lines are uncommented on designated log hosts and commented or removed on all others:
# grep '$ModLoad imtcp' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
$ModLoad imtcp
# grep '$InputTCPServerRun' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf
$InputTCPServerRun 514
extraDetail.remediation_en:
For hosts that are designated as log hosts, edit the /etc/rsyslog.conf file and un-comment or add the following lines:
$ModLoad imtcp
$InputTCPServerRun 514
For hosts that are not designated as log hosts, edit the /etc/rsyslog.conf file and comment or remove the following lines:
# $ModLoad imtcp
# $InputTCPServerRun 514
Run the following command to reload the rsyslogd configuration:
# systemctl restart rsyslog

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure journald is configured to send logs to rsyslog
detail_zh: 确保配置journald将日志发送到rsyslog

extraDetail.description:
日志中的数据可以存储在易失性内存中，也可以持久化在服务器本地。实用工具可以接受日志日志的远程导出，但是，使用rsyslog服务提供了一种一致的日志收集和导出方法
注:
本建议假设4.2.1.5建议“确保配置rsyslog发送日志到远程日志主机”已经实现
“主配置文件/etc/systemd/journald.conf在任何自定义*.conf文件之前被读取。如果存在自定义配置，它们将覆盖主要配置参数
如日志手册中所述:日志日志可以通过这里提到的过程或通过类似systemd-journal.service的工具导出到rsyslog。在每个实现中都涉及到权衡，其中ForwardToSyslog将立即捕获所有事件(如果配置正确，还将转发到外部日志服务器)，但可能不会捕获所有启动活动。像system-journal这样的机制。另一方面，服务将记录启动事件，但可能会延迟将信息发送到rsyslog，从而导致在导出之前可能发生日志操作。要了解用于保护系统的所有工具的局限性
extraDetail.rationale: 将日志数据存储在远程主机上可以保护日志完整性免受本地攻击。如果攻击者获得了本地系统的根访问权，他们就可以篡改或删除存储在本地系统上的日志数据
extraDetail.audit:
查看/etc/systemd/journald.conf，确认日志已转发到syslog:
# grep -E ^\s*ForwardToSyslog /etc/systemd/ journard .conf
ForwardToSyslog=yes
extraDetail.remediation:
修改/etc/systemd/journald.conf文件，增加如下一行:
ForwardToSyslog=yes
extraDetail.description_en: Data from journald may be stored in volatile memory or persisted locally on the server. Utilities exist to accept remote export of journald logs, however, use of the rsyslog service provides a consistent means of log collection and export. Notes:  This recommendation assumes that recommendation 4.2.1.5, "Ensure rsyslog is configured to send logs to a remote log host" has been implemented.   The main configuration file /etc/systemd/journald.conf is read before any of the custom *.conf files. If there are custom configs present, they override the main configuration parameters   As noted in the journald man pages: journald logs may be exported to rsyslog either through the process mentioned here, or through a facility like systemd-journald.service. There are trade-offs involved in each implementation, where ForwardToSyslog will immediately capture all events (and forward to an external log server, if properly configured), but may not capture all boot-up activities. Mechanisms such as systemd-journald.service, on the other hand, will record bootup events, but may delay sending the information to rsyslog, leading to the potential for log manipulation prior to export. Be aware of the limitations of all tools employed to secure a system.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Storing log data on a remote host protects log integrity from local attacks. If an attacker gains root access on the local system, they could tamper with or remove log data that is stored on the local system
extraDetail.audit_en:

extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the /etc/systemd/journald.conf file and add the following line:

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure journald is configured to compress large log files
detail_zh: 确保日志配置为压缩大型日志文件

extraDetail.description:
日志系统包括压缩过大文件的功能，以避免用日志填满系统或使日志大到难以管理
注意:主配置文件/etc/systemd/journald.conf在任何自定义*.conf文件之前被读取。如果存在自定义配置，它们将覆盖主要配置参数
extraDetail.rationale: 未压缩的大文件可能会意外地填满文件系统，导致资源不可用。在写入之前压缩日志可以防止突然的、意外的文件系统影响
extraDetail.audit:
查看/etc/systemd/journald.conf，确认大文件将被压缩:
# grep -E ^\s*Compress /etc/systemd/journald.conf
Compress=yes
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑/etc/systemd/journald.conf文件，增加如下一行:
Compress=yes
extraDetail.description_en:
The journald system includes the capability of compressing overly large files to avoid filling up the system with logs or making the logs unmanageably large.
Note: The main configuration file /etc/systemd/journald.conf is read before any of the custom *.conf files. If there are custom configs present, they override the main configuration parameters
extraDetail.rationale_en: Uncompressed large files may unexpectedly fill a filesystem leading to resource unavailability. Compressing logs prior to write can prevent sudden, unexpected filesystem impacts
extraDetail.audit_en:
Review /etc/systemd/journald.conf and verify that large files will be compressed:
# grep -E ^\s*Compress /etc/systemd/journald.conf
Compress=yes
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the /etc/systemd/journald.conf file and add the following line:
ßßCompress=yes

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure journald is configured to write logfiles to persistent disk
detail_zh: 确保journald已配置为将日志文件写入持久磁盘

extraDetail.description:
日志中的数据可以存储在易失性内存中，也可以持久化在服务器本地。系统重新启动时，内存中的日志将丢失。通过将日志持久化到服务器上的本地磁盘，可以防止它们丢失
注意:主配置文件/etc/systemd/journald.conf在任何自定义*.conf文件之前被读取。如果存在自定义配置，它们将覆盖主要配置参数
extraDetail.rationale: 将日志数据写入磁盘将提供在系统崩溃或重新启动后重新构建可能影响系统操作或安全的事件的能力
extraDetail.audit:
查看/etc/systemd/journard.conf，确认日志被持久化到磁盘:
# grep -E ^\s*Storage /etc/systemd/journard.conf
Storage=persistent
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑/etc/systemd/journald.conf文件，增加如下一行:
Storage=persistent
extraDetail.description_en:
Data from journald may be stored in volatile memory or persisted locally on the server. Logs in memory will be lost upon a system reboot. By persisting logs to local disk on the server they are protected from loss.
Note: The main configuration file /etc/systemd/journald.conf is read before any of the custom *.conf files. If there are custom configs present, they override the main configuration parameters
extraDetail.rationale_en: Writing log data to disk will provide the ability to forensically reconstruct events which may have impacted the operations or security of a system even after a system crash or reboot
extraDetail.audit_en:
Review /etc/systemd/journald.conf and verify that logs are persisted to disk:
# grep -E ^\s*Storage /etc/systemd/journald.conf
Storage=persistent
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the /etc/systemd/journald.conf file and add the following line:
Storage=persistent

extraDetail.description: 存储在/var/log/中的日志文件包含来自系统上许多服务的日志信息，或者日志主机上其他服务的日志信息。
extraDetail.rationale: 重要的是要确保日志文件具有正确的权限，以确保对敏感数据进行归档和保护。其他/世界不应该有能力查看此信息。组不应具有修改此信息的能力
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，确认other对任何文件没有权限，group对任何文件没有写入或执行权限:
# find /var/log -type f -perm /g+wx,o+rwx  -exec ls -l {} \;任何东西都不应退还
extraDetail.remediation:
使用实例设置所有日志文件的权限:
# find /var/log -type f -exec chmod g-wx,o-rwx "{}" +注意:对于权限不正确的日志，可能还需要修改日志软件或服务的配置，否则权限可能会恢复到错误的权限
extraDetail.description_en: Log files stored in /var/log/ contain logged information from many services on the system, or on log hosts others as well
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is important to ensure that log files have the correct permissions to ensure that sensitive data is archived and protected. Other/world should not have the ability to view this information. Group should not have the ability to modify this information
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following commands to set permissions on all existing log files:
# find /var/log -type f -exec chmod g-wx,o-rwx "{}" +
Note: The configuration for your logging software or services may need to also be modified for any logs that had incorrect permissions, otherwise, the permissions may be reverted to the incorrect permissions

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure logrotate is configured

extraDetail.description:
该系统包括定期旋转日志文件的功能，以避免用日志填满系统或使日志过大而难以管理。文件“/etc/ logate . log”。D /syslog为配置文件，用于轮换syslog或rsyslog生成的日志文件
注意:如果没有为log - grotate设置maxage设置，则会出现log - grotate中断且无法删除旋转的日志文件的情况。建议将该值设置为大于系统上应存在的最长日志文件的值，以确保删除任何此类日志文件，但不会覆盖标准旋转设置。
extraDetail.rationale: 通过使日志文件更小和更易于管理，系统管理员可以轻松地将这些文件归档到另一个系统，并花费更少的时间查看超大的日志文件
extraDetail.audit: 查看/etc/logrotate.conf和/etc/logrotate.d/*，确认日志是否按照站点策略轮换
extraDetail.remediation: 编辑/etc/logrotate.conf和/etc/logrotate.d/*，确保日志按照局点策略进行轮换。
extraDetail.description_en:
The system includes the capability of rotating log files regularly to avoid filling up the system with logs or making the logs unmanageably large. The file /etc/logrotate.d/syslog is the configuration file used to rotate log files created by syslog or rsyslog.
Note: If no maxage setting is set for logrotate a situation can occur where logrotate is interrupted and fails to delete rotated logfiles. It is recommended to set this to a value greater than the longest any log file should exist on your system to ensure that any such logfile is removed but standard rotation settings are not overridden
extraDetail.rationale_en: By keeping the log files smaller and more manageable, a system administrator can easily archive these files to another system and spend less time looking through inordinately large log files
extraDetail.audit_en: Review /etc/logrotate.conf and /etc/logrotate.d/* and verify logs are rotated according to site policy
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit /etc/logrotate.conf and /etc/logrotate.d/* to ensure logs are rotated according to site policy

extraDetail.rationale: 该文件包含有关cron运行的系统作业的信息。对这些文件的写访问可以为没有特权的用户提供提升其特权的能力。对这些文件的读取访问可以让用户了解在系统上运行的系统作业，并为他们提供一种获得未经授权的特权访问的方法

如果安装了cron:

extraDetail.remediation:

 # yum remove cronie
extraDetail.description_en: The /etc/crontab file is used by cron to control its own jobs. The commands in this item make sure that root is the user and group owner of the file and that only the owner can access the file.
extraDetail.rationale_en: This file contains information on what system jobs are run by cron. Write access to these files could provide unprivileged users with the ability to elevate their privileges. Read access to these files could provide users with the ability to gain insight on system jobs that run on the system and could provide them a way to gain unauthorized privileged access
extraDetail.audit_en:
If cron is installed:
 Run the following command and verify Uid and Gid are both 0/root and Access does not grant permissions to group or other:

Access: (0600/-rw-------)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
extraDetail.remediation_en:

extraDetail.description: /etc/cron.d/目录包含系统cron作业，这些作业需要以类似于/etc/crontab中的每小时、每天、每周和每月作业的方式运行，但需要对它们的运行时间进行更细粒度的控制。此目录下的文件不能由crontab命令操作，而是由系统管理员使用文本编辑器编辑。以下命令限制root用户和root组的读写和搜索权限，阻止普通用户访问该目录。
extraDetail.rationale: 为非特权用户授予对该目录的写访问权可以为他们提供获得未授权的提升权限的方法。授予对该目录的读访问权可以让非特权用户了解如何获得更高的权限或绕过审计控制
extraDetail.audit:
如果安装了cron:
执行以下命令，确认Uid和Gid都为0/root，且Access没有授予group或other权限:
# stat /etc/cron.d  
Access: (0700/drwx------)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
extraDetail.remediation:
设置“/etc/cron.d”目录的归属和权限:
# chown root:root /etc/cron.d
# chmod og-rwx /etc/cron.d
或执行以下命令，删除cron:
 # yum remove cronie
extraDetail.description_en: The /etc/cron.d/ directory contains system cron jobs that need to run in a similar manner to the hourly, daily weekly and monthly jobs from /etc/crontab , but require more granular control as to when they run. The files in this directory cannot be manipulated by the crontab command, but are instead edited by system administrators using a text editor. The commands below restrict read/write and search access to user and group root, preventing regular users from accessing this directory.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Granting write access to this directory for non-privileged users could provide them the means for gaining unauthorized elevated privileges. Granting read access to this directory could give an unprivileged user insight in how to gain elevated privileges or circumvent auditing controls
extraDetail.audit_en:
If cron is installed:
Run the following command and verify Uid and Gid are both 0/root and Access does not grant permissions to group or other:
# stat /etc/cron.d  
Access: (0700/drwx------)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following commands to set ownership and permissions on /etc/cron.d directory:
# chown root:root /etc/cron.d
# chmod og-rwx /etc/cron.d
OR Run the following command to remove cron:
# yum remove cronie

creator: system
title_zh: 配置基于时间的作业调度器
detail_en: Ensure cron is restricted to authorized users

extraDetail.description: 如果系统中安装了cron，请配置“/etc/cron.”允许允许特定用户使用这些服务。如果/etc/cron.Allow不存在，则检查/etc/cron.deny。任何没有在这些文件中明确定义的用户都可以使用cron。通过删除文件，只有用户在/etc/cron.允许使用cron。注意:即使给定的用户没有在cron中列出。允许，cron作业仍然可以作为该用户运行。cron。允许文件仅控制对crontab命令的管理访问，以调度和修改cron作业
extraDetail.rationale: 在许多系统上，只有系统管理员被授权调度cron作业。使用cron。允许文件控制谁可以运行cron作业执行此策略。管理允许列表比管理拒绝列表更容易。在拒绝列表中，您可能会向系统添加用户ID，而忘记将其添加到拒绝文件中
extraDetail.audit:
如果安装了cron:
执行以下命令，确认/etc/cron.deny不存在:
# stat /etc/cron.deny  
stat: cannot stat `/etc/cron.deny': No such file or directory 
执行以下命令，确认“Uid”和“Gid”均为“0/root”，并且“Access”没有授予/etc/cron.allow的group或other权限:
# stat /etc/cron.allow  
Access: (0600/-rw-------)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
extraDetail.remediation:
执行以下命令，删除“/etc/cron.deny”: 
# rm /etc/cron.deny 
执行以下命令创建/etc/cron.allow
# touch /etc/cron.allow 
执行以下命令设置/etc/cron.allow的属主和权限:
# chown root:root /etc/cron.allow  
# chmod u-x,og-rwx /etc/cron.allow 
或执行以下命令，删除cron:
# yum remove cronie
extraDetail.description_en: If cron is installed in the system, configure /etc/cron.allow to allow specific users to use these services. If /etc/cron.allow does not exist, then /etc/cron.deny is checked. Any user not specifically defined in those files is allowed to use cron. By removing the file, only users in /etc/cron.allow are allowed to use cron. Note: Even though a given user is not listed in cron.allow, cron jobs can still be run as that user. The cron.allow file only controls administrative access to the crontab command for scheduling and modifying cron jobs
extraDetail.rationale_en: On many systems, only the system administrator is authorized to schedule cron jobs. Using the cron.allow file to control who can run cron jobs enforces this policy. It is easier to manage an allow list than a deny list. In a deny list, you could potentially add a user ID to the system and forget to add it to the deny files
extraDetail.audit_en:
If cron is installed:
 Run the following command and verify /etc/cron.deny does not exist:
# stat /etc/cron.deny  
stat: cannot stat `/etc/cron.deny': No such file or directory 
Run the following command and verify Uid and Gid are both 0/root and Access does not grant permissions to group or other for /etc/cron.allow: 
# stat /etc/cron.allow  
Access: (0600/-rw-------)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following command to remove /etc/cron.deny: 
# rm /etc/cron.deny 
Run the following command to create /etc/cron.allow 
# touch /etc/cron.allow 
Run the following commands to set the owner and permissions on /etc/cron.allow: 
# chown root:root /etc/cron.allow  
# chmod u-x,og-rwx /etc/cron.allow 
OR Run the following command to remove cron 
# yum remove cronie

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure sudo is installed

extraDetail.description: Sudo允许被允许的用户作为超级用户或安全策略指定的其他用户执行命令。调用用户的真实(无效)用户ID用于确定用于查询安全策略的用户名
extraDetail.rationale:
Sudo支持安全策略和输入/输出日志的插件架构。第三方可以开发和发布他们自己的策略和I/O日志插件，以便与sudo前端无缝地工作。默认的安全策略是sudoers，通过文件/etc/sudoers.
配置安全策略决定用户在运行sudo时拥有哪些特权(如果有的话)。策略可能要求用户使用密码或其他身份验证机制对自己进行身份验证。如果需要身份验证，如果在可配置的时间限制内没有输入用户密码，sudo将退出。此限制与策略相关
extraDetail.audit:
验证sudo已安装
执行以下命令:
# rpm -q sudo
 sudo-<VERSION>
extraDetail.remediation:
执行以下命令安装sudo:
# yum install sudo
extraDetail.description_en: sudo allows a permitted user to execute a command as the superuser or another user, as specified by the security policy. The invoking user's real (not effective) user ID is used to determine the user name with which to query the security policy
extraDetail.rationale_en:
sudo supports a plugin architecture for security policies and input/output logging. Third parties can develop and distribute their own policy and I/O logging plugins to work seamlessly with the sudo front end. The default security policy is sudoers, which is configured via the file /etc/sudoers.
 The security policy determines what privileges, if any, a user has to run sudo. The policy may require that users authenticate themselves with a password or another authentication mechanism. If authentication is required, sudo will exit if the user's password is not entered within a configurable time limit. This limit is policy-specific
extraDetail.audit_en:
Verify that sudo in installed. Run the following command: 
# rpm -q sudo
  sudo-<VERSION>
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following command to install sudo.
 # yum install sudo

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure sudo commands use pty

extraDetail.description:
sudo可以配置为只能从伪pty中运行
注意:visudo以一种安全的方式编辑sudoers文件，类似于vipw(8)。Visudo对sudoers文件进行多重同步编辑锁定，提供基本的健全性检查，并检查解析错误。如果sudoers文件当前正在编辑，您将收到一条稍后再试的消息。f选项允许您告诉visudo要编辑哪个文件。
extraDetail.rationale:
攻击者可以使用sudo运行恶意程序，这将再次派生一个后台进程，即使主程序已经完成执行，
该进程仍然存在。可以通过配置sudo仅从伪pty运行其他命令来缓解这一问题，无论是否打开I/O日志记录
extraDetail.audit:
验证sudo只能从伪pty运行其他命令
执行如下命令:
# grep -Ei '^\s*Defaults\s+([^#]\S+,\s*)?use_pty\b' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*
  Defaults use_pty
extraDetail.remediation:
使用visudo或visudo -f <PATH TO FILE>编辑/etc/sudoers文件或/etc/sudoers.d/文件，并添加以下行:
Defaults use_pty
extraDetail.description_en:
sudo can be configured to run only from a pseudo-pty
 Note: visudo edits the sudoers file in a safe fashion, analogous to vipw(8). visudo locks the sudoers file against multiple simultaneous edits, provides basic sanity checks, and checks for parse errors. If the sudoers file is currently being edited you will receive a message to try again later. The -f option allows you to tell visudo which file to edit.
extraDetail.rationale_en:
Attackers can run a malicious program using sudo, which would again fork a background process that remains even when the main program has finished executing.
 This can be mitigated by configuring sudo to run other commands only from a pseudo-pty, whether I/O logging is turned on or not
extraDetail.audit_en:
Verify that sudo can only run other commands from a pseudo-pty
 Run the following command:
# grep -Ei '^\s*Defaults\s+([^#]\S+,\s*)?use_pty\b' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*
  Defaults use_pty
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Edit the file /etc/sudoers or a file in /etc/sudoers.d/ with visudo or visudo -f <PATH TO FILE> and add the following line:
 Defaults use_pty

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure sudo log file exists

extraDetail.description:
sudo可以使用自定义日志文件
注意:visudo以一种安全的方式编辑sudoers文件，类似于vipw(8)。Visudo对sudoers文件进行多重同步编辑锁定，提供基本的健全性检查，并检查解析错误。如果sudoers文件当前正在编辑，您将收到一条稍后再试的消息。-f选项允许您告诉visudo要编辑哪个文件
extraDetail.rationale: sudo日志文件简化了sudo命令的审计
extraDetail.audit:
验证sudo配置了一个自定义日志文件
执行以下命令:
# grep -Ei '^\s*Defaults\s+([^#;]+,\s*)?logfile\s*=\s*(")?[^#;]+(")?' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*
  Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"
extraDetail.remediation:
使用visudo或visudo -f <PATH TO FILE>编辑/etc/sudoers文件或/etc/sudoers.d/文件，并添加以下行:

 efaults  logfile="<PATH TO CUSTOM LOG FILE>"
例如:
 Defaults  logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"
extraDetail.impact: 不正确地编辑sudo配置可能导致sudo停止工作
extraDetail.description_en:
sudo can use a custom log file
 Note: visudo edits the sudoers file in a safe fashion, analogous to vipw(8). visudo locks the sudoers file against multiple simultaneous edits, provides basic sanity checks, and checks for parse errors. If the sudoers file is currently being edited you will receive a message to try again later. The -f option allows you to tell visudo which file to edit.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A sudo log file simplifies auditing of sudo commands
extraDetail.audit_en:
Verify that sudo has a custom log file configured
 Run the following command:
# grep -Ei '^\s*Defaults\s+([^#;]+,\s*)?logfile\s*=\s*(")?[^#;]+(")?' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*
  Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"
extraDetail.remediation_en:
edit the file /etc/sudoers or a file in /etc/sudoers.d/ with visudo or visudo -f <PATH TO FILE> and add the following line:
 efaults  logfile="<PATH TO CUSTOM LOG FILE>"
 Example:
 Defaults  logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"
extraDetail.impact_en: Editing the sudo configuration incorrectly can cause sudo to stop functioning

detail_en: Ensure permissions on /etc/ssh/sshd_config are configured

extraDetail.description: /etc/ssh/sshd_config文件包含sshd的配置规范。下面的命令将文件的所有者和组设置为root。
extraDetail.rationale: 需要保护/etc/ssh/sshd_config文件，防止非特权用户未经授权的更改
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，确认Uid和Gid都为0/root，且Access没有授予group或other权限:
# stat /etc/ssh/sshd_config
Access:(0600/-rw-------) Uid:(0/root) Gid: (0 /root)
extraDetail.remediation:
执行以下命令，设置/etc/ssh/sshd_config目录的所有权和权限:
# chown root:root /etc/ssh/sshd_config
# chmod og-rwx /etc/ssh/sshd_config
extraDetail.description_en: The /etc/ssh/sshd_config file contains configuration specifications for sshd. The command below sets the owner and group of the file to root
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/ssh/sshd_config file needs to be protected from unauthorized changes by non-privileged users
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command and verify Uid and Gid are both 0/root and Access does not grant permissions to group or other:
# stat /etc/ssh/sshd_config
Access: (0600/-rw-------)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following commands to set ownership and permissions on /etc/ssh/sshd_config:
