执行如下命令列出SUID文件:
# df——local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type f -perm -4000
以上命令只搜索本地文件系统，在网络挂载分区上可能仍有泄漏项。此外，df的——local选项并不是所有版本的通用选项，可以省略查找系统上的所有文件系统，包括网络挂载的文件系统，或者可以对每个分区手动运行以下命令:
# find <partition> -xdev -type f -perm -4000
extraDetail.remediation: 确保没有流氓SUID程序引入到系统中。检查Audit部分中操作返回的文件，并确认这些二进制文件的完整性
extraDetail.description_en: The owner of a file can set the file's permissions to run with the owner's or group's permissions, even if the user running the program is not the owner or a member of the group. The most common reason for a SUID program is to enable users to perform functions (such as changing their password) that require root privileges
extraDetail.rationale_en: There are valid reasons for SUID programs, but it is important to identify and review such programs to ensure they are legitimate
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command to list SUID files:
# df --local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type f -perm -4000
The command above only searches local filesystems, there may still be compromised items on network mounted partitions. Additionally the --local option to df is not universal to all versions, it can be omitted to search all filesystems on a system including network mounted filesystems or the following command can be run manually for each partition:
# find <partition> -xdev -type f -perm -4000
extraDetail.remediation_en: Ensure that no rogue SUID programs have been introduced into the system. Review the files returned by the action in the Audit section and confirm the integrity of these binaries

creator: system
detail_en: Audit SGID executables

extraDetail.description: 文件的所有者可以将文件的权限设置为与所有者或组的权限一起运行，即使运行程序的用户不是所有者或组的成员。使用SGID程序的最常见原因是允许用户执行需要根权限的功能(例如更改密码)
extraDetail.rationale: SGID项目有合理的理由，但重要的是要识别和审查这样的项目，以确保它们是合法的。检查审计部分中操作返回的文件，并检查系统二进制文件的md5校验和是否与包中的md5校验和不同。这表明二进制文件可能已经被替换了
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令列出SGID文件:
# df——local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type f -perm -2000
上面的命令只搜索本地文件系统，在网络挂载的分区上可能仍然有被破坏的项目。此外，df的——local选项并不是所有版本的通用选项，可以省略查找系统上的所有文件系统，包括网络挂载的文件系统，或者可以为每个分区手动运行以下命令:
# find <partition> -xdev -type f -perm -2000
extraDetail.remediation: 确保系统中没有非法的SGID程序。检查Audit部分中操作返回的文件，并确认这些二进制文件的完整性
extraDetail.description_en: The owner of a file can set the file's permissions to run with the owner's or group's permissions, even if the user running the program is not the owner or a member of the group. The most common reason for a SGID program is to enable users to perform functions (such as changing their password) that require root privileges
extraDetail.rationale_en: There are valid reasons for SGID programs, but it is important to identify and review such programs to ensure they are legitimate. Review the files returned by the action in the audit section and check to see if system binaries have a different md5 checksum than what from the package. This is an indication that the binary may have been replaced
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command to list SGID files:
# df --local -P | awk '{if (NR!=1) print $6}' | xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -type f -perm -2000
The command above only searches local filesystems, there may still be compromised items on network mounted partitions. Additionally the --local option to df is not universal to all versions, it can be omitted to search all filesystems on a system including network mounted filesystems or the following command can be run manually for each partition:
# find <partition> -xdev -type f -perm -2000
extraDetail.remediation_en: Ensure that no rogue SGID programs have been introduced into the system. Review the files returned by the action in the Audit section and confirm the integrity of these binaries

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure accounts in /etc/passwd use shadowed passwords
detail_zh: 确保/etc/passwd目录下的帐号使用影子密码

extraDetail.description: 本地帐户可以使用隐藏密码。使用影子密码时，密码保存在影子密码文件/etc/shadow中，通过加盐的单向哈希加密。使用阴影密码的帐户在/etc/password .的第二个字段中有一个x
extraDetail.rationale:
/etc/passwd文件还包含许多系统程序使用的用户ID和组ID等信息。因此，/etc/passwd文件必须保持全球可读。尽管使用随机生成的单向哈希函数对密码进行编码，但如果攻击者能够访问/etc/passwd文件，仍然可以破坏系统。这可以通过使用隐藏密码来缓解，从而将/etc/passwd文件中的密码移动到/etc/shadow。/etc/shadow文件被设置为只有root用户能够读写。这有助于降低攻击者获取用于执行字典攻击的编码密码的风险
注:
所有帐户必须有密码或已锁定，以防止未经授权的用户使用。
在/etc/passwd中第二个字段为空的用户帐户允许仅提供用户名即可登录。
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令，查看是否无输出:
# awk -F: '($2 != "x" ) { print $1 " is not set to shadowed passwords "}' /etc/passwd
extraDetail.remediation:
如果/etc/passwd文件中存在密码字段中没有x的帐户，则执行以下命令将这些帐户设置为影子密码:
# sed -e 's/^\([a-zA-Z0-9_]*\):[^:]*:/\1:x:/' -i /etc/passwd
调查以确定该帐户是否已登录以及它的用途，以确定是否需要将其强制注销
extraDetail.description_en: Local accounts can uses shadowed passwords. With shadowed passwords, The passwords are saved in shadow password file, /etc/shadow, encrypted by a salted one-way hash. Accounts with a shadowed password have an x in the second field in /etc/passwd
extraDetail.rationale_en:
The /etc/passwd file also contains information like user ID's and group ID's that are used by many system programs. Therefore, the /etc/passwd file must remain world readable. In spite of encoding the password with a randomly-generated one-way hash function, an attacker could still break the system if they got access to the /etc/passwd file. This can be mitigated by using shadowed passwords, thus moving the passwords in the /etc/passwd file to /etc/shadow. The /etc/shadow file is set so only root will be able to read and write. This helps mitigate the risk of an attacker gaining access to the encoded passwords with which to perform a dictionary attack
Notes:
  All accounts must have passwords or be locked to prevent the account from being used by an unauthorized user
 A user account with an empty second field in /etc/passwd allows the account to be logged into by providing only the username
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command and verify that no output is returned:
# awk -F: '($2 != "x" ) { print $1 " is not set to shadowed passwords "}' /etc/passwd
extraDetail.remediation_en:
If any accounts in the /etc/passwd file do not have a single x in the password field, run the following command to set these accounts to use shadowed passwords:
# sed -e 's/^\([a-zA-Z0-9_]*\):[^:]*:/\1:x:/' -i /etc/passwd
Investigate to determine if the account is logged in and what it is being used for, to determine if it needs to be forced off.

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure /etc/shadow password fields are not empty

extraDetail.description: 密码字段为空的帐户意味着任何人都可以作为该用户登录，而无需提供密码
extraDetail.rationale: 所有帐户必须设置密码或被锁定，以防止未经授权的用户使用
extraDetail.audit:
执行如下命令，查看是否无输出:
# awk -F: '($2 == "" ) { print $1 " does not have a password "}' /etc/shadow
extraDetail.remediation:
如果/etc/shadow文件中有帐户没有密码，执行以下命令锁定该帐户，直到可以确定为什么没有密码:
# passwd -l <username>
此外，检查该帐户是否已登录，并调查它的用途，以确定是否需要强制关闭
extraDetail.description_en: An account with an empty password field means that anybody may log in as that user without providing a password
extraDetail.rationale_en: All accounts must have passwords or be locked to prevent the account from being used by an unauthorized user
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command and verify that no output is returned:
# awk -F: '($2 == "" ) { print $1 " does not have a password "}' /etc/shadow
extraDetail.remediation_en:
If any accounts in the /etc/shadow file do not have a password, run the following command to lock the account until it can be determined why it does not have a password:
# passwd -l <username>
Also, check to see if the account is logged in and investigate what it is being used for to determine if it needs to be forced off

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure all groups in /etc/passwd exist in /etc/group
detail_zh: 确保“/etc/passwd”中的所有组都存在于“/etc/group”中

extraDetail.description: 随着时间的推移，系统管理错误和更改可能导致在/etc/passwd中定义组而不在/etc/group中定义组
extraDetail.rationale: 在“/etc/passwd”文件中定义的组没有在“/etc/group”文件中定义，组权限管理不合理，会对系统安全造成威胁
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:
#!/bin/bash for i in $(cut -s -d: -f4 /etc/passwd | sort -u ); do  grep -q -P "^.*?:[^:]*:$i:" /etc/group   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then     echo "Group $i is referenced by /etc/passwd but does not exist in /etc/group"   fi done
extraDetail.remediation: 分析上面Audit步骤的输出，并执行适当的操作来纠正发现的任何差异
extraDetail.description_en: Over time, system administration errors and changes can lead to groups being defined in /etc/passwd but not in /etc/group
extraDetail.rationale_en: Groups defined in the /etc/passwd file but not in the /etc/group file pose a threat to system security since group permissions are not properly managed
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script and verify no results are returned:
#!/bin/bash for i in $(cut -s -d: -f4 /etc/passwd | sort -u ); do  grep -q -P "^.*?:[^:]*:$i:" /etc/group   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then     echo "Group $i is referenced by /etc/passwd but does not exist in /etc/group"   fi done
extraDetail.remediation_en: Analyze the output of the Audit step above and perform the appropriate action to correct any discrepancies found

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure shadow group is empty

extraDetail.description: shadow组允许需要访问的系统程序读取/etc/shadow文件。不允许将任何用户分配到影子组
extraDetail.rationale: 分配给shadow组的任何用户都将被授予对/etc/shadow文件的读访问权。如果攻击者可以获得对/etc/shadow文件的读访问权，他们可以很容易地对散列密码运行密码破解程序来破坏它们。存储在/etc/shadow文件中的其他安全信息(例如过期)也可以用于破坏其他用户帐户
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，确认无返回结果:
# awk -F: '($1=="shadow") {print $NF}' /etc/group
# awk -F: -v GID="$(awk -F: '($1=="shadow") {print $3}' /etc/group)"'($4==GID) {print $1}' /etc/passwd
extraDetail.remediation:
执行如下命令，删除影子组中的所有用户
# sed -ri 's/(^shadow:[^:]*:[^:]*:)([^:]+$)/\1/' /etc/group
更改任何使用shadow作为其primary group的用户的primary group
# usermod -g <primary group> <user>
extraDetail.description_en: The shadow group allows system programs which require access the ability to read the /etc/shadow file. No users should be assigned to the shadow group
extraDetail.rationale_en: Any users assigned to the shadow group would be granted read access to the /etc/shadow file. If attackers can gain read access to the /etc/shadow file, they can easily run a password cracking program against the hashed passwords to break them. Other security information that is stored in the /etc/shadow file (such as expiration) could also be useful to subvert additional user accounts
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following commands and verify no results are returned:
# awk -F: '($1=="shadow") {print $NF}' /etc/group
# awk -F: -v GID="$(awk -F: '($1=="shadow") {print $3}' /etc/group)" '($4==GID) {print $1}' /etc/passwd
extraDetail.remediation_en:
Run the following command to remove all users from the shadow group:
# sed -ri 's/(^shadow:[^:]*:[^:]*:)([^:]+$)/\1/' /etc/group
Change the primary group of any users with shadow as their primary group
# usermod -g <primary group> <user>

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure no duplicate user names exist
detail_zh: 确保不存在重复的用户名

extraDetail.description: 虽然useradd程序不允许您创建重复的用户名，但管理员可以手动编辑/etc/passwd文件并更改用户名
extraDetail.rationale: 如果给用户分配了重复的用户名，它将创建/etc/passwd中该用户名的第一个UID的文件并有权访问该文件。例如，如果“test4”的UID是1000，而后续的“test4”条目的UID是2000，那么作为“test4”登录将使用UID 1000。实际上，UID是共享的，这是一个安全问题
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:
#!/bin/bash  cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd | sort | uniq -d | while read x; do    echo "Duplicate login name ${x} in /etc/passwd" done
extraDetail.remediation: 根据审计脚本的结果，为用户建立唯一的用户名。只要用户拥有唯一的uid，文件所有权就会自动反映更改
extraDetail.description_en: Although the useradd program will not let you create a duplicate user name, it is possible for an administrator to manually edit the /etc/passwd file and change the user name
extraDetail.rationale_en: If a user is assigned a duplicate user name, it will create and have access to files with the first UID for that username in /etc/passwd . For example, if "test4" has a UID of 1000 and a subsequent "test4" entry has a UID of 2000, logging in as "test4" will use UID 1000. Effectively, the UID is shared, which is a security problem
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script and verify no results are returned:
#!/bin/bash  cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd | sort | uniq -d | while read x; do    echo "Duplicate login name ${x} in /etc/passwd" done
extraDetail.remediation_en: Based on the results of the audit script, establish unique user names for the users. File ownerships will automatically reflect the change as long as the users have unique UIDs

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure no duplicate group names exist
detail_zh: 确保不存在重复的组名

extraDetail.description: 虽然groupadd程序不允许您创建重复的组名，但管理员可以手动编辑/etc/group文件并更改组名
extraDetail.rationale: 如果给一个组分配了重复的组名，它将在/etc/group中为该组创建并访问具有第一个GID的文件。实际上，GID是共享的，这是一个安全问题
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:
#!/bin/bash  cut -d: -f1 /etc/group | sort | uniq -d | while read -r x; do    echo "Duplicate group name ${x} in /etc/group" done
extraDetail.remediation: 根据审计脚本的结果，为用户组建立唯一的名称。只要组具有惟一的gid，文件组的所有权将自动反映更改
extraDetail.description_en: Although the groupadd program will not let you create a duplicate group name, it is possible for an administrator to manually edit the /etc/group file and change the group name
extraDetail.rationale_en: If a group is assigned a duplicate group name, it will create and have access to files with the first GID for that group in /etc/group . Effectively, the GID is shared, which is a security problem
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script and verify no results are returned:
#!/bin/bash  cut -d: -f1 /etc/group | sort | uniq -d | while read -r x; do    echo "Duplicate group name ${x} in /etc/group" done
extraDetail.remediation_en: Based on the results of the audit script, establish unique names for the user groups. File group ownerships will automatically reflect the change as long as the groups have unique GIDs

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure no duplicate UIDs exist

extraDetail.description: 虽然useradd程序不允许您创建重复的用户ID (UID)，但管理员可以手动编辑/etc/passwd文件并更改UID字段。
extraDetail.rationale: 必须为用户分配唯一的uid，以便进行问责并确保适当的访问保护
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:
#!/bin/bash  cut -f3 -d":" /etc/passwd | sort -n | uniq -c | while read -r x; do    [ -z "$x" ] && break    set - "$x"    if [ "$1" -gt 1 ]; then       users=$(awk -F: '($3 == n) { print $1 }' n="$2" /etc/passwd | xargs)       echo "Duplicate UID ($2): $users"    fi done
extraDetail.remediation: 根据审计脚本的结果，建立唯一UID并检查共享UID所拥有的所有文件，以确定它们应该属于哪个UID
extraDetail.description_en: Although the useradd program will not let you create a duplicate User ID (UID), it is possible for an administrator to manually edit the /etc/passwd file and change the UID field
extraDetail.rationale_en: Users must be assigned unique UIDs for accountability and to ensure appropriate access protections
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script and verify no results are returned:
#!/bin/bash  cut -f3 -d":" /etc/passwd | sort -n | uniq -c | while read -r x; do    [ -z "$x" ] && break    set - "$x"    if [ "$1" -gt 1 ]; then       users=$(awk -F: '($3 == n) { print $1 }' n="$2" /etc/passwd | xargs)       echo "Duplicate UID ($2): $users"    fi done
extraDetail.remediation_en: Based on the results of the audit script, establish unique UIDs and review all files owned by the shared UIDs to determine which UID they are supposed to belong to

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure no duplicate GIDs exist

extraDetail.description: 虽然groupadd程序不允许您创建重复的组ID (GID)，但管理员可以手动编辑/etc/group文件并更改GID字段。注意:您还可以使用grpck命令检查/etc/group文件中的其他不一致
extraDetail.rationale: 必须为用户组分配唯一的gid，以便问责，并确保适当的访问保护
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:
#!/bin/bash   cut -d: -f3 /etc/group | sort | uniq -d | while read -r x; do    echo "Duplicate GID ($x) in /etc/group" done
extraDetail.remediation: 根据审计脚本的结果，建立唯一的GID，并检查共享GID所拥有的所有文件，以确定它们应该属于哪个组。附加信息:您还可以使用grpck命令检查/etc/group文件中的其他不一致
extraDetail.description_en:
Although the groupadd program will not let you create a duplicate Group ID (GID), it is possible for an administrator to manually edit the /etc/group file and change the GID field.
Note: You can also use the grpck command to check for other inconsistencies in the /etc/group file
extraDetail.rationale_en: User groups must be assigned unique GIDs for accountability and to ensure appropriate access protections
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script and verify no results are returned:
#!/bin/bash   cut -d: -f3 /etc/group | sort | uniq -d | while read -r x; do    echo "Duplicate GID ($x) in /etc/group" done
extraDetail.remediation_en: Based on the results of the audit script, establish unique GIDs and review all files owned by the shared GID to determine which group they are supposed to belong to. Additional Information: You can also use the grpck command to check for other inconsistencies in the /etc/group file

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure root is the only UID 0 account

extraDetail.description: UID为0的帐户在系统上具有超级用户权限。
extraDetail.rationale: 这种访问必须仅限于默认的根帐户，并且只能从系统控制台进行访问。管理访问必须通过非特权帐户，使用第5.6项中提到的批准机制，确保对su命令的访问受到限制
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，确认只返回“root”:
# awk -F: '($3 == 0) {print $1}' /etc/passwd 
root
extraDetail.remediation: 删除除root用户以外UID为0的任何用户，或根据需要为其分配一个新的UID
extraDetail.description_en: Any account with UID 0 has superuser privileges on the system
extraDetail.rationale_en: This access must be limited to only the default root account and only from the system console. Administrative access must be through an unprivileged account using an approved mechanism as noted in Item 5.6 Ensure access to the su command is restricted
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following command and verify that only "root" is returned:
# awk -F: '($3 == 0) { print $1 }' /etc/passwd
root
extraDetail.remediation_en: Remove any users other than root with UID 0 or assign them a new UID if appropriate

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure root PATH Integrity

extraDetail.description: root用户可以在系统上执行任何命令，如果PATH设置不正确，可能会被欺骗而无意中执行程序
extraDetail.rationale: 在root的可执行路径中包含当前工作目录(.)或其他可写目录，使得攻击者可以通过强制以root身份操作的管理员执行特洛伊木马程序来获得超级用户访问权限
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:
#!/bin/bash  RPCV="$(sudo -Hiu root env | grep '^PATH' | cut -d= -f2)" echo "$RPCV" | grep -q "::" && echo "root's path contains a empty directory (::)" echo "$RPCV" | grep -q ":$" && echo "root's path contains a trailing (:)" for x in $(echo "$RPCV" | tr ":" " "); do    if [ -d "$x" ]; then       ls -ldH "$x" | awk '$9 == "." {print "PATH contains current working directory (.)"}       $3 != "root" {print $9, "is not owned by root"}       substr($1,6,1) != "-" {print $9, "is group writable"}       substr($1,9,1) != "-" {print $9, "is world writable"}'    else       echo "$x is not a directory"    fi done
extraDetail.remediation: 纠正或证明审计步骤中发现的任何项
extraDetail.description_en: The root user can execute any command on the system and could be fooled into executing programs unintentionally if the PATH is not set correctly
extraDetail.rationale_en: Including the current working directory (.) or other writable directory in root 's executable path makes it likely that an attacker can gain superuser access by forcing an administrator operating as root to execute a Trojan horse program
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script and verify no results are returned:
#!/bin/bash  RPCV="$(sudo -Hiu root env | grep '^PATH' | cut -d= -f2)" echo "$RPCV" | grep -q "::" && echo "root's path contains a empty directory (::)" echo "$RPCV" | grep -q ":$" && echo "root's path contains a trailing (:)" for x in $(echo "$RPCV" | tr ":" " "); do    if [ -d "$x" ]; then       ls -ldH "$x" | awk '$9 == "." {print "PATH contains current working directory (.)"}       $3 != "root" {print $9, "is not owned by root"}       substr($1,6,1) != "-" {print $9, "is group writable"}       substr($1,9,1) != "-" {print $9, "is world writable"}'    else       echo "$x is not a directory"    fi done
extraDetail.remediation_en: Correct or justify any items discovered in the Audit step

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure all users' home directories exist
detail_zh: 确保所有用户的主目录都存在

extraDetail.description: 用户可以在/etc/passwd中定义，但没有主目录，或者有一个实际上不存在的主目录
extraDetail.rationale: 如果用户的主目录不存在或未分配，则用户将被放置在“/”目录下，并且不能写入任何文件或设置本地环境变量
extraDetail.description_en: Users can be defined in /etc/passwd without a home directory or with a home directory that does not actually exist

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure users own their home directories
detail_zh: 确保用户拥有自己的主目录

extraDetail.description: 用户主目录是为特定用户定义的空间，用于设置本地环境变量和存储个人文件
extraDetail.rationale: 由于用户对存储在用户主目录中的文件负责，因此用户必须是该目录的所有者
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下脚本并验证没有返回结果:

extraDetail.description_en: The user home directory is space defined for the particular user to set local environment variables and to store personal files
extraDetail.rationale_en: Since the user is accountable for files stored in the user home directory, the user must be the owner of the directory

detail_en: Ensure users' home directories permissions are 750 or more restrictive
detail_zh: 确保用户的主目录权限限制在750或以上

extraDetail.description: 虽然系统管理员可以为用户的主目录建立安全权限，但用户可以轻松地覆盖这些权限。
extraDetail.rationale: 组或全局可写用户主目录可能使恶意用户能够窃取或修改其他用户的数据，或获得其他用户的系统特权

creator: system
detail_en: Ensure no users have .netrc files
detail_zh: 确保没有用户拥有.netrc文件

extraDetail.description: .netrc文件包含通过FTP登录到远程主机进行文件传输的数据。虽然系统管理员可以为用户的.netrc文件建立安全权限，但用户可以轻松地覆盖这些权限
extraDetail.rationale:
.netrc文件存在重大的安全风险，因为它以未加密的形式存储密码。即使FTP被禁用，用户帐户也可能从其他系统带来。netrc文件，这可能对这些系统构成风险
如果需要一个.netrc文件，并且遵循本端站点策略，那么它应该具有600或更多的限制权限
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下脚本。这个脚本将返回:
失败:适用于权限限制小于600的任何.netrc文件
警告:针对交互用户主目录中存在的任何.netrc文件
#!/bin/bash  awk -F: '($1!~/(halt|sync|shutdown|nfsnobody)/ && $7!~/^(\/usr)?\/sbin\/nologin(\/)?$/ && $7!~/(\/usr)?\/bin\/false(\/)?$/) { print $1 " " $6 }' /etc/passwd | while read -r user dir; do    if [ -d "$dir" ]; then       file="$dir/.netrc"       if [ ! -h "$file" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then          if stat -L -c "%A" "$file" | cut -c4-10 |  grep -Eq '[^-]+'; then             echo "FAILED: User: \"$user\" file: \"$file\" exists with permissions: \"$(stat -L -c "%a" "$file")\", remove file or excessive permissions"          else             echo "WARNING: User: \"$user\" file: \"$file\" exists with permissions: \"$(stat -L -c "%a" "$file")\", remove file unless required"          fi       fi    fi done
验证:
*任何以FAILED开头的行:—根据本地网站策略，除非认为有必要，否则应删除File，并将权限更新为600或更多限制
*任何以“警告”开头的行:-除非认为有必要，否则应删除文件，并符合本地网站政策
extraDetail.description_en:
The .netrc file contains data for logging into a remote host for file transfers via FTP.
While the system administrator can establish secure permissions for users' .netrc files, the users can easily override these
extraDetail.rationale_en:
The .netrc file presents a significant security risk since it stores passwords in unencrypted form. Even if FTP is disabled, user accounts may have brought over .netrc files from other systems which could pose a risk to those systems.
If a .netrc file is required, and follows local site policy, it should have permissions of 600 or more restrictive
extraDetail.audit_en:
Run the following script. This script will return:
 FAILED: for any .netrc file with permissions less restrictive than 600
 WARNING: for any .netrc files that exist in interactive users' home directories
#!/bin/bash  awk -F: '($1!~/(halt|sync|shutdown|nfsnobody)/ && $7!~/^(\/usr)?\/sbin\/nologin(\/)?$/ && $7!~/(\/usr)?\/bin\/false(\/)?$/) { print $1 " " $6 }' /etc/passwd | while read -r user dir; do    if [ -d "$dir" ]; then       file="$dir/.netrc"       if [ ! -h "$file" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then          if stat -L -c "%A" "$file" | cut -c4-10 |  grep -Eq '[^-]+'; then             echo "FAILED: User: \"$user\" file: \"$file\" exists with permissions: \"$(stat -L -c "%a" "$file")\", remove file or excessive permissions"          else             echo "WARNING: User: \"$user\" file: \"$file\" exists with permissions: \"$(stat -L -c "%a" "$file")\", remove file unless required"          fi       fi    fi done
Verify:
 Any lines beginning with FAILED: - File should be removed unless deemed necessary, in accordance with local site policy, and permissions are updated to be 600 or more restrictive
 Any lines beginning with WARNING: - File should be removed unless deemed necessary, and in accordance with local site policy

extraDetail.rationale: 只有在/etc/pam.conf文件中允许.rhosts支持时，此操作才有意义。如果在/etc/pam.conf中禁用了支持，即使.rhosts文件是无效的，但它们可能是从其他系统带来的，并且可能包含对那些其他系统的攻击者有用的信息
